college-writing-001489.en: 1. As part of her editing, Finley checked and corrected the of two words, equipped and chocolate.
college-writing-001489.zh: 作为编辑工作的一部分，芬利检查并修正了“equipped”和“chocolate”这两个词。

college-writing-001490.en: 2. She added to set off two introductory phrases (“Like most of us” in the second sentence and “By the time I leave the theater” in the final sentence) and also to set off the interrupting word however in the fifth sentence.
college-writing-001490.zh: 2. 她添加了两个引入性短语（第二句中的“像我们大多数人一样”以及最后一句中的“当我离开剧院时”），同时还在第五句中使用了“然而”这个中断词。

college-writing-001491.en: 3. She realized that “milk duds” is a brand name and added to make it “Milk Duds.”
college-writing-001491.zh: 3. 她意识到“milk duds”是一个品牌名称，于是将其改为“Milk Duds”。

college-writing-001492.en: 4. And since revision can occur at any stage of the writing process, including editing, she made one of her details more vivid by adding the descriptive
college-writing-001492.zh: 4. 由于修改可以发生在写作过程的任何阶段，包括编辑阶段，她通过添加描述性内容让其中一个细节更加生动。

college-writing-001497.en: You now have a good overview of the writing process, from prewriting to first draft to revising to editing.
college-writing-001497.zh: 现在你已经对写作过程有了全面的了解，从构思阶段到初稿，再到修改阶段和编辑阶段。

college-writing-001498.en: The remaining chapters in Part 1 will deepen your sense of the four goals of effective writing: unity, support, organization or coherence, and sentence skills.
college-writing-001498.zh: 第一部分的剩余章节将帮助你更深刻地理解有效写作的四个目标：连贯性、支撑性、组织性或一致性，以及句子运用技巧。

college-writing-001499.en: To reinforce the information about the writing process that you have learned in this chapter, you can now work through the following activities:
college-writing-001499.zh: 为了巩固本章所学习的写作过程相关知识，你现在可以开展以下活动：

college-writing-001504.en: Taking a Writing Inventory Answer the questions below to evaluate your approach to the writing process.
college-writing-001504.zh: 进行写作评估，回答以下问题以衡量你的写作方法。

college-writing-001505.en: This activity is not a test, so try to be as honest as possible.
college-writing-001505.zh: 这项活动不是测试，所以尽量做到诚实。

college-writing-001506.en: Becoming aware of your writing habits will help you realize changes that may be helpful.
college-writing-001506.zh: 了解自己的写作习惯有助于你发现可能有用的改进之处。

college-writing-001507.en: 1. When you start work on an essay, do you typically do any prewriting?
college-writing-001507.zh: 1. 当你开始撰写文章时，通常会进行一些预写作工作吗？

college-writing-001509.en: 2. If so, which prewriting techniques do you use?
college-writing-001509.zh: 2. 如果是这样，你使用哪些预写作技巧？

college-writing-001510.en: Freewriting Diagramming Questioning Scratch outline List-making Other (please describe)
college-writing-001510.zh: 自由写作、图表绘制、提问、粗略提纲、列表制作、其他（请描述）

college-writing-001511.en: 3. Which prewriting technique or techniques work best for you, or which do you think will work best for you?
college-writing-001511.zh: 3. 哪种预写作技巧对你最有效？或者你认为哪种技巧最适合你？

college-writing-001512.en: 4. Many students say they find it helpful to handwrite a first draft and then type that draft on a computer.
college-writing-001512.zh: 4. 许多学生表示，手写初稿，然后用电脑将其输入到打字机中，对他们来说很有帮助。

college-writing-001513.en: They then print out the draft and revise it by hand.
college-writing-001513.zh: 然后他们打印出草稿，并手工修改。

college-writing-001514.en: Describe the way you proceed in drafting and revising an essay.
college-writing-001514.zh: 描述你撰写和修改文章的过程。

college-writing-001515.en: 5. After you write the first draft of an essay, do you have time to set it aside for a while so that you can come back to it with a fresh eye?
college-writing-001515.zh: 5. 写完文章的初稿后，你有时间将其搁置一段时间，以便以全新的视角再重新审视它吗？

college-writing-001519.en: 6. How many drafts do you typically write when working on an essay?
college-writing-001519.zh: 6. 撰写文章时，你通常会写多少份草稿？

college-writing-001520.en: 7. When you revise, are you aware that you should be working toward an essay
college-writing-001520.zh: 7. 在修改时，你意识到自己应该朝着撰写一篇文章的目标努力吗？

college-writing-001521.en: that is unified, solidly supported, and clearly organized?
college-writing-001521.zh: 那就是统一、有稳固支撑且结构清晰的吗？

college-writing-001522.en: Has this chapter given you a better sense that unity, support, and organization are goals to aim for?
college-writing-001522.zh: 这一章是否让你更清楚地认识到，团结、支持与组织是应追求的目标？

college-writing-001523.en: 8. Do you revise an essay for the effectiveness of its sentences as well as for its
college-writing-001523.zh: 8. 你是否会修改文章，不仅考虑句子的表达效果，还考虑其他方面？

college-writing-001526.en: 9. Do you typically do any editing of the almost-final draft of an essay, or do
college-writing-001526.zh: 9. 你通常会对接近定稿的论文草稿进行任何编辑吗？还是说……

college-writing-001527.en: you tend to “hope for the best” and hand it in without careful checking?
college-writing-001527.zh: 你往往“抱希望”，不经仔细检查就提交了吗？

college-writing-001529.en: 10. What (if any) information has this chapter given you about prewriting that you will try to apply in your writing?
college-writing-001529.zh: 10. 本章提供了哪些关于写作前准备的信息（如果有的话），你会尝试在写作中应用这些信息？

college-writing-001530.en: 11. What (if any) information has this chapter given you about revising that you will try to apply in your writing?
college-writing-001530.zh: 11. 本章提供了哪些（如果有的话）关于修改的内容，你打算在写作中应用这些内容吗？

college-writing-001531.en: 12. What (if any) information has this chapter given you about editing that you will try to apply in your writing?
college-writing-001531.zh: 12. 本章提供了哪些关于写作编辑的信息（如果有的话），你会尝试在写作中应用这些信息？

college-writing-001532.en: Prewriting On the following pages are examples of how the five prewriting techniques could be used to develop the topic “Problems of Combining Work and College.”
college-writing-001532.zh: 预写作 在接下来的页面中，展示了如何运用五种预写作技巧来探讨“工作与学业之间的冲突”这一主题。

college-writing-001533.en: Identify each technique by writing F (for freewriting), Q (for questioning), L (for list-making), C (for clustering), or SO (for the scratch outline) in the answer space.
college-writing-001533.zh: 在答案区域中，用 F（用于自由写作）、Q（用于提问）、L（用于列清单）、C（用于聚类）或 SO（用于草图大纲）来标识每种技巧。

college-writing-001534.en: Never enough time Miss campus parties Had to study (only two free hours a night) Give up activities with friends No time to rewrite papers Can’t stay at school to play video games or talk to friends Friends don’t call me to go out anymore
college-writing-001534.zh: 校园派对的时间永远不够，必须学习（每晚只有两个小时的空闲时间），无法参与朋友的活动，没有时间重写论文，不能留在学校玩电子游戏或与朋友聊天，朋友不再让我出去玩了。

college-writing-001537.en: Sunday no longer relaxed day─have to study Missing sleep I should be getting Grades aren’t as good as they could be Can’t watch favorite TV shows or stream YouTube Really need the extra money Tired when I sit down to study at nine o’clock
college-writing-001537.zh: 周日不再属于轻松的日子了——必须学习，睡眠不足，成绩也不如预期。无法观看喜欢的电视节目或观看YouTube视频。真的需要更多的钱。在九点坐下来学习时就会感到疲惫。

college-writing-001539.en: the problems of combining work and school?
college-writing-001539.zh: 工作与学习相结合的问题？

college-writing-001540.en: Schoolwork suffers because I don’t have time to study or rewrite papers.
college-writing-001540.zh: 学业任务难以完成，因为我没有时间学习或修改论文。

college-writing-001541.en: I’ve had to give up things I enjoy, like sleep and touch football.
college-writing-001541.zh: 我不得不放弃一些我喜欢的爱好，比如睡眠和触摸式橄榄球。

college-writing-001542.en: I can’t get into the social life at college, because I have to work right after class.
college-writing-001542.zh: 我无法参与大学里的社交活动，因为下课后我必须工作。

college-writing-001545.en: My grades aren’t as good as they were when I didn’t work.
college-writing-001545.zh: 我的成绩没有不工作时的那么好。

college-writing-001546.en: Some of my friends have stopped calling me.
college-writing-001546.zh: 我的一些朋友不再给我打电话了。

college-writing-001547.en: My relationship with a girl I liked fell apart because I couldn’t spend much time with her.
college-writing-001547.zh: 我喜欢的一个女孩与我的关系破裂了，因为我无法花太多时间与她在一起。

college-writing-001549.en: What do I do in a

college-writing-001551.en: I get up at 7 to make an 8 a.m. class.
college-writing-001551.zh: 我7点起床，去上上午8点的课程。

college-writing-001552.en: I have classes till 1:30, and then I drive to the supermarket where I work.
college-writing-001552.zh: 我到1:30还有课，之后我会开车去我工作的超市。

college-writing-001553.en: I work till 7 p.m., and then I drive home and eat dinner.
college-writing-001553.zh: 我工作到晚上7点，然后开车回家吃晚饭。

college-writing-001554.en: After I take a shower and relax for a half hour, it’s about 9.
college-writing-001554.zh: 洗完澡、放松了半小时之后，大约9点左右。

college-writing-001555.en: This gives me only a couple of hours to study─read textbooks, do math exercises, write essays.
college-writing-001555.zh: 这只能让我有几个小时来学习——阅读教材、做数学练习、写论文。

college-writing-001556.en: My eyes start to close well before I go to bed at 11.
college-writing-001556.zh: 11点睡觉前，我的眼睛就开始闭上了。

college-writing-001557.zh: 为什么我还要继续下去

college-writing-001559.en: I can’t afford to go to school without working, and I need a degree to get the accounting job I want.
college-writing-001559.zh: 我无法不工作就去上学，而且我需要学位才能获得我想要的会计工作。

college-writing-001560.en: If I invest my time now, I’ll have a better future.
college-writing-001560.zh: 如果我现在投入时间，就能拥有更美好的未来。

college-writing-001561.en: major difficulties juggling job and college
college-writing-001561.zh: 同时兼顾工作和学业的重大困难

college-writing-001565.zh: • 没有用于测试的学习时间

college-writing-001570.zh: • 没有时间享受个人乐趣

college-writing-001572.zh: • 周一晚上的橄榄球比赛

college-writing-001574.en: It’s hard working and going to school at the same time.
college-writing-001574.zh: 既要努力工作，又要同时去上学。

college-writing-001575.en: I never realized how much I’d have to give up.
college-writing-001575.zh: 我从未意识到自己需要放弃多少。

college-writing-001576.en: I won’t be quitting my job because I need the money.
college-writing-001576.zh: 我不会辞职，因为我需要这笔钱。

college-writing-001577.en: And the people are friendly at the place where I work.
college-writing-001577.zh: 而且我工作的地方的人都很友善。

college-writing-001578.en: I’ve had to give up a lot more than I thought.
college-writing-001578.zh: 我不得不放弃的，比我想象的要多得多。

college-writing-001579.en: We used to play touch football games every Sunday.
college-writing-001579.zh: 我们过去每个周日都会玩触式橄榄球游戏。

college-writing-001580.en: They were fun and we’d go out for drinks afterwards.
college-writing-001580.zh: 他们很有趣，之后我们还会一起出去喝酒。

college-writing-001581.en: Sundays now are for catch-up work with my courses.
college-writing-001581.zh: 现在，星期天用来补做课程作业。

college-writing-001582.en: I have to catch up because I don’t get home every day until 7, I have to eat dinner first before studying.
college-writing-001582.zh: 我得跟上进度，因为不是每天7点才回家，我得先吃晚饭，然后再学习。

college-writing-001583.en: Sometimes I’m so hungry I just eat cookies or chips.
college-writing-001583.zh: 有时候我饿得厉害，就吃饼干或薯片。

college-writing-001584.en: Anyway, by the time I take a shower it’s 9 p.m. or later and I’m already feeling tired.
college-writing-001584.zh: 无论如何，当我洗澡时已经是晚上9点或更晚了，我已经感到很疲惫了。

college-writing-001586.en: Sometimes I write an English paper in twenty minutes and don’t even read it over.
college-writing-001586.zh: 有时我能在20分钟内写出一篇英文论文，甚至都不需要再阅读。

college-writing-001587.en: I feel that I’m missing out on a lot in college.
college-writing-001587.zh: 我觉得在大学里我错过了很多东西。

college-writing-001588.en: The other day some people I like were sitting in the cafeteria listening to music and talking.
college-writing-001588.zh: 前几天，我喜欢的几个人坐在食堂里听音乐、聊天。

college-writing-001589.en: I would have given anything to stay and not have to go to work.
college-writing-001589.zh: 我愿意付出任何代价来留下，而不必去工作。

college-writing-001591.en: I used to get invited to parties, I don’t much anymore.
college-writing-001591.zh: 过去我常被邀请参加派对，现在却不常了。

college-writing-001592.en: My friends know I’m not going to be able to make it, so they don’t bother.
college-writing-001592.zh: 我的朋友们知道我无法参加，所以也不打扰我了。

college-writing-001593.en: I can’t sleep late on weekends or watch TV and YouTube videos during the week.
college-writing-001593.zh: 周末我无法睡懒觉，工作日也无法看电视或YouTube视频。

college-writing-001595.en: Outlining As already mentioned, outlining is central to writing a good essay.
college-writing-001595.zh: 提纲制定 如前所述，提纲制定是撰写优秀文章的关键环节。

college-writing-001596.en: An outline lets you see, and work on, the bare bones of an essay, without the distraction of a clutter of words and sentences.
college-writing-001596.zh: 提纲能让你看清并着手撰写文章的基本内容，而不受大量文字和句子的干扰。

college-writing-001597.en: It develops your ability to think clearly and logically.
college-writing-001597.zh: 它能提升你清晰、逻辑地思考的能力。

college-writing-001598.en: Outlining provides a quick check on whether your essay will be unified.
college-writing-001598.zh: 概述部分可以快速检查你的文章是否结构统一。

college-writing-001599.en: It also suggests right at the start whether your essay will be adequately supported.
college-writing-001599.zh: 它从一开始就提示你的文章是否得到了充分的支撑。

college-writing-001600.en: And it shows you how to plan an essay that is well organized.
college-writing-001600.zh: 它展示了如何规划一个结构严谨的文章。

college-writing-001601.en: There are two types of outlines that will help you create strong essays.
college-writing-001601.zh: 有两种提纲类型可以帮助你写出优秀的文章。

college-writing-001602.en: The first is a scratch, or informal, outline.
college-writing-001602.zh: 第一个是简略的、非正式的概述。

college-writing-001603.en: As we have seen earlier in this chapter, it can be a very helpful tool in the prewriting stage.
college-writing-001603.zh: 正如本章前面所提到的，它在写作前阶段可以成为一种非常有用的工具。

college-writing-001604.en: The second, a formal outline, is useful during the drafting and revision stages.
college-writing-001604.zh: 第二个，即正式大纲，在起草和修订阶段非常有用。

college-writing-001605.en: You should have a working thesis before you begin a formal outline.
college-writing-001605.zh: 在开始撰写正式提纲之前，你应该先确定一个可行的论点。

college-writing-001606.en: Unlike a scratch outline, a formal outline employs specific formatting and uses complete sentences.
college-writing-001606.zh: 与简略提纲不同，正式提纲采用特定的格式，并使用完整的句子。

college-writing-001607.en: Another way to use a formal outline is as a check.
college-writing-001607.zh: 使用正式提纲的另一种方式，可以将其作为一种检查手段。

college-writing-001608.en: Once you have written your draft, you can go through and outline your essay.
college-writing-001608.zh: 完成初稿后，你可以仔细审查并梳理文章的结构。

college-writing-001609.en: This will help you decide whether you have information that is out of place and will help you find a better location for that information.
college-writing-001609.zh: 这将帮助你判断是否有信息属于不合适的位置，从而帮你找到该信息的更合适存放地点。

college-writing-001610.en: The following two exercises will help you develop the two different outlining skills so important to planning and writing a solid essay.
college-writing-001610.zh: 以下两个练习将帮助你培养对撰写高质量文章至关重要的两种不同提纲制定技能。

college-writing-001611.en: One key to effective outlining is the ability to distinguish between major ideas and details that fit under those ideas.
college-writing-001611.zh: 有效列纲的一个关键，在于能够区分主要观点与属于这些观点下的细节。

college-writing-001612.en: In each of the four lists below, major and supporting items are mixed together.
college-writing-001612.zh: 在下面的四个列表中，主要项目与辅助项目混合在一起。

college-writing-001613.en: Working in pairs, put the items into logical order by filling in the scratch or formal outline that follows each list.
college-writing-001613.zh: 两人合作，通过填写列表后的空白或正式提纲，将内容按逻辑顺序排列。

college-writing-001623.zh: 这是保持健康的好方法。

college-writing-001626.zh: 人们可以在听歌的同时跑步

college-writing-001629.en: It burns calories and is great for
college-writing-001629.zh: 它能消耗卡路里，非常有益。

college-writing-001631.zh: 对心脏和肺部非常有益

college-writing-001641.zh: 4. 论点：互联网是大学生不可或缺的工具。

college-writing-001647.zh: 许多学习中心都有在线服务

college-writing-001648.en: resources, so students can easily get extra help.
college-writing-001648.zh: 资源充足，因此学生可以轻松获得额外帮助。

college-writing-001649.en: There is a lot of information

college-writing-001650.en: online to help with term papers.
college-writing-001650.zh: 在线帮助撰写学期论文。

college-writing-001653.en: Schedules can be more flexible if
college-writing-001653.zh: 如果计划表能够更灵活一些，就会更好。

college-writing-001655.en: It is easy to find additional infor-

college-writing-001659.en: Students can keep up in any
college-writing-001659.zh: 学生可以跟上任何进度

college-writing-001660.en: course even if they are absent.
college-writing-001660.zh: 即使他们不在，课程也照常进行。

college-writing-001661.en: Read the following essay and create a formal outline in the spaces provided.
college-writing-001661.zh: 阅读以下文章，并在提供的空格中制定一个正式提纲。

college-writing-001662.en: One item is done for you as an example.
college-writing-001662.zh: 这里以一项为例，为你完成。

college-writing-001668.en: Instead of commuting to an office, Julian stays home on workdays.
college-writing-001668.zh: 朱利安在工作日不去办公室工作，而是待在家里。

college-writing-001669.en: From the comfort of his home office, he logs into his computer, communicates with his co-workers via e-mail, and submits his reports through a company server.
college-writing-001669.zh: 他在家中办公室舒适地登录电脑，通过电子邮件与同事沟通，并通过公司服务器提交报告。

college-writing-001670.en: In the evenings, he streams music or movies, or surfs the Internet.
college-writing-001670.zh: 晚上，他会播放音乐或电影，或者上网浏览。

college-writing-001671.en: On many days, Julian doesn’t talk to any other human beings, and he doesn’t see any people except those on television or his electronic devices.
college-writing-001671.zh: 许多时候，朱利安不会与任何其他人交谈，他只看到电视上或他的电子设备上的那些人。

college-writing-001672.en: Julian is imaginary, but his lifestyle is very common.
college-writing-001672.zh: 朱利安是虚构的，但他的生活方式却非常常见。

college-writing-001673.en: More and more, the inventions of modern technology seem to be cutting us off from contact with our fellow human beings.
college-writing-001673.zh: 越来越多的现代技术发明似乎让我们与人类同伴的互动变得困难。

college-writing-001677.en: The world of business is one area in which technology is isolating us.
college-writing-001677.zh: 商业领域是技术让我们被孤立的一个领域。

college-writing-001678.en: Many people now work alone at home.
college-writing-001678.zh: 现在许多人都在家里独自工作。

college-writing-001679.en: With access to a large central computer, employees such as secretaries, insurance agents, and accountants do their jobs at display terminals in their own homes.
college-writing-001679.zh: 通过接入大型中央计算机，如秘书、保险代理和会计师等员工可以在自己的家中使用显示终端完成工作。

college-writing-001680.en: They no longer have to actually see the people they’re dealing with, except for the occasional Zoom meeting.
college-writing-001680.zh: 他们不再需要实际看到那些与他们打交道的人，除了偶尔的Zoom会议。

college-writing-001681.en: In addition, employees are often paid in an impersonal way.
college-writing-001681.zh: 此外，员工往往以非个人化的方式获得报酬。

college-writing-001682.en: Workers’ salaries are automatically credited to their bank accounts, eliminating the need for paychecks.
college-writing-001682.zh: 工人的工资会自动计入他们的银行账户，从而无需使用工资单形式支付。

college-writing-001683.en: Fewer people stand in line with their coworkers to receive their pay or cash their checks.
college-writing-001683.zh: 越来越少的人需要排队与同事一起领取工资或兑现支票。

college-writing-001684.en: Finally, personal banking is becoming a detached process.
college-writing-001684.zh: 最终，个人银行业务正逐渐成为一种独立化的过程。

college-writing-001685.en: Customers interact with machines rather than people to deposit or withdraw money from their accounts.
college-writing-001685.zh: 客户与机器互动，而不是与人类互动，以向账户中存入或取出资金。

college-writing-001686.en: Even some bank loans are approved or rejected, not in an interview with a loan officer, but by a computer program or app.
college-writing-001686.zh: 甚至一些银行贷款申请也是通过计算机程序或应用程序来审批或拒绝的，而不是通过与贷款官的面试。

college-writing-001689.en: Many people now work alone at home.
college-writing-001689.zh: 现在许多人都在家里独自工作。

college-writing-001695.en: Another area that technology is changing is entertainment.
college-writing-001695.zh: 技术的另一个改变领域是娱乐领域。

college-writing-001696.en: Music, for instance, was once a group experience.
college-writing-001696.zh: 例如，音乐曾经是一种集体体验。

college-writing-001697.en: People listened to music in concert halls or at small social gatherings.
college-writing-001697.zh: 人们会在音乐厅或小型社交聚会中聆听音乐。

college-writing-001698.en: For many people now, however, music is a solitary experience.
college-writing-001698.zh: 然而对于许多人来说，音乐现在是一种独处的体验。

college-writing-001699.en: Walking along the street or sitting in their living rooms, they wear headphones to build a wall of music around them.
college-writing-001699.zh: 无论是在街道上行走，还是坐在客厅里，他们都会佩戴耳机，让音乐成为包围他们的“屏障”。

college-writing-001700.zh: 电影娱乐形式也在变化。

college-writing-001701.en: Movies used to be social events.

college-writing-001702.en: Now, some people are not going out to see a movie.
college-writing-001702.zh: 现在，有些人不出去看电影了。

college-writing-001703.en: Some are choosing to wait for a film to appear on Netflix or Hulu.
college-writing-001703.zh: 有些人选择等待有电影在 Netflix 或 Hulu 上发布。

college-writing-001704.en: Instead of being involved with the laughter, applause, or hisses of the audience, viewers watch movies in the isolation of their own living rooms.
college-writing-001704.zh: 观众不再参与观众的笑声、掌声或嘶吼声，而是在自己客厅的独处中观看电影。

college-writing-001705.en: Education is a third important area in which technology is separating us from others.
college-writing-001705.zh: 教育是另一个重要领域，在这个领域里，技术让我们与其他人相分离。

college-writing-001706.en: From elementary schools to colleges, students spend more and more time sitting by themselves in front of computers.
college-writing-001706.zh: 从小学到大学，学生们在电脑前独坐的时间越来越长。

college-writing-001707.en: The computers give them feedback, while teachers spend more time tending the computers and less time interacting with their classes.
college-writing-001707.zh: 电脑为他们提供反馈，而教师则花费更多时间处理电脑相关事务，与学生的互动时间则减少。

college-writing-001708.en: A similar problem occurs in homes.
college-writing-001708.zh: 类似的問題也出现在家庭中。

college-writing-001709.en: As more families buy tablets and computers, increasing numbers of students practice their math and reading skills with apps and programs instead of with their friends, brothers and sisters, and parents.
college-writing-001709.zh: 随着越来越多的家庭购买平板电脑和电脑，越来越多的学生通过应用程序和软件来练习数学和阅读技能，而不是与朋友、兄弟姐妹或父母一起练习。

college-writing-001710.en: Last, alienation is occurring as a result of YouTube and through Zoom.
college-writing-001710.zh: 最后，这种分离现象是通过 YouTube 和 Zoom 实现的。

college-writing-001711.en: People are streaming videos and meeting virtually about subjects such as cooking, real estate investment, speaking, and learning a second language.
college-writing-001711.zh: 人们通过流媒体观看视频，并以虚拟方式讨论烹饪、房地产投资、演讲以及学习第二语言等话题。

college-writing-001712.en: They then practice their skills at home rather than by taking classes in which a rich human interaction can occur.
college-writing-001712.zh: 然后，他们会在家中练习自己的技能，而不是参加能够产生丰富人际互动的课程。

college-writing-001716.en: Technology, then, seems to be driving human beings apart.
college-writing-001716.zh: 因此，技术似乎正在将人类分开。

college-writing-001717.en: Soon, we may no longer need to communicate with other human beings to do our work, entertain ourselves, or pursue an education.
college-writing-001717.zh: 很快，我们可能就不需要与其他人交流来工作、娱乐或学习了。

college-writing-001718.en: Machines will be the coworkers and companions of the future.
college-writing-001718.zh: 机器将成为未来的同事与伙伴。

college-writing-001719.en: Revising Following is the second supporting paragraph from an essay called “Problems of Combining School and Work.”
college-writing-001719.zh: 修订内容：以下是从名为《学校与工作的结合问题》的文章中的第二段支持性文字。

college-writing-001720.en: The paragraph is shown in four different stages of development: (1) first draft, (2) revised second draft, (3) edited next-to-final draft, (4) final draft.
college-writing-001720.zh: 该段落展示了四个不同的发展阶段：(1) 初稿，(2) 修改后的第二稿，(3) 编辑后的接近定稿稿，(4) 定稿。

college-writing-001721.en: The four stages appear in scrambled order.
college-writing-001721.zh: 这四个阶段以混乱的顺序出现。

college-writing-001722.en: Write the number 1 in the answer blank for the first draft, and number the remaining stages in sequence.
college-writing-001722.zh: 在初稿的答案栏中填写数字1，并按顺序对其余阶段进行编号。

college-writing-001723.en: To help you get started, a few comments about the changes made in draft 2 are included here.
college-writing-001723.zh: 为了帮助您开始使用，这里包含了关于第2版中所做的变更的几点说明。

college-writing-001724.en: Add to these, but also record the changes made in drafts 3 and 4.
college-writing-001724.zh: 此外，还需记录第3版和第4版中所做的修改。

college-writing-001728.en: Adds information about sports he/she used to play.
college-writing-001728.zh: 添加了过去从事的运动的相关信息。

college-writing-001729.zh: 删除以“心理学家说”开头的句子。

college-writing-001732.en: I have also given up some personal pleasures in my life.
college-writing-001732.zh: 我也放弃了人生中一些个人享受。

college-writing-001733.en: On sundays for example I used to play softball or football, now I use the entire day to study.
college-writing-001733.zh: 比如星期天，我过去会打垒球或足球，现在则利用一整天的时间来学习。

college-writing-001734.en: Good old-fashioned sleep is another lost pleasure for me now.
college-writing-001734.zh: 传统的睡眠方式，如今也成了我错过的乐趣之一。

college-writing-001735.en: I never get as much as I like because their just isn’t time.
college-writing-001735.zh: 我永远无法得到我想要的，因为他们根本没有时间。

college-writing-001736.en: Finally I miss having the chance to just sit in front of the TV or stream my favorite YouTube videos, on weeknights.
college-writing-001736.zh: 最后，我怀念在周末的晚上能坐在电视前，或者观看自己最喜欢的YouTube视频的时光。

college-writing-001737.en: In order to watch the whole lineup of movies and sports that I used to watch regularly.
college-writing-001737.zh: 为了观看我过去经常观看的各类电影和体育节目。

college-writing-001738.en: These sound like small pleasures, but you realize how important they are when you have to give them up.
college-writing-001738.zh: 这些看似是微不足道的乐趣，但当你不得不放弃它们时，你就会意识到它们的的重要性。

college-writing-001739.en: I’ve had to give up pleasures in my life.
college-writing-001739.zh: 我不得不放弃生活中的许多乐趣。

college-writing-001740.en: I use to spend sundays playing games, now I have to study.
college-writing-001740.zh: 过去我常在周日玩游戏，现在却要学习。

college-writing-001741.en: Im the sort of person who needs a lot of sleep, but I dont have the time for that either.
college-writing-001741.zh: 我属于需要大量睡眠的人，但我也没有时间做这件事。

college-writing-001742.en: Sleeping nine or ten hours a night woul’dnt be unusual for me.
college-writing-001742.zh: 我每晚睡九到十个小时并不奇怪。

college-writing-001743.en: Psycologists say that each individual need a different amount of sleep, some people need as little as five hours, some need as much as nine or ten.
college-writing-001743.zh: 心理学家指出，每个人所需的睡眠时间不同，有些人只需要五小时，而有些人则需要九到十小时。

college-writing-001744.en: So I’m not unusual in that.

college-writing-001745.en: But Ive given up that pleasure too.
college-writing-001745.zh: 但我也放弃了那种乐趣。

college-writing-001746.en: And I can’t watch the TV shows or YouTube videos I use to enjoy.
college-writing-001746.zh: 我无法观看那些我用来消遣的电视节目或YouTube视频。

college-writing-001747.en: This is another personal pleasure Ive lost because of doing work and school.
college-writing-001747.zh: 这是我因工作和学习而失去的另一种个人乐趣。

college-writing-001748.en: These may seem like small things, but you realize how good they are when you give them up.
college-writing-001748.zh: 这些可能看起来是微不足道的小事，但当你放弃它们时，你就会意识到它们的价值。

college-writing-001749.en: Besides missing the social side of college life, I’ve also had to give up some of my special personal pleasures.
college-writing-001749.zh: 除了错过大学生活中的社交层面，我还不得不放弃一些特别的个人乐趣。

college-writing-001750.en: I used to spend Sunday afternoons, for example, playing lob-pitch softball or touch football depending on the season.
college-writing-001750.zh: 例如，我过去常常在周日下午进行垒球或触式足球比赛，具体取决于季节情况。

college-writing-001751.en: Now I use Sunday as a catch-up day for my studies.
college-writing-001751.zh: 现在我把周日作为复习学习的日子。

college-writing-001752.en: Another pleasure I’ve lost is sleeping late on days off and weekends.
college-writing-001752.zh: 我又失去了一个乐趣，那就是在休息日和周末晚睡。

college-writing-001753.en: I once loved mornings when I could check the clock, bury my head in the pillow, and drift off for another hour.
college-writing-001753.zh: 我曾经喜欢那些早晨，可以查看时钟，把头埋在枕头里，再沉浸在睡梦中一小时。

college-writing-001754.en: These days I’m forced to crawl out of bed the minute the alarm lets out its piercing ring.
college-writing-001754.zh: 如今，一旦闹钟发出刺耳的响声，我就被迫立刻从床上爬起来。

college-writing-001755.en: Finally, I no longer have the chance to just sit watching the movies and sports programs that I enjoy.
college-writing-001755.zh: 最后，我再也没有机会只是坐下来观看我喜欢的电影和体育节目了。

college-writing-001756.en: A leisurely night of Monday Night Football or a Dwayne Johnson movie is a pleasure of the past for me now.
college-writing-001756.zh: 对于我来说，在周一的夜晚观看足球比赛或看德韦恩·约翰逊的电影，曾经是令人愉悦的享受。

college-writing-001757.en: Besides missing the social side of college life, I’ve also had to give up some of my special personal pleasures.
college-writing-001757.zh: 除了错过大学生活中的社交层面，我还不得不放弃一些特别的个人乐趣。

college-writing-001758.en: I used to spend sunday afternoons, for example playing lob-pitch softball or touch football depending on the season.
college-writing-001758.zh: 过去，我会在周日下午进行活动，根据季节的不同，可能会玩投球棒球或触式足球。

college-writing-001759.en: Now I use the day as a catch-up day for my studies.
college-writing-001759.zh: 现在我把这一天作为复习学习的日子。

college-writing-001760.en: Another pleasure I’ve lost is sleeping late on days off and weekends.
college-writing-001760.zh: 我又失去了一个乐趣，那就是在休息日和周末晚睡。

college-writing-001761.en: I once loved mornings when I could check the clock, then burying my head in the pillow, and you drift off to sleep for another hour.
college-writing-001761.zh: 我曾经喜欢那些可以查看时钟的早晨，然后把头埋在枕头里，再睡上一个小时。

college-writing-001762.en: These days I’m forced to get out of bed the minute the alarm lets out
college-writing-001762.zh: 如今，一旦闹钟响起，我就被迫立刻下床。

college-writing-001765.en: Finally I no longer have the chance to just sit watching the movies and also programs with sports that I enjoy.
college-writing-001765.zh: 最后，我再也没有机会只是坐着观看电影，以及那些我喜欢的体育节目了。

college-writing-001766.en: A leisurely night of Monday Night Football or a Dwayne Johnson movie is a pleasure of the past for me now.
college-writing-001766.zh: 对于我来说，在周一的夜晚观看足球比赛或看德韦恩·约翰逊的电影，曾经是令人愉悦的享受。

college-writing-001767.en: After you have done that, explain why you think that drafts 2, 3, and 4 are each better than the one that preceded them.
college-writing-001767.zh: 完成之后，请说明为什么认为草案2、3和4分别优于之前的版本。

college-writing-001768.en: In other words, explain what improvements that writer has made to each.
college-writing-001768.zh: 换句话说，说明作者对每一部分做出了哪些改进。

college-writing-001769.en: As you do this, consider the following questions:
college-writing-001769.zh: 在做这件事时，请考虑以下问题：

college-writing-001770.en: 1. Is this version of the paragraph better unified, supported, and organized than the previous one?
college-writing-001770.zh: 这个版本的文字表述是否比之前的版本更统一、更清晰、更有序？

college-writing-001771.en: (Review the Revising Content questions presented earlier in this chapter.)
college-writing-001771.zh: （回顾本章前面提到的修改内容相关问题。）

college-writing-001773.en: (Review the Revising Sentences questions presented earlier in this chapter.)
college-writing-001773.zh: （复习本章前面出现的“修改句子”题目。）

college-writing-001774.en: 3. Has the student edited for mistakes in grammar, punctuation, and spelling?
college-writing-001774.zh: 3. 学生是否对语法、标点和拼写错误进行了修正？

college-writing-001776.en: This chapter will show you how to • start an essay with a point, or thesis • support that point, or thesis, with specific evidence
college-writing-001776.zh: 本章将向您展示如何•以一个观点或论点作为文章的开头•用具体证据来支撑该观点或论点

college-writing-001777.en: The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing

college-writing-001778.en: C H A P T E R

college-writing-001779.en: Describe a favorite childhood place that made you feel secure, safe, private, or in a world of your own.
college-writing-001779.zh: 描述一个让你感到安心、安全、私密或拥有自己世界的童年喜爱之地。

college-writing-001780.en: Begin with a thesis statement, something like this: “_____ was a place that made me feel _____ when I was a child.”
college-writing-001780.zh: 以一个中心论点句开头，例如：“在我小时候，_____是一个让我感到_____的地方。”

college-writing-001781.en: Remember to keep the point of your thesis statement in mind as you describe this place.
college-writing-001781.zh: 描写这个地方时，记住你在中心论点句中想表达的观点。

college-writing-001782.en: Include only details that will support the idea that your place was one of security, safety, privacy, or the like.
college-writing-001782.zh: 仅包含那些能支持“您的场所属于安全、安保、隐私类场所”这一观点的细节。

college-writing-001784.en: Chapter 2 emphasized how prewriting and revising can help you become an effective writer.
college-writing-001784.zh: 第二章强调了预写作和修改如何帮助你成为一名高效的作家。

college-writing-001785.en: This chapter focuses on the first two steps in writing an effective essay:
college-writing-001785.zh: 本章重点介绍撰写有效文章的前两个步骤：

college-writing-001786.en: 1. Begin with a point, or thesis.
college-writing-001786.zh: 1. 从一个观点或论点开始。

college-writing-001787.en: 2. Support the thesis with specific evidence.
college-writing-001787.zh: 2. 用具体证据支持该论点。

college-writing-001788.en: The chapters that follow will focus on the third and fourth steps in writing:
college-writing-001788.zh: 接下来的章节将重点讨论写作的第三步和第四步：

college-writing-001789.en: 3. Organize and connect the specific evidence (Chapter 4).
college-writing-001789.zh: 3. 整理并连接具体证据（第4章）。

college-writing-001790.zh: 4. 写出清晰、无错误的句子（第5章）。

college-writing-001792.en: Step 1: Begin with a Point, or Thesis
college-writing-001792.zh: 步骤1：以一个观点或论点作为起点

college-writing-001793.en: Your first step in writing is to discover what point you want to make and to write that point out as a single sentence.
college-writing-001793.zh: 写作的第一步是确定你想表达的观点，并将该观点以一句话的形式表达出来。

college-writing-001794.en: There are two reasons for doing this.

college-writing-001795.en: You want to know right from the start if you have a clear and workable thesis.
college-writing-001795.zh: 从一开始就想清楚自己是否有清晰且可行的论点。

college-writing-001796.en: Also, you will be able to use the thesis as a guide while writing your essay.
college-writing-001796.zh: 此外，在写作论文时，你可以将这篇论文作为参考。

college-writing-001797.en: At any stage you can ask yourself, Does this support my thesis?
college-writing-001797.zh: 在任何阶段，你都可以问自己：这是否支持了我的论点？

college-writing-001798.en: With the thesis as a guide, the danger of drifting away from the point of the essay is greatly reduced.
college-writing-001798.zh: 以这一论点为指导，偏离文章核心主题的危险大大降低了。

college-writing-001799.en: Understanding Thesis Statements In Chapter 1, you learned that effective essays center around a thesis, or main point, that a writer wishes to express.
college-writing-001799.zh: 理解中心论点句 在第一章中，你了解到有效的文章都是以一个论点或主要观点为核心的，这是作者想要表达的内容。

college-writing-001800.en: This central idea is usually presented as a thesis statement in an essay’s introductory paragraph.
college-writing-001800.zh: 这个中心观点通常以中心论点句的形式出现在文章的引言段中。

college-writing-001801.en: A good thesis statement does two things.
college-writing-001801.zh: 一个好的中心论点句要做到两件事。

college-writing-001802.en: First, it tells readers an essay’s topic.
college-writing-001802.zh: 首先，它向读者说明文章的主题。

college-writing-001803.en: Second, it presents the writer’s attitude, opinion, idea, or point about that topic.
college-writing-001803.zh: 其次，它展示了作者关于该主题的态度、观点、想法或论点。

college-writing-001804.en: This is often referred to as the author’s claim.
college-writing-001804.zh: 这通常被称为作者的主张。

college-writing-001805.en: For example, look at the following thesis statement:
college-writing-001805.zh: 例如，请看下面这个中心论点句：

college-writing-001806.en: Owning a pet has several important benefits.
college-writing-001806.zh: 拥有宠物有几个重要的好处。

college-writing-001807.en: In this thesis statement, the topic is owning a pet; the writer’s main point is that owning a pet has several important benefits.
college-writing-001807.zh: 在这个中心论点句中，主题是养宠物；作者的主要观点是，养宠物有几个重要好处。

college-writing-001808.en: For each thesis statement below, single-underline the topic and double-underline the main point that the writer wishes to express about the topic.
college-writing-001808.zh: 请在下面每个中心论点句中给主题画一条下划线，给作者就该主题表达的主要观点画两条下划线。

college-writing-001809.en: examples Our company president should be fired for three main reasons.
college-writing-001809.zh: 例子：我们公司的总裁应因三个主要原因被解雇。

college-writing-001810.en: The Internet has led to new kinds of frustration in everyday life.
college-writing-001810.zh: 互联网给日常生活带来了新的烦恼。

college-writing-001811.zh: 照顾孩子需要付出努力、投入和耐心。

college-writing-001812.en: 2. Celebrities are often poor role models because of the ways they dress, talk,
college-writing-001812.zh: 2. 名人往往不是良好的榜样，因为他们的穿着和说话方式，

college-writing-001814.en: 3. My first night as a security guard turned out to be one of the most frightening
college-writing-001814.zh: 3. 作为保安的第一个夜晚，成了最令人恐惧的夜晚之一。

college-writing-001816.en: 4. SUVs are inferior to cars because they are harder to control, more expensive,
college-writing-001816.zh: 4. 越野车不如轿车，因为它们更难以操控，价格也更高。

college-writing-001818.en: 5. The twentieth century produced three inventions that dramatically changed
college-writing-001818.zh: 5. 二十世纪出现了三项彻底改变世界的发明。

college-writing-001821.zh: 第三章 写作的第一和第二步 57

college-writing-001822.en: 6. Stress in the fast-food workplace has led to serious physical, psychological,
college-writing-001822.zh: 6. 快餐行业中的压力导致了严重的身体与心理问题，

college-writing-001824.en: 7. Advertisers target young people when marketing e-cigarettes, cell phones, and
college-writing-001824.zh: 7. 在推广电子烟、手机时，广告商会将目标对准年轻人。

college-writing-001826.en: 8. Christian Bale’s varied film roles demonstrate his versatility as an actor.
college-writing-001826.zh: 8. 克里斯蒂安·贝尔在各类电影中的不同角色表现，证明了他作为演员的多样性。

college-writing-001827.zh: 9. 美国汽车制造商需要生产那些具有电动特性、安全性更高且更省油的车辆。

college-writing-001829.zh: 10. 在任何工作中取得成功，需要具备准时性、可靠性与抱负。

college-writing-001830.en: Writing a Good Thesis I Now that you know how thesis statements work, you can begin writing your own.
college-writing-001830.zh: 撰写优秀的论文——既然你已经了解了中心论点句的写法，就可以开始撰写自己的论点了。

college-writing-001831.en: To start, you need a topic that is neither too broad nor too narrow.
college-writing-001831.zh: 首先，你需要一个既不太宽泛也不太狭窄的主题。

college-writing-001832.en: Suppose, for example, that an instructor asks you to write a paper on marriage.
college-writing-001832.zh: 例如，假设一位讲师要求你写一篇关于婚姻的论文。

college-writing-001833.en: Such a subject is too broad to cover in a five-hundred-word essay.
college-writing-001833.zh: 这个主题过于宽泛，无法在五百字的文章中涵盖完整。

college-writing-001834.en: You would have to write a book to support adequately any point you might make about the general subject of marriage.
college-writing-001834.zh: 你需要写一本书来充分支持你关于婚姻这一主题的任何观点。

college-writing-001835.en: What you would need to do, then, is limit your subject.
college-writing-001835.zh: 那么，你需要做的就是限制你的主题范围。

college-writing-001836.en: Narrow it down until you have a thesis that you can deal with specifically in about five hundred words.
college-writing-001836.zh: 缩小范围，直到你能提出一个可以在约五百字内具体阐述的论点。

college-writing-001837.en: In the box that follows are (1) several general subjects, (2) a limited version of each general subject, and (3) a thesis statement about each limited subject.
college-writing-001837.zh: 下方方框列出了（1）几个宽泛的主题，（2）各主题缩小范围后的版本，以及（3）围绕每个限定主题写成的中心论点句。

college-writing-001838.en: General Subject Limited Subject Thesis Marriage Honeymoon A honeymoon is perhaps the worst way to begin a marriage.
college-writing-001838.zh: 一般主题 限定主题 论文 婚姻 蜜月 蜜月或许是开启婚姻时最糟糕的方式。

college-writing-001839.en: Family Older sister My older sister helped me overcome my shyness.
college-writing-001839.zh: 家人 姐姐 我的姐姐帮助我克服了我的害羞情绪。

college-writing-001841.en: Television stations offer many great educational programs for young children.
college-writing-001841.zh: 电视台为幼儿提供许多优秀的教育节目。

college-writing-001842.zh: 孩子们 孩子们帮忙做家务

college-writing-001843.en: My spouse and I have several creative ways to encourage our children to complete household duties.
college-writing-001843.zh: 我和我的配偶有几种创意方法，用来激励孩子们完成家务任务。

college-writing-001844.en: Sports Players’ salaries Players’ high salaries are bad for the game, for the fans, and for the values our children are developing.
college-writing-001844.zh: 运动员的薪酬：过高的薪酬对比赛、球迷以及我们孩子所培养的价值观都是不利的。

college-writing-001846.en: Sometimes a subject must go through several stages of limiting before it is narrow enough to write about.
college-writing-001846.zh: 有时，一个主题必须经历多个限制阶段，才能变得足够狭窄以进行论述。

college-writing-001847.en: Below are four lists reflecting several stages that writers went through in moving from a general subject to a narrow thesis statement.
college-writing-001847.zh: 下面四组例子展示了写作者如何分阶段把一个宽泛的主题收束成一个具体的中心论点句。

college-writing-001848.en: Number the stages in each list from 1 to 5, with 1 marking the broadest stage and 5 marking the thesis.
college-writing-001848.zh: 将每个列表中的阶段从1到5编号，其中1表示最宽泛的阶段，5表示最终结论。

college-writing-001864.en: Later in this chapter, you will get more practice in narrowing general subjects to thesis statements.
college-writing-001864.zh: 在本章的后续内容中，你将获得更多将一般主题缩小为中心论点句的练习。

college-writing-001865.en: How to Limit and Focus Your Thesis
college-writing-001865.zh: 如何限制与聚焦你的论点

college-writing-001866.en: You have just learned that it is important to limit a topic.
college-writing-001866.zh: 你刚刚了解到，限制话题范围非常重要。

college-writing-001867.en: One way to do this is by clustering, which is also a good way to gather information.
college-writing-001867.zh: 一种实现方式是通过聚类，这也是收集信息的好方法。

college-writing-001868.en: (If necessary, turn back to Chapter 2 to review how to cluster.)
college-writing-001868.zh: （如有需要，可返回第二章了解如何进行聚类。）

college-writing-001869.en: Let’s say your instructor assigns a paper on physical exercise.
college-writing-001869.zh: 假设你的老师布置了一道关于体育运动的论文作业。

college-writing-001870.en: Obviously, this is far too broad a topic for a short paper.
college-writing-001870.zh: 显然，对于一篇短论文来说，这个主题范围太广了。

college-writing-001871.en: Therefore, you can try to cluster ideas around this topic as a way to limit it to an aspect of the topic that you know most about or that you are
college-writing-001871.zh: 因此，你可以尝试围绕这个主题将各种想法聚集起来，以此将讨论范围限制在你最了解或最熟悉的那个方面。

college-writing-001878.zh: 我已经学会了如何应对

college-writing-001884.en: My first camping trip was a
college-writing-001884.zh: 我的第一次露营之旅是

college-writing-001887.zh: 第三章 写作的第一步与第二步 59

college-writing-001889.en: Here’s an example of how one student began to use this method to limit her topic:
college-writing-001889.zh: 以下是一个例子，说明一名学生如何开始使用这种方法来限定她的主题：

college-writing-001890.en: Immediately after completing this exercise, the student realized that the type of physical exercise she knew most about was running.
college-writing-001890.zh: 完成这项练习后不久，学生意识到她最熟悉的体育项目是跑步。

college-writing-001891.en: So, she decided to limit her essay to that topic.
college-writing-001891.zh: 因此，她决定将论文主题限定在那个话题上。

college-writing-001892.en: However, she also knew that she would have to focus on a main point about running and that her clustering suggested several different main points.
college-writing-001892.zh: 然而，她也知道必须专注于跑步的某个核心要点，而她的分析表明存在几个不同的核心点。

college-writing-001894.en: • Running is an easy way to get needed exercise: it is inexpensive, can be done almost anywhere, and requires few special skills.
college-writing-001894.zh: • 跑步是获得所需锻炼的便捷方式：成本低廉，几乎可以在任何地方进行，所需技能也很少。

college-writing-001896.en: • Running benefits the lungs, circulatory system, and the leg muscles.
college-writing-001896.zh: • 跑步对肺部、循环系统以及腿部肌肉有益。

college-writing-001897.en: • Running burns calories and helps maintain a healthy weight.
college-writing-001897.zh: • 跑步可以消耗卡路里，有助于保持健康的体重。

college-writing-001898.en: To determine which of these three main points she could most easily write about, the student used another prewriting technique, making a list.
college-writing-001898.zh: 为了确定这三个主要方面中她最容易撰写哪一个，学生采用了另一种写作前的技巧——列清单。

college-writing-001899.en: (If necessary, turn back to Chapter 2 to review list making.)
college-writing-001899.zh: （如有需要，可返回第二章复习列表制作相关内容。）

college-writing-001900.en: In fact, she listed everything she knew about each of her three potential thesis statements:
college-writing-001900.zh: 事实上，她列出了关于她的三个潜在中心论点句的所有已知信息：

college-writing-001902.zh: 对循环系统、肺部和肌肉有益

college-writing-001903.en: Helps maintain a healthy weight Can be done outside or inside
college-writing-001903.zh: 有助于保持健康的体重，可以在户外或室内进行

college-writing-001905.en: Lost 20 pounds in one year running three times a week No special training needed
college-writing-001905.zh: 一年内减了20磅，每周练习三次。不需要特殊训练

college-writing-001906.en: Strengthens lungs, improves breathing Inexpensive Slows pulse rate No special location needed
college-writing-001906.zh: 增强肺部功能，改善呼吸效果 价格低廉 可减缓心率 无需特定放置位置

college-writing-001908.en: No uniform or special clothing required Can be done with others Can be done while listening to music on headset
college-writing-001908.zh: 不需要统一或特殊服装，可以与他人一起进行，也可以在佩戴耳机听音乐的同时进行。

college-writing-001909.en: It is obvious from what we see here that the interests of the student favor writing about why running is an easy way to get exercise.
college-writing-001909.zh: 从我们看到的内容来看，学生的兴趣在于撰写关于为什么跑步是进行锻炼的便捷方式的文章。

college-writing-001910.en: As you can see, limiting or narrowing a topic is extremely important.
college-writing-001910.zh: 如你所见，限制或缩小主题范围非常重要。

college-writing-001911.en: However, you will also have to focus on a main point.
college-writing-001911.zh: 然而，你也必须关注一个主要点。

college-writing-001912.en: Writers should always be committed to the ideas they are discussing.
college-writing-001912.zh: 作者应始终致力于他们所讨论的理念。

college-writing-001913.en: So, if possible, always write about the main point that you know most about, that you are most interested in, or that you are most passionate about.
college-writing-001913.zh: 因此，如果可能的话，始终要写关于你最了解、最感兴趣或最热爱的核心内容。

college-writing-001914.zh: 以下是关于同一主题的不同主要观点的中心论点句列表。

college-writing-001915.en: Each can be the foundation of a very different essay.
college-writing-001915.zh: 每一个都可以成为一篇截然不同文章的基础。

college-writing-001925.zh: 上大学让人们能够欣赏不同的文化。

college-writing-001927.en: Going to college provides students with analytical skills that
college-writing-001927.zh: 上大学能赋予学生分析能力，这些能力对于他们来说非常宝贵。

college-writing-001928.zh: 可以带来有回报的职业发展。

college-writing-001929.en: Going to college requires study habits different from those
college-writing-001929.zh: 上大学需要与平时不同的学习习惯

college-writing-001931.en: Conserving energy at home saves residents a great deal of money.
college-writing-001931.zh: 在家中节约能源可以让居民节省大量资金。

college-writing-001932.en: Conserving energy at home reduces air pollution caused by the burning
college-writing-001932.zh: 在家节约能源可以减少燃烧产生的空气污染

college-writing-001934.en: Conserving energy at home doesn’t require a change in lifestyle.
college-writing-001934.zh: 在家节约能源不需要改变生活方式。

college-writing-001935.en: Conserving energy at home reduces our dependence on foreign sources
college-writing-001935.zh: 在家节约能源能减少我们对外部资源的依赖

college-writing-001937.en: The Internet should be regulated to protect children.
college-writing-001937.zh: 应当对互联网进行监管以保护儿童。

college-writing-001938.en: The Internet is an inexpensive way to transmit

college-writing-001942.zh: 重要的社会与政治问题。

college-writing-001943.en: As you can see, you can write several different thesis statements about the same topic.
college-writing-001943.zh: 如你所见，你可以针对同一个主题写出几种不同的中心论点句。

college-writing-001944.en: In each case, of course, your purpose will help determine your main point and may even help shape the organization of your paper.
college-writing-001944.zh: 当然，在每种情况下，你的目的将有助于确定你的核心观点，甚至可能有助于决定你论文的结构。

college-writing-001945.en: Below is a list of several different thesis statements written on “heating costs.”
college-writing-001945.zh: 以下是关于“供暖成本”的几个不同的中心论点句列表。

college-writing-001947.en: Purpose Thesis To analyze A home energy audit revealed that we can
college-writing-001947.zh: 目的与论点：通过分析家庭能源审计结果发现，我们可以

college-writing-001948.en: reduce home heating costs by $500 a year.
college-writing-001948.zh: 每年可节省500美元的家庭供暖费用。

college-writing-001949.en: To explain a cause Our home heating costs were high because
college-writing-001949.zh: 为了解释原因，我们家的取暖费用高是因为

college-writing-001950.en: of poor insulation, drafty windows, and an inefficient furnace.
college-writing-001950.zh: 隔热性能差，窗户通风不良，以及炉子效率低下。

college-writing-001952.en: Purpose Thesis To contrast Homes using passive solar energy have lower
college-writing-001952.zh: 目的论点：对比使用被动太阳能的住宅，其温度较低

college-writing-001953.zh: 取暖费用比其他地方更高。

college-writing-001954.en: To explain an effect Higher heating costs have made architects design
college-writing-001954.zh: 为了解释这一效应，更高的供暖成本促使建筑师进行设计创新

college-writing-001956.en: To explain a process Lowering home heating costs is easy if one fol-

college-writing-001958.en: To offer a solution People who own older homes should have an

college-writing-001959.en: energy audit to find ways to reduce heating costs.
college-writing-001959.zh: 进行能源审计，以寻找降低供暖成本的方法。

college-writing-001960.en: To classify Heating costs can be reduced by using fossil-fuel
