college-writing-001964.zh: 为了说明其缺点：安装太阳能板可以降低取暖费用。

college-writing-001965.en: but they are unsightly and expensive.
college-writing-001965.zh: 但它们外观难看且价格昂贵。

college-writing-001966.en: Writing a Good Thesis II When writing thesis statements, people often make mistakes that undermine their chances of producing an effective essay.
college-writing-001966.zh: 写好中心论点句（二）：写中心论点句时，人们常犯一些错误，影响文章的表达效果。

college-writing-001967.en: One mistake is to simply announce the subject rather than state a true thesis.
college-writing-001967.zh: 一个错误就是仅仅宣布主题，而不阐述真正的论点。

college-writing-001968.en: A second mistake is to write a thesis that is too broad, and a third is to write a thesis that is too narrow.
college-writing-001968.zh: 第二个错误是撰写过于宽泛的论点，第三个错误是撰写过于狭窄的论点。

college-writing-001969.en: A fourth error is to write a thesis containing more than one idea.
college-writing-001969.zh: 第四个错误是撰写包含多个观点的论文。

college-writing-001970.en: Here are tips for avoiding such mistakes and writing good thesis statements.
college-writing-001970.zh: 以下是避免此类错误并撰写优秀中心论点句的技巧。

college-writing-001972.en: The subject of this paper will be my parents.
college-writing-001972.zh: 本文的主题将是我父母。

college-writing-001973.en: I want to talk about the crime wave in our country.
college-writing-001973.zh: 我想谈谈我们国家的犯罪浪潮。

college-writing-001974.en: The millennial generation is the concern of this essay.
college-writing-001974.zh: 千禧一代是本文关注的主题。

college-writing-001975.en: In this first group, the sentences are not thesis statements but announcements of a topic.
college-writing-001975.zh: 在这一组中，这些句子并非中心论点句，而是关于某个主题的说明。

college-writing-001976.en: For instance, “The subject of this paper will be my parents” does not make a point about the parents but merely tells, in a rather weak and unimaginative way, the writer’s general subject.
college-writing-001976.zh: 例如，“本文的主题将是我的父母”并没有明确说明关于父母的任何内容，只是以一种相当平淡且缺乏创意的方式，简单地描述了作者的总体主题。

college-writing-001977.en: Remember, a thesis statement must make a point about a limited subject.
college-writing-001977.zh: 请记住，中心论点句必须针对一个范围明确的主题提出观点。

college-writing-001978.en: Effective thesis statements based on the above sentences could be as follows:
college-writing-001978.zh: 基于上述句子有效的中心论点句可以如下：

college-writing-001979.en: My parents each struggled with personal demons.
college-writing-001979.zh: 我的父母都面临着个人层面的困扰。

college-writing-001980.en: The recent crime wave in our city has several apparent causes.
college-writing-001980.zh: 我们城市近期发生的犯罪浪潮有几个明显的原因。

college-writing-001981.en: The millennial generation has changed American society in key ways.
college-writing-001981.zh: 千禧一代以关键方式改变了美国社会。

college-writing-001982.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 63
college-writing-001982.zh: 第三章 写作的第一步与第二步 63

college-writing-001983.en: 2 Avoid Statements That Are Too Broad

college-writing-001985.zh: 昆虫是令人着迷的生物。

college-writing-001986.en: Men and women are very different.

college-writing-001987.en: In the preceding examples, each statement is too broad to be supported adequately in a student essay.
college-writing-001987.zh: 在之前的例子中，每个观点都过于宽泛，无法在学生论文中得到充分支持。

college-writing-001988.en: For instance, “Disease has shaped human history” would require far more than a five-hundred-word essay.
college-writing-001988.zh: 例如，“疾病塑造了人类历史”这一主题，需要超过五百字的文章才能充分阐述。

college-writing-001989.en: In fact, there are many lengthy books written on the exact same topic.
college-writing-001989.zh: 事实上，有许多篇幅很长的书籍都是关于同一个主题的。

college-writing-001990.en: Remember, your thesis statement should be focused enough that it can be effectively supported in a five-paragraph essay.
college-writing-001990.zh: 请记住，你的中心论点句应该足够聚焦，使它能在一篇五段式文章中得到充分论证。

college-writing-001991.en: Revised thesis statements based on the topics in the above sentences could be as follows:
college-writing-001991.zh: 基于上述句子中的主题，修改后的中心论点句可以如下：

college-writing-001992.en: In 2020, Covid-19 changed people's views about regularly wearing face masks when in public.
college-writing-001992.zh: 2020年，新冠疫情改变了人们对于在公共场合定期佩戴口罩的看法。

college-writing-001993.en: Strength, organization, and communication make the ant one of nature’s most successful insects.
college-writing-001993.zh: 力量、组织能力和沟通能力，使得蚂蚁成为自然界中最成功的昆虫之一。

college-writing-001994.en: Men and women are often treated very differently in the workplace.
college-writing-001994.zh: 在职场上，男性和女性往往受到不同的对待。

college-writing-001995.en: 3 Avoid Statements That Are Too Narrow

college-writing-001996.en: Here are three statements that are too narrow:
college-writing-001996.zh: 以下是三个过于狭隘的表述：

college-writing-001997.en: The speed limit near my home is sixty-five miles per hour.
college-writing-001997.zh: 我家附近的限速是每小时六十五英里。

college-writing-001998.en: A hurricane hit southern Florida last summer.
college-writing-001998.zh: 去年夏天，一场飓风袭击了佛罗里达州南部。

college-writing-001999.en: A person must be at least thirty-five years old to be elected president of the United States.
college-writing-001999.zh: 要当选为美国总统，年龄必须至少达到35岁。

college-writing-002000.en: In this third group, there is no room in any of the three statements for support to be given.
college-writing-002000.zh: 在第三组中，三个陈述中都不存在需要被支持的余地。

college-writing-002001.en: For instance, “The speed limit near my home is sixty-five miles per hour” is too narrow to be expanded into a paper.
college-writing-002001.zh: 例如，“我家附近的限速是每小时65英里”这个表述太简短，无法在论文中进一步展开。

college-writing-002002.en: It is a simple fact that does not require any support.
college-writing-002002.zh: 这是一个不需要任何支持的简单事实。

college-writing-002003.en: Such a statement is sometimes called a dead-end statement: there is no place to go with it.
college-writing-002003.zh: 这种陈述有时被称为“死胡同陈述”：它没有可发展的方向。

college-writing-002004.en: Remember, a thesis statement must be broad enough to require support in an essay.
college-writing-002004.zh: 请记住，中心论点句的范围也要足够宽，值得用一篇文章来展开和论证。

college-writing-002005.en: Successful thesis statements based on the preceding sentences are as follows:
college-writing-002005.zh: 根据前面的句子写成的有效中心论点句如下：

college-writing-002006.en: The speed limit near my home should be lowered to fifty-five miles per hour for several reasons.
college-writing-002006.zh: 出于几个原因，我家附近的限速应该降低至55英里/小时。

college-writing-002007.en: Federal officials made a number of mistakes in their response to the recent Florida hurricane.
college-writing-002007.zh: 联邦官员在应对最近佛罗里达州的飓风时犯了一些错误。

college-writing-002008.en: The requirement that a U.S. president must be at least thirty-five years old is unfair and unreasonable.
college-writing-002008.zh: 要求美国总统必须至少35岁这一要求既不公平也不合理。

college-writing-002010.en: 4 Make Sure Statements Develop Only One Idea
college-writing-002010.zh: 4 确保陈述内容只发展一个想法

college-writing-002011.en: Here are three statements that contain more than one idea:
college-writing-002011.zh: 以下是三个包含多个观点的陈述：

college-writing-002012.en: One of the most serious problems affecting young people today is bullying, and it is time more kids learned the value of helping others.
college-writing-002012.zh: 当今影响年轻人的最严重问题之一是霸凌行为，是时候让更多孩子认识到帮助他人的重要性了。

college-writing-002013.en: Studying with others has several benefits, but it also has drawbacks and can be difficult to schedule.
college-writing-002013.zh: 与他人一起学习有诸多好处，但也存在缺点，且可能难以安排时间。

college-writing-002014.en: Teachers have played an important role in my life, but they were not as important as my parents.
college-writing-002014.zh: 老师在我的人生中扮演了重要的角色，但他们的地位不如我的父母。

college-writing-002015.en: In this fourth group, each statement contains more than one idea.
college-writing-002015.zh: 在这一组中，每个陈述都包含多个概念。

college-writing-002016.en: For instance, “One of the most serious problems affecting young people today is bullying, and it is time more kids learned the value of helping others” clearly has two separate ideas (“One of the most serious problems affecting young people today is bullying” and “it is time more kids learned the value of helping others”).
college-writing-002016.zh: 例如，“当今影响年轻人的最严重问题之一是霸凌行为，是时候让更多孩子了解帮助他人的意义了”这句话实际上包含了两个独立的观点（“当今影响年轻人的最严重问题之一是霸凌行为”以及“是时候让更多孩子了解帮助他人的意义了”）。

college-writing-002017.en: The reader is asked to focus on two separate points, each of which more logically belongs in an essay of its own.
college-writing-002017.zh: 读者被要求关注两个独立的要点，每个要点都更合乎逻辑地属于一篇独立的文章。

college-writing-002018.en: Remember, the point of an essay is to communicate a single main idea to readers.
college-writing-002018.zh: 记住，文章的目的是向读者传达一个核心观点。

college-writing-002019.en: To be as clear as possible, then, try to limit your thesis statement to the single key idea you want your readers to know.
college-writing-002019.zh: 为了尽可能清楚，请尝试把中心论点句限制在你希望读者了解的一个核心观点上。

college-writing-002020.en: Revised thesis statements based on each of the examples above are as follows:
college-writing-002020.zh: 基于上述每个例子的修订后的中心论点句如下：

college-writing-002021.en: One of the most serious problems affecting young people today is bullying.
college-writing-002021.zh: 当今影响年轻人的最严重问题之一是霸凌。

college-writing-002022.en: Studying with others has several benefits.
college-writing-002022.zh: 与他人一起学习有诸多好处。

college-writing-002023.en: Teachers have played an important role in my life.
college-writing-002023.zh: 教师在我的人生中扮演了重要的角色。

college-writing-002024.en: Write TN in the space next to the two statements that are too narrow to be developed in an essay.
college-writing-002024.zh: 在那些过于狭隘、无法在文章中展开的陈述旁边的空白处填写TN。

college-writing-002025.en: Write TB beside the two statements that are too broad to be covered in an essay.
college-writing-002025.zh: 在两条范围太宽、难以在一篇文章中展开的陈述旁标上 TB。

college-writing-002026.en: Then, in the spaces provided, revise one of the too-narrow statements and one of the too-broad statements to make them each an effective thesis.
college-writing-002026.zh: 然后，在给定的空间中，修改其中一句过于狭隘的表述和一句过于宽泛的表述，使其都成为有效的论点。

college-writing-002027.en: 1. The way our society treats elderly people is unbelievable.
college-writing-002027.zh: 我们社会对待老年人的方式令人难以置信。

college-writing-002028.en: 2. Enrollment at Freestone State College increased by 10 percent.
college-writing-002028.zh: 2. Freestone州立学院的入学人数增长了10%。

college-writing-002029.en: 3. California has much to offer the tourist.
college-writing-002029.zh: 3. 加利福尼亚州为游客提供了许多可体验的景点。

college-writing-002031.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 65
college-writing-002031.zh: 第三章 写作的第一步与第二步 65

college-writing-002033.en: Step 2: Support the Thesis with Specific Evidence
college-writing-002033.zh: 步骤2：用具体证据支持论点

college-writing-002034.en: The first essential step in writing a successful essay is to formulate a clearly stated thesis.
college-writing-002034.zh: 撰写成功的文章的首要步骤是提出明确清晰的论点。

college-writing-002035.en: The second basic step is to support the thesis with specific reasons or details.
college-writing-002035.zh: 第二个基本步骤是用具体的理由或细节来支撑论点。

college-writing-002036.en: To ensure that your essay will have adequate support, you may find an informal outline very helpful.
college-writing-002036.zh: 为了确保你的文章有足够的支撑，使用非正式的提纲可能会很有帮助。

college-writing-002037.en: Write down a brief version of your thesis idea, and then work out and jot down the three points that will support the thesis.
college-writing-002037.zh: 写下你论文观点的简要版本，然后列出支持该论文的三个要点。

college-writing-002038.en: Here is the scratch outline that was prepared by the author of the earlier essay on moviegoing:
college-writing-002038.zh: 以下是之前那篇关于观看电影的文章作者所准备的简要大纲：

college-writing-002043.en: A scratch outline like this one looks simple, but developing it often requires a great deal of careful thinking.
college-writing-002043.zh: 像这样的粗略轮廓看起来很简单，但将其发展完善却需要大量的仔细思考。

college-writing-002044.en: The time spent on developing a logical outline is invaluable, though.
college-writing-002044.zh: 不过，用于制定逻辑大纲所花费的时间非常宝贵。

college-writing-002045.en: Once you have planned the steps that logically support your thesis, you will be in an excellent position to go on to write an effective essay.
college-writing-002045.zh: 一旦你规划好了能够逻辑地支持你论点的步骤，你就能很好地撰写出一篇有效的文章。

college-writing-002046.en: Activities in this section will give you practice in the crucial skill of planning an essay clearly.
college-writing-002046.zh: 本部分的练习将帮助你掌握清晰规划文章这一关键技能。

college-writing-002047.zh: 以下是十个非正式的提纲。

college-writing-002048.en: Working with a partner, complete any five of them by adding a third logical supporting point
college-writing-002048.zh: 与合作伙伴合作，通过添加第三个合理的支持点来完成其中五项。

college-writing-002049.en: (c) that will parallel the two already provided (a and
college-writing-002049.zh: (c) 与已提供的两项内容保持一致（a和

college-writing-002051.en: 1. Difficulties of first day on job

college-writing-002055.en: Finding your way around a new place
college-writing-002055.zh: 在新的环境中找到方向

college-writing-002067.en: 3. Advantages of summer job on landscaping crew
college-writing-002067.zh: 3. 从事景观美化工作的夏季工作的优势

college-writing-002071.zh: 值得为之工作的优秀人物

college-writing-002073.en: 4. Living at home while in college

college-writing-002077.en: Avoid distractions of dorm or apartment life
college-writing-002077.zh: 避免宿舍或公寓生活带来的干扰

college-writing-002079.zh: 5. 布辛的表格工作是最糟糕的

college-writing-002091.en: 7. My excellent high school algebra teacher
college-writing-002091.zh: 7. 我那优秀的高中代数老师

college-writing-002095.zh: 非常适合用于考试的练习资料

college-writing-002097.en: 8. College library best place to study
college-writing-002097.zh: 8. 大学图书馆是学习的最佳场所

college-writing-002101.en: Nothing to tempt me away from my books
college-writing-002101.zh: 没有任何东西能让我远离我的书籍

college-writing-002103.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 67
college-writing-002103.zh: 第三章 写作的第一步与第二步 67

college-writing-002106.en: Less likely to be stolen than new cars
college-writing-002106.zh: 相比新车，它们被偷窃的可能性更低

college-writing-002108.en: Don’t lose their value as quickly as most new cars
college-writing-002108.zh: 不要像大多数新车那样迅速失去其价值

college-writing-002110.en: 10. Companies’ annoying practices to increase sales
college-writing-002110.zh: 10. 为增加销售额而采取的令人恼火的行为

college-writing-002116.en: The Importance of Specific Details Just as a thesis must be developed with at least three supporting points, each supporting point must be developed with specific details.
college-writing-002116.zh: 具体细节的重要性：正如论点必须包含至少三个支撑点一样，每个支撑点也必须用具体细节来加以阐述。

college-writing-002117.en: Specific details are valuable in two key ways.
college-writing-002117.zh: 具体细节在两个方面具有价值。

college-writing-002118.en: First, details excite the reader’s interest.
college-writing-002118.zh: 首先，细节能够激发读者的兴趣。

college-writing-002119.en: They make writing a pleasure to read, for we all enjoy learning particulars about people, places, and things.
college-writing-002119.zh: 它们让阅读变得充满乐趣，因为我们都喜欢了解关于人、地点和事物的细节。

college-writing-002120.en: Second, details serve to explain a writer’s points.
college-writing-002120.zh: 其次，细节有助于阐明作者的观点。

college-writing-002121.en: They give the evidence needed for us to see and understand general ideas.
college-writing-002121.zh: 它们提供了我们理解一般概念所需的证据。

college-writing-002122.en: All too often, the body paragraphs in essays contain only vague generalities, rather than the specific supporting details that are needed to engage and convince a reader.
college-writing-002122.zh: 在文章中，背景段落往往只包含模糊的泛泛之谈，而非能够吸引读者并说服他们的具体支撑细节。

college-writing-002123.en: Here is what one of the paragraphs in “The Hazards of Moviegoing” would have looked like if the writer had not detailed her supporting evidence vividly:
college-writing-002123.zh: 如果作者没有把支撑论点的证据写得生动具体，《看电影的烦恼》里有一段就可能写成下面这样：

college-writing-002124.en: Some of the other patrons are even more of a problem than the theater itself.
college-writing-002124.zh: 其他一些观众比剧院本身更成问题。

college-writing-002125.en: Many people in the theater often show themselves to be inconsiderate.
college-writing-002125.zh: 剧院里的许多人常常表现得不考虑他人。

college-writing-002126.en: They make noises and create disturbances at their seats.
college-writing-002126.zh: 他们在座位上发出噪音，造成干扰。

college-writing-002127.en: Included are people in every age group, from the young to the old.
college-writing-002127.zh: 包括各个年龄段的人，从年轻到年老都有。

college-writing-002128.en: Some act as if they were at home in their own living room watching TV.
college-writing-002128.zh: 有些人表现得就像在自己客厅里看电视一样。

college-writing-002129.en: And people are often messy, so that you’re constantly aware of all the food they’re eating.
college-writing-002129.zh: 而且人们往往行为邋遢，因此你总是能注意到他们吃的所有食物。

college-writing-002130.en: People are also always moving around near you, creating a disturbance and interrupting your enjoyment of the movie.
college-writing-002130.zh: 人们也总是在你附近走动，造成干扰，影响你观看电影的体验。

college-writing-002131.en: The following box contrasts the vague support in the preceding paragraph with the specific support in the essay.
college-writing-002131.zh: 下面的框面将前一段的模糊支持与文章中的具体支持进行了对比。

college-writing-002133.en: The effective paragraph from the essay provides details that make vividly clear the statement that patrons are a problem in the theater.
college-writing-002133.zh: 文章中的有效段落提供了细节，清晰生动地说明了观众是剧院的麻烦所在这一观点。

college-writing-002134.en: The writer specifies the exact age groups (little kids, teenagers, and adults) and the offenses of each (giggling, talking and whistling, and loud comments).
college-writing-002134.zh: 作者具体指出了各个年龄组（小孩、青少年和成人）以及相应的违规行为（笑闹、说话和吹口哨、大声评论）。

college-writing-002135.en: She specifies the various food excesses (tacky remnants of candy, gum on seats, dropped popcorn and soda containers).
college-writing-002135.zh: 她指出了各种食物浪费现象（糖果的碎屑、座位上的口香糖、掉落的爆米花和汽水容器）。

college-writing-002136.en: Finally, she provides concrete details that enable us to see and hear other disturbances (coughs and burps, squirming, constant trips to restrooms, jostling for elbow room).
college-writing-002136.zh: 最后，她提供了具体的细节，让我们能够看到和听到其他异常行为（咳嗽、打嗝、扭动身体、频繁前往洗手间、争抢空间）。

college-writing-002137.en: The ineffective paragraph asks us to guess about these details; the effective paragraph describes the details in a specific and lively way.
college-writing-002137.zh: 无效的段落让我们去猜测这些细节；有效的段落则以具体且生动的方式描述这些细节。

college-writing-002138.en: In the strong paragraph, then, sharp details capture our interest and enable us to share the writer’s experience.
college-writing-002138.zh: 因此，在有力的段落中，清晰的细节能够吸引我们的兴趣，并让我们能够理解作者的经历。

college-writing-002139.en: They provide pictures that make us feel we are there.
college-writing-002139.zh: 它们呈现的画面让我们仿佛身在其处。

college-writing-002140.en: The particulars also enable us to understand clearly the writer’s point that patrons are a problem.
college-writing-002140.zh: 这些细节也让我们能够清楚地理解作者所说的“顾客是个问题”这一观点。

college-writing-002141.en: Aim to make your own writing equally convincing by providing detailed support.
college-writing-002141.zh: 通过提供详细的支持，使你的写作同样具有说服力。

college-writing-002142.zh: 模糊支持 具体支持 1.

college-writing-002144.en: ater show themselves to be inconsiderate.
college-writing-002144.zh: 他们表现得十分不顾及他人。

college-writing-002145.en: They make noises and create disturbances at their seats.
college-writing-002145.zh: 他们在座位上发出噪音，造成干扰。

college-writing-002146.en: Included are people in every age group, from the young to the old.
college-writing-002146.zh: 包括各个年龄段的人，从年轻到年老都有。

college-writing-002147.en: Some act as if they were at home in their own living room watching TV.
college-writing-002147.zh: 有些人表现得就像在自己客厅里看电视一样。

college-writing-002148.en: 1. Little kids race up and down the
college-writing-002148.zh: 小孩子们在上下奔跑着

college-writing-002149.zh: 他们通常成群结队地笑着。

college-writing-002150.en: Teenagers try to impress their friends by talking back to the screen, whistling, and making what they consider to be hilarious noises.
college-writing-002150.zh: 青少年试图通过对着屏幕回嘴、吹口哨以及发出他们认为有趣的噪音来给朋友留下深刻印象。

college-writing-002151.en: Adults act as if they were at home in their own living room and comment loudly on the ages of the stars or why movies aren’t as good anymore.
college-writing-002151.zh: 成年人们表现得就像在自己家的客厅里一样，大声评论星星的年龄，或者为什么电影不再那么好了。

college-writing-002153.en: messy, so that you’re constantly aware of all the food they’re eating.
college-writing-002153.zh: 杂乱无章，因此你会时刻注意到他们正在吃的所有食物。

college-writing-002154.en: 2. And people of all ages leave tacky
college-writing-002154.zh: 2. 各个年龄段的人都会留下粘性物质

college-writing-002155.en: remnants of candy on the hand rests, stick gum on their seats, and drop popcorn tubs or cups of crushed ice and soda on the floor.
college-writing-002155.zh: 手上还残留着糖果碎屑，座位上放着口香糖，地板上则放着爆米花容器或装有碎冰与苏打水的杯子。

college-writing-002157.en: moving around near you, creating a disturbance and interrupting your enjoyment of the movie.
college-writing-002157.zh: 在你附近移动，造成干扰，打断你观看电影的体验。

college-writing-002158.en: 3. They also cough and burp, squirm
college-writing-002158.zh: 3. 他们还会咳嗽、打嗝，还会扭动身体。

college-writing-002159.en: endlessly in their seats, file out for repeated trips to the restrooms or concession stand, and elbow you out of the armrest on either side of your seat.
college-writing-002159.zh: 他们一直坐在座位上，频繁地前往洗手间或小吃摊，还用肘部挤开你座位两侧的扶手。

college-writing-002160.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 69
college-writing-002160.zh: 第三章 写作的第一和第二步 69

college-writing-002161.en: Write S in front of the two selections below that provide specific evidence to support the opening point.
college-writing-002161.zh: 在以下两项选择之前加上“S”，这些选择提供了支持开篇观点的具体证据。

college-writing-002162.en: Write X in front of the two selections in which the opening point is followed by vague, general, wordy sentences.
college-writing-002162.zh: 在那些起始点之后出现模糊、笼统、冗长句子的两个选项前面，写上 X。

college-writing-002163.en: 1. The tree house my father and I built was a masterpiece.
college-writing-002163.zh: 我和父亲一起建造的树屋堪称杰作。

college-writing-002164.en: It had three floors, each of which was about seventy-five square feet.
college-writing-002164.zh: 它有三层，每层约七十五平方英尺。

college-writing-002165.en: There were two windows made of real glass on each floor, allowing sunlight to flood in and making the place pleasant and cheerful.
college-writing-002165.zh: 每层都有两扇由真玻璃制成的窗户，让阳光照进室内，使环境显得舒适而愉悦。

college-writing-002166.en: The walls were made of sweet-smelling cedar planks Dad and I salvaged from a landfill.
college-writing-002166.zh: 这些墙壁由我父亲和我在垃圾填埋场里捡来的芳香雪松木板制成。

college-writing-002167.en: On the bottom floor was a small cast-iron stove, which gave off enough heat to keep us toasty on the coldest winter day.
college-writing-002167.zh: 底层有一个小铸铁炉，它产生的热量足以让我们在最寒冷的冬日里保持温暖。

college-writing-002168.en: The second floor had an old rocking chair on which I read my favorite comics every summer afternoon.
college-writing-002168.zh: 二楼有一把旧摇椅，每年夏天午后我都会坐在上面阅读我最喜欢的漫画。

college-writing-002169.en: On the top floor, Dad had set up a telescope from which we observed the glories of the night sky.
college-writing-002169.zh: 在顶层，父亲放置了一台望远镜，我们便通过它欣赏夜空的壮丽景象。

college-writing-002170.en: 2. Our first camping trip in Keystone State Forest was
college-writing-002170.zh: 2. 我们在基斯通州森林的第一次露营之旅是

college-writing-002172.en: Many of the animals we had hoped to see on our walk just weren’t there.
college-writing-002172.zh: 我们原本希望在散步时看到的许多动物其实并不在。

college-writing-002173.en: Some smaller animals were, but we had seen them before in our backyards.
college-writing-002173.zh: 有些较小的动物存在，但我们在后院见过它们。

college-writing-002175.en: It was not what we had expected.

college-writing-002177.en: It was dreadful for most of our stay.
college-writing-002177.zh: 我们待在那里的大部分时间都很糟糕。

college-writing-002179.en: We had planned for the trip well, spending a lot of money on provisions and special equipment, but much of it was a waste because we left much earlier than we had intended.
college-writing-002179.zh: 我们为这次旅行做了周密的计划，在物资和专用设备方面投入了大量资金，但大部分都浪费了，因为我们出发的时间比预期要早得多。

college-writing-002180.en: We came home frustrated and soured on the whole idea of camping.
college-writing-002180.zh: 我们回到家时感到沮丧，对露营这个想法也失去了兴趣。

college-writing-002181.en: 3. Some things are worse when they’re “improved.”
college-writing-002181.zh: 3. 有些事情在“改进”之后反而更糟糕了。

college-writing-002182.en: A good cheesecake, for one thing, is perfect.
college-writing-002182.zh: 首先，一份好的芝士蛋糕是完美的。

college-writing-002183.en: It doesn’t need pineapple, cherries, blueberries, or whipped cream smeared all over it.
college-writing-002183.zh: 不需要菠萝、樱桃、蓝莓，也不需要涂满鲜奶油。

college-writing-002184.en: Plain old American blue jeans, the ones with five pockets and copper rivets, are perfect too.
college-writing-002184.zh: 传统的美式蓝色牛仔裤，那种有五个口袋且带有铜铆钉的款式也非常完美。

college-writing-002185.en: Manufacturers only made them worse when they added flared legs, took away the pockets, tightened the fit, and plastered white logos and designers’ names all over them.
college-writing-002185.zh: 制造商只是通过增加喇叭形腿、取消口袋设计、收紧贴合度，以及在产品上粘贴白色标志和设计师名字，让产品变得更差了。

college-writing-002186.en: 4. Pets can be more trouble than children.
college-writing-002186.zh: 4. 宠物可能会比孩子更麻烦。

college-writing-002187.en: My dog, unlike my children, has never been completely housebroken.
college-writing-002187.zh: 与我的孩子不同，我的狗从未完全学会在家中行为得体。

college-writing-002188.en: When he’s excited or nervous, he still has an occasional problem.
college-writing-002188.zh: 当他兴奋或紧张时，仍会偶尔出现问题。

college-writing-002189.en: My dog, unlike my children, has never learned how to take care of himself when we’re away, despite the fact that we’ve
college-writing-002189.zh: 我的狗与我的孩子不同，即使我们在时不在，它也从未学会自己照顾自己，尽管我们一直……

college-writing-002192.en: given him plenty of time to do so.
college-writing-002192.zh: 他拥有足够的时间来做到这一点。

college-writing-002193.en: We don’t have to worry about our grown children anymore.
college-writing-002193.zh: 我们不必再担心我们的成年子女了。

college-writing-002194.en: However, we still have to hire a dog-sitter.
college-writing-002194.zh: 不过，我们仍然需要雇一个照顾狗的人。

college-writing-002195.en: The Importance of Adequate Details One of the most common and most serious problems in students’ writing is inadequate development.
college-writing-002195.zh: 充分细节的重要性 学生写作中最常见且最严重的问题之一，就是内容缺乏充分展开。

college-writing-002196.en: You must provide enough specific details to fully support the point in a body paragraph of an essay.
college-writing-002196.zh: 在文章的段落中，你必须提供足够具体的细节来充分支持你的观点。

college-writing-002197.en: You could not, for example, include a paragraph about a friend’s unreliability and provide only a one- or two-sentence example.
college-writing-002197.zh: 例如，你不能包含一段关于朋友不可靠性的内容，而只提供一两句话的例子。

college-writing-002198.en: You would have to extend the example or add several other examples showing your friend as an unreliable person.
college-writing-002198.zh: 你可能需要扩展这个例子，或者添加几个其他例子来表明你的朋友是个不可靠的人。

college-writing-002199.en: Without such additional support, your paragraph would be underdeveloped.
college-writing-002199.zh: 没有这种额外的支持，你的段落就会发展不足。

college-writing-002200.en: Students may try to disguise unsupported paragraphs through repetition and generalities.
college-writing-002200.zh: 学生可能会通过重复和泛泛而试图掩饰那些没有依据的段落。

college-writing-002201.en: Do not fall into this “wordiness trap.”
college-writing-002201.zh: 不要陷入这种“冗长陷阱”中。

college-writing-002202.en: Be prepared to do the plain hard work needed to ensure that each paragraph has solid support.
college-writing-002202.zh: 做好准备，付出必要的努力，确保每段都有扎实的支撑。

college-writing-002203.en: Both of the following body paragraphs were written on the same topic, and each has a clear opening point.
college-writing-002203.zh: 以下两个正文段落都是关于同一个主题撰写的，每篇都有明确的开头点。

college-writing-002204.zh: 哪一段得到了充分发展？

college-writing-002205.en: Which one has only several particulars and uses mostly vague, general, wordy sentences to conceal that it is starved for specific details?
college-writing-002205.zh: 哪一个只有少数具体细节，却使用模糊、笼统、冗长的句子来掩盖其缺乏具体细节的缺陷？

college-writing-002209.en: I wouldn’t want to be a teenager again, first of all, because I wouldn’t want to worry about talking to girls.
college-writing-002209.zh: 我不想再成为青少年了，首先是因为我不想再为和女孩交谈而烦恼。

college-writing-002210.en: I still remember how scary it was to call up a girl and ask her out.
college-writing-002210.zh: 我仍记得给一个女孩打电话约她出去有多可怕。

college-writing-002211.en: My heart would race, my pulse would pound, and perspiration would trickle down my face, adding to my acne by the second.
college-writing-002211.zh: 我的心脏剧烈跳动，脉搏急促，汗水从脸上流下，进一步加剧了我的痤疮。

college-writing-002212.en: I never knew whether my voice would come out sounding calm and confident or nervous and shaky.
college-writing-002212.zh: 我从未想过，我的声音会听起来平静自信，还是紧张颤抖。

college-writing-002213.en: Then there were the questions: Would she be at home?
college-writing-002213.zh: 接着出现了几个问题：她会在家吗？

college-writing-002214.en: If she was, would she want to talk to me?
college-writing-002214.zh: 如果她是，她会想和我说话吗？

college-writing-002215.en: And if she did, what would I say?
college-writing-002215.zh: 如果她真的这么做了，我会说些什么呢？

college-writing-002216.en: The one time I did get up the nerve to take a girl in my homeroom to a movie, I was so tongue-tied that I stared silently at the box of popcorn in my lap until the feature finally started.
college-writing-002216.zh: 有那么一次，我鼓起勇气带班上的某个女生去看电影，但我实在说不出话，只是默默地盯着放在脚边的爆米花，直到电影开始播放。

college-writing-002217.en: Needless to say, I wasn’t very interesting company.
college-writing-002217.zh: 不用说，我并不是个很有趣的公司。

college-writing-002218.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 71
college-writing-002218.zh: 第三章 写作的第一和第二步 71

college-writing-002219.en: The first paragraph offers a series of well-detailed examples of the author’s nerve-racking experiences, as a teenager, with girls.
college-writing-002219.zh: 第一段详细列举了作者作为青少年与女孩相处时那些令人紧张的经历。

college-writing-002220.en: The second paragraph, on the other hand, is underdeveloped.
college-writing-002220.zh: 另一方面，第二段发展得不够充分。

college-writing-002221.en: For instance, the second paragraph makes only the general observation “I would have all the symptoms of nervousness when I got on the phone,” but the first paragraph states, “My heart would race, my pulse would pound, and perspiration would trickle down my face.”
college-writing-002221.zh: 例如，第二段只是提出了一般的观察结果：“当我接起电话时，我会出现所有紧张的征兆”，而第一段则指出：“我的心跳会加快，脉搏也会剧烈跳动，汗水会顺着我的脸颊流下。”

college-writing-002222.en: The second paragraph makes the general statement “I worried a great deal about how I would sound,” but in the first paragraph the author wonders if their voice will “come out sounding calm and confident or nervous and shaky.”
college-writing-002222.zh: 第二段中提出了这样的总体观点：“我非常担心自己的声音会如何听起来”，而在第一段中，作者则思考着他们的声音会“听起来是平静而自信的，还是紧张且颤抖的”。

college-writing-002223.en: And the second paragraph has no specific description of the evening that turned into a disaster.
college-writing-002223.zh: 第二段没有对那个变成灾难的夜晚进行具体描述。

college-writing-002224.en: In summary, the second paragraph lacks the full, detailed support needed to develop its opening point convincingly.
college-writing-002224.zh: 总结来说，第二段缺乏足够的、详细的支持来有效阐述其开头观点。

college-writing-002225.en: Write a paragraph supporting one of the following points:
college-writing-002225.zh: 写一段支持以下其中一点观点的内容：

college-writing-002227.en: 2. My college offers a variety of student activities.
college-writing-002227.zh: 2. 我的大学提供各种学生活动。

college-writing-002228.zh: 3. 我们的城市拥有令人惊叹的公园。

college-writing-002229.en: 4. Trader Joe’s (or Whole Foods; or My local grocery store) has the best groceries in town.
college-writing-002229.zh: 4. Trader Joe’s（或Whole Foods，或当地的杂货店）有城里最棒的食品杂货。

college-writing-002230.en: Afterward, consider reading your paragraph to a small group of classmates.
college-writing-002230.zh: 之后，可以试着把你的段落读给一小群同学听。

college-writing-002231.en: The best paragraphs are sure to be those with plenty of specific details.
college-writing-002231.zh: 最优秀的段落一定是那些包含大量具体细节的段落。

college-writing-002233.zh: 我青少年时期的恐惧与困扰

college-writing-002234.en: I wouldn’t want to be a teenager again, first of all, because I wouldn’t want to worry about talking to girls.
college-writing-002234.zh: 我不想再成为青少年了，首先是因为我不想再为和女孩交谈而烦恼。

college-writing-002235.en: Calling up a girl to ask her out was something that I completely dreaded.
college-writing-002235.zh: 约一个女孩出来见面，是我极其害怕的事情。

college-writing-002236.en: I didn’t know what words to express or how to express them.
college-writing-002236.zh: 我不知道用什么词来表达，也不知道如何表达。

college-writing-002237.en: I would have all the symptoms of nervousness when I got on the phone.
college-writing-002237.zh: 我打电话时会有所有焦虑的症状。

college-writing-002238.en: I worried a great deal about how I would sound, and I had a lot of doubts about the girl’s reaction.
college-writing-002238.zh: 我非常担心自己的说话方式会如何，对那个女孩的反应也心存许多疑虑。

college-writing-002239.en: Once, I managed to call up a girl to go out, but the evening turned out to be a disaster.
college-writing-002239.zh: 有一次，我成功约了一个女孩出去，但那晚最终变成了一场灾难。

college-writing-002240.en: I was too unsure of myself to act in a confident way.
college-writing-002240.zh: 我对自己的信心不足，无法以自信的态度行事。

college-writing-002241.en: I couldn’t think of anything to say and just kept quiet.
college-writing-002241.zh: 我想不出该说什么，就保持沉默。

college-writing-002242.en: Now that I look back on it, I really made a fool of myself.
college-writing-002242.zh: 现在回看起来，我真的自作自演了。

college-writing-002243.en: Agonizing over my attempts at relationships made adolescence a very uncomfortable time.
college-writing-002243.zh: 那些失败的恋爱尝试让青春期变得非常令人不适。

college-writing-002245.en: Practice in Advancing and Supporting a Thesis Identifying the Parts of an Essay Each cluster below contains one topic, one thesis statement, and two supporting sentences.
college-writing-002245.zh: 练习提出并论证中心论点。辨认文章的各个部分：下面每组包含一个主题、一个中心论点句和两个支撑句。

college-writing-002246.en: In the space provided, label each item as follows: ACTIVITY 8
college-writing-002246.zh: 在提供的空间中，按如下方式标注每个项目：活动8

college-writing-002247.zh: T 表示主题，TH 表示中心论点句，S 表示支撑句。

college-writing-002249.en: a. Films based on historical events are sometimes shown in class.
college-writing-002249.zh: a. 基于历史事件的电影有时会在课堂上播放。

college-writing-002251.en: c. Some history teachers use innovative methods to increase student
college-writing-002251.zh: c. 一些历史教师采用创新方法来提升学生

college-writing-002254.en: Instructors ask students to write short plays dramatizing historical
college-writing-002254.zh: 讲师要求学生撰写以历史为题材的短剧

college-writing-002258.en: b. Staying away from meat can reduce intake of fat and cholesterol.
college-writing-002258.zh: b. 远离肉类摄入可以减少脂肪和胆固醇的摄取。

college-writing-002259.en: c. Eating vegetables helps the environment because raising veggies
college-writing-002259.zh: c. 吃蔬菜有助于环境，因为种植蔬菜

college-writing-002260.en: uses less energy than raising animals.
college-writing-002260.zh: 比饲养动物所需的能量更少。

college-writing-002262.en: Vegetarianism benefits both the individual and the environment.
college-writing-002262.zh: 素食主义既有利于个人，也有利于环境。

college-writing-002265.en: b. Antibiotics have enabled doctors to control many diseases that
college-writing-002265.zh: b. 抗生素让医生能够控制许多疾病。

college-writing-002268.en: Organ transplants have prolonged the lives of tens of thousands of
college-writing-002268.zh: 器官移植让数万人的生命得以延长

college-writing-002271.en: Advances in modern medicine have had great success in helping b. Parents can take steps to encourage their children to enjoy
college-writing-002271.zh: 现代医学的进步在帮助父母方面取得了巨大成就。父母可以采取措施鼓励孩子享受生活。

college-writing-002273.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 73
college-writing-002273.zh: 第三章 写作的第一和第二步 73

college-writing-002279.en: The adults’ own behavior can influence children to become
college-writing-002279.zh: 成年人自身的行为能够影响儿童的发展

college-writing-002282.en: Parents can make sure the physical environment of the home
college-writing-002282.zh: 父母可以确保家庭的物理环境良好

college-writing-002285.en: a. Insects perform many helpful functions for human beings.
college-writing-002285.zh: a. 昆虫为人类提供了许多有用的功能。

college-writing-002286.en: b. Insects are essential to the growth of many important crops.
college-writing-002286.zh: b. 昆虫对许多重要作物的生长至关重要。

college-writing-002288.en: d. Insects protect the environment by removing wastes and controlling
college-writing-002288.zh: d. 昆虫通过清除废物和控制污染来保护环境

college-writing-002290.en: This activity will sharpen your sense of the parts of an essay.
college-writing-002290.zh: 这项活动将帮助你更敏锐地感知文章的各个部分。

college-writing-002291.en: The essay that follows, “Coping with the Challenges of Elderhood,” has no indentations starting new paragraphs.
college-writing-002291.zh: 接下来的文章《应对老年时期的挑战》没有新段落的缩进。

college-writing-002292.en: Read this essay carefully, and then double-underline the thesis and single-underline the topic sentence for each of the three supporting paragraphs and the first sentence of the conclusion.
college-writing-002292.zh: 仔细阅读这篇文章，然后为三个支持段落中的每篇以及结论的第一句话的论点部分画双线，主题句部分画单线。

college-writing-002296.en: 1I recently read about an area of the former Soviet Union where many people live to be well over a hundred years old.
college-writing-002296.zh: 我最近读到过前苏联的一个地区，那里有许多人活到一百多岁。

college-writing-002297.en: 2 Being 115 or even 125 isn’t considered unusual there, and these old people continue to do productive work right up until they die.
college-writing-002297.zh: 2. 115 甚至 125 在那里并不罕见，这些老年人继续从事富有成效的工作，直到他们死去。

college-writing-002298.en: 3 The United States, however, isn’t such a healthy place for older people.
college-writing-002298.zh: 3. 然而，美国对老年人来说并不是一个健康的地方。

college-writing-002299.en: 4 Since I retired from my job, I’ve had to cope with the physical, mental, and emotional stresses of being “old.” 5For one thing, I’ve had to adjust to physical changes.
college-writing-002299.zh: 4. 自从我退休后，我不得不应对“老”的身体、精神和情感压力。 5一方面，我不得不适应身体变化。

college-writing-002300.en: 6 Now that I’m over seventy-five, the trusty body that carried me around for years has turned traitor.
college-writing-002300.zh: 6. 现在我已经七十五岁了，那个带着我多年的可信赖的身体已经变成了叛徒。

college-writing-002301.en: 7 Aside from the deepening wrinkles on my face and neck, and the wiry gray hairs that have replaced my brown hair, I face more frightening changes.
college-writing-002301.zh: 7. 除了我脸上和脖子上的皱纹加深，以及取代我棕色头发的结实的灰色头发外，我面临着更可怕的变化。

college-writing-002302.en: 8I don’t have the energy I used to.
college-writing-002302.zh: 我没有以前那么有精力了。

college-writing-002313.en: Others write a dead-end thesis statement that is too narrow to need support or development.
college-writing-002313.zh: 还有些人写出的中心论点句过于狭窄，根本无需论证或展开，因而无法继续写下去。

college-writing-002315.en: something that’s said to me. 11My once faithful feet seem to have lost their comfortable soles, and I sometimes feel I’m walking on marbles.
college-writing-002315.zh: 有人对我说过这样的话。我曾经忠诚的双脚似乎已经失去了舒适感，有时感觉自己就像在踩着 marbles一样。

college-writing-002316.en: 12In order to fight against this slow decay, I exercise whenever I can.
college-writing-002316.zh: 12为了对抗这种缓慢的衰退，我会尽可能经常进行锻炼。

college-writing-002317.en: 13I walk, I stretch, and I climb stairs.

college-writing-002318.zh: 14I 不断努力以保持最佳状态。

college-writing-002319.zh: 15 我也在努力应对心理上的变化。

college-writing-002320.en: 16My mind was once as quick and sure as a champion gymnast.
college-writing-002320.zh: 16我的思维曾经像一位杰出的体操运动员那样敏捷且精准。

college-writing-002321.en: 17I never found it difficult to memorize answers in school or to remember the names of people I met.
college-writing-002321.zh: 17在学校里，我从未觉得记忆答案或记住所遇到人的名字有什么困难。

college-writing-002322.en: 18 Now, I occasionally have to search my mind for the name of a close neighbor or favorite television show.
college-writing-002322.zh: 18. 现在，我偶尔不得不在我的脑海中寻找一个近邻或最喜欢的电视节目的名字。

college-writing-002323.en: 19 Because my mind needs exercise, too, I challenge it as much as I can.
college-writing-002323.zh: 19. 因为我的思想也需要锻炼，所以我尽可能多地挑战它。

college-writing-002324.en: 20 Taking a college course like this English class, for example, forces me to concentrate.
college-writing-002324.zh: 20. 例如，参加像这个英语课这样的大学课程迫使我集中注意力。

college-writing-002325.en: 21 The mental gymnast may be a little slow and out of shape, but he can still do a backflip or turn a somersault when he has to.
college-writing-002325.zh: 21. 心理体操运动员可能有点缓慢和变形，但他仍然可以在必要时进行后空翻或转动翻筋斗。

college-writing-002326.en: 22 Finally, I must deal with the emotional impact of being old.
college-writing-002326.zh: 22. 最后，我必须处理老年人的情感影响。

college-writing-002327.zh: 23. 我们的社会类型转换老人。

college-writing-002328.en: 24We’re supposed to be unattractive, senile, useless leftovers.
college-writing-002328.zh: 我们应该被视作毫无吸引力、老朽无用、被抛弃的残骸。

college-writing-002329.en: 25We’re supposed to be the crazy drivers and the cranky customers.
college-writing-002329.zh: 25我们应该是那些疯狂的司机和情绪暴躁的顾客。

college-writing-002330.en: 26At first, I was angry and frustrated that I was considered old at all.
college-writing-002330.zh: 26起初，我感到愤怒和沮丧，因为人们认为我年纪太大了。

college-writing-002331.en: 27 And I knew that people were wrong to stereotype me.
college-writing-002331.zh: 27. 我知道人们对我的刻板印象是错误的。

college-writing-002332.en: 29I even started to think that maybe I was a castoff, one of those old animals that slow down the rest of the herd.
college-writing-002332.zh: 29I 甚至开始觉得，也许自己是个被抛弃的人，是那些让整个群体行动变慢的旧动物之一。

college-writing-002333.en: 30 But I have now decided to rebel against these negative feelings.
college-writing-002333.zh: 30. 但我现在决定反抗这些负面情绪。

college-writing-002334.en: 31I try to have friends of all ages and to keep up with what’s going on in the world.
college-writing-002334.zh: 我努力结交各个年龄段的朋友，并关注世界上的最新动态。

college-writing-002335.en: 32I try to remember that I’m still the same person who sat at a first-grade desk, who fell in love, who comforted a child, who got a raise at work.
college-writing-002335.zh: 我努力记住，自己仍然是那个坐在一年级教室里的那个人，那个曾经坠入爱河的人，那个能够安慰孩子的那个人，那个在工作中获得加薪的人。

college-writing-002337.en: 34 Coping with the changes of old age has become my latest full-time job.
college-writing-002337.zh: 34. 应对老年的变化已成为我最新的全职工作。

college-writing-002338.en: 35 Even though it’s a job I never applied for, and one for which I had no experience, I’m trying to do the best I can.
college-writing-002338.zh: 35. 尽管这是一份我从未申请过的工作，也是我没有经验的工作，但我正在尽力做到最好。

college-writing-002525.en: Limiting a Topic and Writing a Thesis Statement The following two activities will give you practice in distinguishing general from limited subjects and in writing a thesis.
college-writing-002525.zh: 限定主题与撰写中心论点句。以下两个练习将帮助你掌握如何区分一般性与特定性主题，以及如何撰写论点。

college-writing-002527.zh: 然后为其中任意五个有限主题撰写一个中心论点句。

college-writing-002529.en: To create a thesis statement for a limited subject, ask yourself, What point do I want to make about (my limited subject)?

college-writing-002572.en: Providing Specific Evidence Provide three details that logically support each of the following points.
college-writing-002572.zh: 提供具体证据：提供三个细节，以逻辑上支持以下各点。

college-writing-002573.en: Your details can be drawn from your own experience, or they can be invented.
college-writing-002573.zh: 你的信息可以来自你的亲身经历，也可以被编造出来。

college-writing-002574.en: In each case, the details should show specifically what the point expresses only generally.
college-writing-002574.zh: 在每种情况下，细节应具体说明该观点只是笼统地表达了什么。

college-writing-002575.en: State your details briefly in several words rather than in complete sentences.
college-writing-002575.zh: 用几个词而不是完整的句子来简要说明您的详细信息。

college-writing-002578.en: example We quickly spruced up the apartment before our guest arrived.
college-writing-002578.zh: 例如，在客人到来之前，我们迅速整理了公寓。

college-writing-002579.en: 1. Hid toys and newspapers in spare closet
college-writing-002579.zh: 1. 把玩具和报纸放在闲置的储物柜里

college-writing-002580.zh: 2. 用真空装置清除沙发上的宠物毛发

college-writing-002581.en: 3. Sprayed air freshener around living room
college-writing-002581.zh: 3. 在客厅周围喷洒空气清新剂

college-writing-002582.en: 1. The hike up to the mountain lookout was exciting.
college-writing-002582.zh: 1. 向上攀登到山上的观景台过程非常令人兴奋。

college-writing-002584.en: 3. There are several reasons why I put off studying.
college-writing-002584.zh: 3. 我拖延学习的原因有很多。

college-writing-002585.en: 4. Working at the hospital has taught me many valuable skills.
college-writing-002585.zh: 在医院工作让我获得了许多宝贵的技能。

college-writing-002586.en: 5. I have several ways to earn extra cash.
college-writing-002586.zh: 5. 我有几种方法可以赚取额外收入。

college-writing-002590.en: 7. Friday evening, I didn’t sit still for a minute.
college-writing-002590.zh: 7. 周五晚上，我一刻钟都没能安静地坐着。

college-writing-002591.en: 8. My best friends are very different, but I love each of them.
college-writing-002591.zh: 8. 我的好朋友们各不相同，但我爱她们每一个人。

college-writing-002592.en: Identifying Adequate Supporting Evidence The following body paragraphs were taken from student essays.
college-writing-002592.zh: 辨认充分的论据：下面的正文段落选自学生作文。

college-writing-002593.en: Two of the paragraphs provide sufficient details to support their topic sentences convincingly.
college-writing-002593.zh: 其中两段提供了足够的细节，以有说服力地支持他们的主题句。

college-writing-002594.en: Write AD for adequate development beside those paragraphs.
college-writing-002594.zh: 在那些段落之外，再写一段关于充分发展的AD。

college-writing-002595.en: Three paragraphs use vague, wordy, general, or irrelevant sentences instead of real supporting details.
college-writing-002595.zh: 三个段落使用了模糊、冗长、笼统或无关的句子，而非真实的支撑细节。

college-writing-002596.en: Write U for underdeveloped beside those paragraphs.
college-writing-002596.zh: 在那些段落之后，也请写一下“U”吧。

college-writing-002597.en: 1. Another consideration in adopting a dog is the cost.
college-writing-002597.zh: 采用狗作为宠物时，另一个需要考虑的因素是成本。

college-writing-002598.en: Initial fees for shots and a license might add up to $100.
college-writing-002598.zh: 拍摄和许可的初始费用可能高达100美元。

college-writing-002599.en: Annual visits to the vet for heartworm pills, rabies and distemper shots, and general checkups could cost $200 or more.
college-writing-002599.zh: 每年去兽医处接种心丝虫药、狂犬病和犬瘟热疫苗以及进行常规检查，费用可能达到200美元或更多。

college-writing-002600.en: Then there is the cost of food.

college-writing-002601.en: A twenty-five-pound bag of dry food (the cheapest kind) costs around $15.
college-writing-002601.zh: 一袋25磅的干粮（最便宜的那种）大约售价15美元。

college-writing-002602.en: A large dog can eat that much in a couple of weeks.
college-writing-002602.zh: 一只大狗在几周内就能吃那么多。

college-writing-002603.en: 2. People can be cruel to pets simply by being thoughtless.
college-writing-002603.zh: 2. 人们仅仅因为不体贴，就可能对宠物残忍。

college-writing-002604.en: They don’t think about a pet’s needs, or they simply ignore those needs.
college-writing-002604.zh: 他们不考虑宠物的需求，或者干脆无视这些需求。

college-writing-002605.en: It never occurs to them that their pet can be experiencing a great deal of discomfort as a result of their failure to be sensitive.
college-writing-002605.zh: 他们从未想过，由于他们不敏感，他们的宠物可能会感到极大的不适。

college-writing-002606.en: The cruelty is a result of the basic lack of attention and concern─qualities that should be there, but aren’t.
college-writing-002606.zh: 这种残忍行为，源于基本缺乏关注与关怀——这些本应存在的品质，却不存在。

college-writing-002609.en: 3. My first flight overseas was a miserable experience.
college-writing-002609.zh: 3. 我的第一次海外飞行体验非常糟糕。

college-writing-002610.en: To begin with, even though we boarded our flight on time, we sat on the runway for over two hours.
college-writing-002610.zh: 首先，尽管我们按时登机，却在跑道上坐了两个多小时。

college-writing-002611.en: During those two hours, we had no food, no entertainment systems, and no air conditioning.
college-writing-002611.zh: 那两小时里，没有食物，没有娱乐设施，也没有空调。

college-writing-002612.en: Not only was it hot and stuffy on the plane, but the lack of food and water caused a lot of passengers to get really vulgar and angry.
college-writing-002612.zh: 飞机上不仅又热又闷，而且缺乏食物和饮水，导致许多乘客行为粗鄙、情绪暴躁。

college-writing-002613.en: Once we finally took off, I thought things might get better, but a group of schoolkids made the flight even more miserable.
college-writing-002613.zh: 当我们终于起飞后，我以为情况会有所改善，但一群学生让飞行过程变得更加糟糕。

college-writing-002614.en: For the entire eight-hour trip, they were loud, obnoxious, and rude.
college-writing-002614.zh: 在整个8小时的行程中，他们声音大、行为粗鲁且无礼。

college-writing-002615.en: They ran up and down the aisles, threw things to each other over the heads of other passengers, and ignored the flight attendants’ constant reprimands.
college-writing-002615.zh: 他们在过道里跑来跑去，从其他乘客的头顶上向对方扔东西，完全不理会空乘人员的不断斥责。

college-writing-002616.en: The final straw came when we were landing.
college-writing-002616.zh: 最后压垮我们的时刻出现在着陆时。

college-writing-002617.en: Just as the wheels were about to hit the runway, the pilot pulled up sharply and we took back off.
college-writing-002617.zh: 就在轮子即将接触跑道时，飞行员急刹车，我们便退了回去。

college-writing-002618.en: Everyone on the plane was screaming and crying.
college-writing-002618.zh: 飞机上的每个人都在尖叫和哭泣。

college-writing-002619.en: After circling for a while, we finally landed and were then told we nearly hit another airplane.
college-writing-002619.zh: 绕飞了一会儿后，我们终于降落了，随后被告知差点撞到另一架飞机。

college-writing-002620.en: If I could have swum home for my return flight, I would have.
college-writing-002620.zh: 如果我能为了返程航班游回家，我一定会这么做。

college-writing-002621.en: 4. A friend’s rudeness is much more damaging than a stranger’s.
college-writing-002621.zh: 4. 朋友的粗鲁行为比陌生人的行为更具破坏性。

college-writing-002622.en: When a friend says sharply, “I don’t have time to talk to you just now,” it can hurt deeply.
college-writing-002622.zh: 当朋友突然说“我现在没时间和你说话”时，会让人感到非常受伤。

college-writing-002623.en: When a friend shows up late for lunch or a shopping trip, with no good reason, it can make a person feel as if he or she is being taken for granted.
college-writing-002623.zh: 当朋友没有正当理由迟到吃午餐或购物时，会让人觉得自己被忽视了。

college-writing-002624.en: Worst, though, is when a friend pretends to be listening but his or her wandering eyes show a lack of attention.
college-writing-002624.zh: 最糟糕的情况是，朋友假装在听，但他的目光却显得心不在焉。

college-writing-002625.zh: 这常常让人感觉像是背叛。

college-writing-002626.en: Friends, after all, are supposed to make up for the thoughtless cruelties of strangers.
college-writing-002626.zh: 朋友们啊，他们本应弥补陌生人那些无心的残酷行为。

college-writing-002627.en: 5. Giving my first shampoo and set to a real person, after weeks of practicing on wigs, was a nerve-racking experience.
college-writing-002627.zh: 5. 第一次使用洗发水时，在用假发练习了数周之后，实际操作起来却让人感到非常紧张。

college-writing-002628.en: The customer was a woman who acted very sure about what she came for.
college-writing-002628.zh: 这位顾客是位女性，她对自己的来意非常自信。

college-writing-002629.en: She tried to describe what she wanted, and I tried without much success to understand what she had in mind.
college-writing-002629.zh: 她试图描述自己的需求，而我则尝试理解她的想法，但收效甚微。

college-writing-002630.en: Every time I did something, she seemed to be indicating in one way or another that it was not what she wanted.
college-writing-002630.zh: 每次我做出某件事时，她似乎都会以某种方式表明那并非她所期望的。

college-writing-002631.en: I got more and more nervous as I worked on her hair, and the nervousness showed.
college-writing-002631.zh: 在为她的头发做造型时，我越来越紧张，这种紧张情绪也显露出来了。

college-writing-002632.en: The worst part of the ordeal happened at the very end, when I added the final touches.
college-writing-002632.zh: 这一过程的最糟糕部分发生在最后阶段，也就是我进行最后的修饰时。

college-writing-002633.en: Nothing, to this woman, had turned out right.
college-writing-002633.zh: 对这个女人来说，没有什么是成功的。

college-writing-002634.en: Adding Details to Complete an Essay The following essay needs specific details to back up the ideas in the supporting paragraphs.
college-writing-002634.zh: 添加细节以完成文章：这篇文章需要具体的细节来支撑各段落中的观点。

college-writing-002635.en: Using the spaces provided, add a sentence or two of clear, convincing details for each supporting idea.
college-writing-002635.zh: 利用所提供的空间，为每个支持观点添加一两句清晰、有说服力的细节。

college-writing-002636.en: This activity will give you practice at supplying specific details and an initial feel for writing an essay.
college-writing-002636.zh: 这项活动将帮助你练习提供具体细节，并初步感受撰写文章的过程。

college-writing-002639.en: When my family’s Internet provider had some mechanical problems that interrupted our service for a week, my parents, my sister, and I thought we would never make it.
college-writing-002639.zh: 当我家互联网服务提供商出现一些机械故障，导致服务中断了一周时，我和父母、妹妹都以为我们肯定无法继续使用网络了。

college-writing-002640.en: Getting through long evenings without streaming movies, e-mails, Twitter updates, and Internet searches seemed impossible.
college-writing-002640.zh: 在没有观看电影、发送邮件、关注推特动态以及进行互联网搜索的漫长夜晚里，似乎根本无法熬过。

college-writing-002641.en: We soon realized, though, that living off-line for a while was a stroke of good fortune.
college-writing-002641.zh: 不过，我们很快意识到，暂时离线生活其实是一种幸运的际遇。

college-writing-002642.en: It became easy for each of us to enjoy some activities alone, to complete some postponed chores, and to spend rewarding time with each other and friends.
college-writing-002642.zh: 对我们每个人来说，独自享受一些活动、完成一些推迟的家务，以及与朋友共度有意义的时光都变得容易了。

college-writing-002644.en: First of all, now that we were disconnected, we found plenty of hours for personal interests.
college-writing-002644.zh: 首先，现在既然已经断网了，我们就有很多时间用于追求个人兴趣。

college-writing-002645.en: We all read more that week than we had read during
college-writing-002645.zh: 那周我们阅读的量比之前多了。

college-writing-002647.en: We each also enjoyed some hobbies we had ignored for ages.
college-writing-002647.zh: 我们每个人都重新享受起了那些长期以来被忽视的爱好。

college-writing-002648.en: In addition, my sister and I both stopped procrastinating with our
college-writing-002648.zh: 此外，我和姐姐都不再拖延了。

college-writing-002651.en: Second, we did chores that had been hanging over our heads for too long.
college-writing-002651.zh: 其次，我们完成了那些长期悬在头顶上的家务活。

college-writing-002652.en: There were many jobs around the house that had needed attention
college-writing-002652.zh: 家里有很多需要关注的事情。

college-writing-002656.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 85
college-writing-002656.zh: 第三章 写作的第一步与第二步 85

college-writing-002660.en: Finally, and probably most important, we spent time with each other.
college-writing-002660.zh: 最后，或许也是最重要的，我们共度了时光。

college-writing-002661.en: Instead of just being in the same room together while we stared at different
college-writing-002661.zh: 与其只是一起待在同一个房间里，却各自盯着不同的东西

college-writing-002662.en: screens, we actually talked for many pleasant hours.
college-writing-002662.zh: 在屏幕前，我们实际上共度了许多愉快的时光。

college-writing-002663.en: Moreover, for the first time in years my family played some card games and
college-writing-002663.zh: 此外，多年来第一次，我的家人玩了些纸牌游戏。

college-writing-002665.en: Because we couldn’t keep up with everyone electronically, we had some family friends over one evening and spent an enjoyable time with
college-writing-002665.zh: 由于无法通过电子方式与所有人保持联系，某天晚上我们请了些家庭朋友来，共度了一段愉快的时光。

college-writing-002668.en: We had a chance to do some long-postponed shopping.
college-writing-002668.zh: 我们有机会进行一些长期推迟的购物活动。

college-writing-002669.en: Also, each of us did some paperwork that was long overdue.
college-writing-002669.zh: 此外，我们每个人都处理了一些早已该完成的文书工作。

college-writing-002671.en: Once our Internet provider got the problems fixed, we were not prepared to go back to our previous ways.
college-writing-002671.zh: 一旦我们的互联网服务提供商解决了问题，我们就没有心思再回到以前的方式了。

college-writing-002672.en: We had gained a sense of how our online activities had not only taken over our lives, but had also interrupted our family’s life.
college-writing-002672.zh: 我们意识到，我们的在线活动不仅占据了我们的生活，还扰乱了家庭的生活。

college-writing-002673.en: We still spend time streaming movies, gaming, e-mailing, and tweeting, but we make sure to spend at least two evenings a week focusing on each other.
college-writing-002673.zh: 我们仍然会花时间观看电影、玩游戏、发邮件和发推文，但确保每周至少有两个晚上专注于彼此。

college-writing-002674.en: As a result, we have found that we can enjoy our virtual lives and still have time left over for our real lives!
college-writing-002674.zh: 因此，我们发现我们可以享受虚拟生活，同时还能留出时间用于现实生活！

college-writing-002676.en: What are some ways besides using electronic media that you and your family or friends spend quality time together?
college-writing-002676.zh: 除了使用电子媒体，还有哪些方式能让你与家人或朋友共度美好时光？

college-writing-002677.en: Write about one of these activities and why you enjoy it.
college-writing-002677.zh: 写关于其中一项活动的内容，并说明你为什么喜欢它。

college-writing-002679.en: Chapter 3 The First and Second Steps in Essay Writing 87
college-writing-002679.zh: 第三章 写作的第一和第二步 87

college-writing-002684.en: In the previous chapter, you helped complete one student’s essay about life without electronic media.
college-writing-002684.zh: 在上一章中，你帮助完成了一名学生关于没有电子媒体时代的生活的文章。

college-writing-002685.en: Without Internet access, the student had time to enjoy a host of other activities they otherwise would not have had time to do.
college-writing-002685.zh: 没有互联网接入，学生有时间参与许多原本无法进行的活动。

college-writing-002686.en: Write an essay about what, in your life, keeps you from completing tasks or doing what you enjoy.
college-writing-002686.zh: 写一篇文章，谈谈在你的生活中，是什么阻碍了你完成任务或做自己喜欢的事情。

college-writing-002687.en: Also include what you would do with your time if this obstacle was removed.
college-writing-002687.zh: 也包含如果这一障碍被消除，你会如何利用自己的时间。

college-writing-002689.en: This chapter will show you how to • organize and connect specific evidence in the body paragraphs of an essay • begin and end an essay with effective introductory and concluding paragraphs
college-writing-002689.zh: 本章将指导你如何•在文章的正文段落中整理和连接具体证据•用有效的引言段和结论段来开始和结束文章

college-writing-002690.en: The Third Step in Essay Writing 4

college-writing-002691.en: C H A P T E R

college-writing-002692.en: You know from Chapter 3 that the first two steps in writing an effective essay are advancing a thesis and supporting it with specific evidence.
college-writing-002692.zh: 从第三章中可知，撰写有效文章的前两个步骤是提出论点，并用具体证据来支撑该论点。

college-writing-002693.en: This chapter deals with the third step: organizing and connecting the supporting information in a paper.
college-writing-002693.zh: 本章讨论第三步：对文档中的辅助信息进行整理与关联。

college-writing-002694.en: You’ll also learn how to start an essay with a suitable introductory paragraph and how to finish it with a well-rounded concluding paragraph.
college-writing-002694.zh: 你还将学习如何以合适的引言段开始文章，以及如何以完整的结尾段结束文章。

college-writing-002696.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 89
college-writing-002696.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 89

college-writing-002697.en: Step 3: Organize and Connect the Specific Evidence
college-writing-002697.zh: 第三步：整理并连接具体证据

college-writing-002698.en: As you are generating the specific details needed to support a thesis, you should be thinking about ways to organize and connect those details.
college-writing-002698.zh: 在整理出支持论点所需的具体细节时，你应该思考如何对这些细节进行整理和关联。

college-writing-002699.en: All the details in your essay must cohere, or stick together, so that your reader will be able to move smoothly from one bit of supporting information to the next.
college-writing-002699.zh: 你的文章中的所有细节必须协调一致，让读者能够顺畅地从一段支撑信息过渡到下一段。

college-writing-002700.en: This section shows you how to organize and connect supporting details by using (1) common methods of organization, (2) transitions, and (3) other connecting words.
college-writing-002700.zh: 本节介绍怎样用（1）常见的组织方式、（2）过渡语和（3）其他连接语来组织和衔接支撑细节。

college-writing-002701.en: Common Methods of Organization Two common methods used to organize the supporting material in an essay are time order and emphatic order.
college-writing-002701.zh: 常见的组织方法：用于组织文章辅助材料的两种常见方法是时间顺序和重点突出顺序。

college-writing-002702.en: (You will learn more specific methods of development in Part 2 of this book.)
college-writing-002702.zh: （本书第二部分将介绍更多具体的开发方法。）

college-writing-002703.en: Time order, or chronological order, simply means that details are listed as they occur in time.
college-writing-002703.zh: 时间顺序或时间顺序，指的是按事件发生的先后顺序来排列细节。

college-writing-002704.en: First this is done; next this; then this; after that, this; and so on.
college-writing-002704.zh: 首先做这个；然后做这个；接着做这个；之后再做这个；如此反复。

college-writing-002705.en: Here is an outline of an essay in this book that uses time order:
college-writing-002705.zh: 这是本书中一篇采用时间顺序的文章大纲：

college-writing-002706.en: In order to effectively market the preschool, promoting the center needs to remain at
college-writing-002706.zh: 为了有效推广幼儿园业务，该中心需要保持竞争力。

college-writing-002707.en: the top of our priority list and should include proper advertising, publicity, and referrals.
college-writing-002707.zh: 应将其列为最优先事项，并应包含适当的广告、宣传和推荐。

college-writing-002708.en: 1. The first step is proper advertising that must start with a well-designed multi-layered
college-writing-002708.zh: 第一步是进行恰当的广告投放，这必须以精心设计的多层结构为起点。

college-writing-002709.en: website that includes general information, enrollment forms, and profiles of teachers and
college-writing-002709.zh: 网站包含一般信息、报名表格以及教师个人资料。

college-writing-002711.en: 2. A second step to increasing enrollment is through concerted publicity.
college-writing-002711.zh: 2. 增加入学率的第二个途径是开展协同宣传。

college-writing-002712.en: 3. The final and best way to increase enrollment is to utilize our currently enrolled families.
college-writing-002712.zh: 3. 增加入学人数的最终且最佳方法，就是利用目前已入学的家庭。

college-writing-002714.en: Fill in the missing words: The topic sentences in the essay use the words or phrases , and to help show time order.
college-writing-002714.zh: 填写缺失的单词：文章中的主题句使用了某些词语或短语，以此来表明时间顺序。

college-writing-002715.en: Here is one supporting paragraph from the essay:
college-writing-002715.zh: 这是文章中的一段支持性段落：

college-writing-002716.en: A second step to increasing enrollment is through concerted publicity.
college-writing-002716.zh: 增加入学率的第二步是通过协同宣传来实现。

college-writing-002717.en: Publicity could include a monthly column in the local newspaper that highlights what is currently going on at the preschool.
college-writing-002717.zh: 宣传方式可以包括在当地报纸上刊登每月一次的专栏文章，报道幼儿园当前正在开展的活动。

college-writing-002720.en: The last position in a paper is the most emphatic position because the reader is most likely to remember the last thing read.
college-writing-002720.zh: 文章的最后一段是最为重要的部分，因为读者最有可能记住最后读到的内容。

college-writing-002721.en: Finally, last of all, and most important are typical words or phrases showing emphasis.
college-writing-002721.zh: 最后，也是最重要的，是那些用于强调的典型词语或短语。

college-writing-002722.en: Here is an outline of an essay in this book that uses emphatic order:
college-writing-002722.zh: 以下是本书中一篇采用强调语序的文章大纲：

college-writing-002723.en: Because our curriculum is a blend of Montessori and Carden methods, we have a unique offering; calling attention to the special achievements, programs, and students in our school would offer the positive publicity needed to interest potential families.
college-writing-002723.zh: 由于我们的课程融合了蒙特梭利与卡登教学法，我们拥有独特的教学特色；重点介绍学校中的杰出成就、项目以及学生，能够带来足够的正面宣传，吸引潜在的家庭关注。

college-writing-002724.en: Each column’s publication should be followed by an open house, so potential families can actually visit our school.
college-writing-002724.zh: 每列报道之后都应安排开放日，以便潜在的家庭能够实际参观我们的学校。

college-writing-002725.en: These open houses should also occur during key enrollment periods to encourage greater attendance.
college-writing-002725.zh: 这些开放日活动也应在重要的报名期间进行，以鼓励更多人参与。

college-writing-002726.en: Finally, hosting one or two major events such as a school picnic or music program will continue to raise awareness of our school within the community.
college-writing-002726.zh: 最后，举办一两次大型活动，比如学校野餐或音乐演出，将有助于提升社区对我们学校的认知。

college-writing-002727.en: In cases where all the details seem equal in importance, the writer should impose a personal order that seems logical or appropriate.
college-writing-002727.zh: 在所有细节的重要性都相当的情况下，作者应制定一个看似合理或恰当的个人排序。

college-writing-002729.en: Fill in the missing words: The paragraph uses the following words to help show time order: , and .
college-writing-002729.zh: 填写缺失的单词：该段落使用以下词汇来体现时间顺序：，和。

college-writing-002730.en: Emphatic order is sometimes described as “saving the best till last.”
college-writing-002730.zh: 强调性排序有时被描述为“把最好的留到最后”。

college-writing-002731.en: It is a way to put emphasis on the most interesting or important detail by placing it in the last part of a paragraph or in the final supporting paragraph of an essay.
college-writing-002731.zh: 这是一种强调最有趣或最重要的细节的方法，将其放在段落的结尾部分，或文章的最后支持性段落中。

college-writing-002732.en: When I compare the two restaurants, the advantages of eating at McDonald’s are clear.
college-writing-002732.zh: 与两家餐厅相比，在麦当劳用餐的优势非常明显。

college-writing-002733.en: 1. For one thing, going to the Chalet is more difficult than going to McDonald’s.
college-writing-002733.zh: 一方面，去chalet比去麦当劳要困难一些。

college-writing-002734.en: 2. Eating at the Chalet is, to me, less enjoyable than eating at McDonald’s.
college-writing-002734.zh: 对我来说，在小屋用餐比在麦当劳用餐没那么愉快。

college-writing-002735.en: 3. The most important difference between the Chalet and McDonald’s, though, is price.
college-writing-002735.zh: 3. 不过，Chalet与麦当劳之间最关键的差异在于价格。

college-writing-002737.en: Fill in the missing words: The topic sentences in the essay use the words or phrases , , to help show emphatic order.
college-writing-002737.zh: 填写缺失的单词：文章中的主题句使用了这些词语或短语，以帮助体现清晰的顺序。

college-writing-002738.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 91
college-writing-002738.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 91

college-writing-002739.en: Here is the third supporting paragraph from the essay:
college-writing-002739.zh: 这是该文章的第三段支持性段落：

college-writing-002740.en: The most important difference between the Chalet and McDonald’s, though, is price.
college-writing-002740.zh: 不过，Chalet与麦当劳之间最关键的差异在于价格。

college-writing-002741.en: Dinner for two at the Chalet, even without appetizers or desserts, would easily cost $100.
college-writing-002741.zh: 在chalet里享用二人晚餐，即使没有开胃菜和甜点，费用也很容易达到100美元。

college-writing-002742.en: And the $100 doesn’t include the cost of parking the car and tipping the waiter, which can come to an additional $20.
college-writing-002742.zh: 那100美元还不包括停车以及给服务员小费的费用，这些可能还会额外增加20美元。

college-writing-002743.en: Once, I forgot to bring enough money.
college-writing-002743.zh: 有一次，我忘了带足够的钱。

college-writing-002744.en: At McDonald’s, a filling meal for two will cost around $15.
college-writing-002744.zh: 在麦当劳，双人套餐大约需要15美元。

college-writing-002745.en: With the extra $105, my wife and I can eat at McDonald’s seven more times, or go to the movies five times, or buy tickets to a local theater production.
college-writing-002745.zh: 有了那额外的105美元，我和妻子可以再在麦当劳吃七次饭，或者去电影院看五次电影，或者购买当地剧院的演出门票。

college-writing-002746.en: Fill in the missing phrase: The words are used to mark the most emphatic detail in the paragraph.
college-writing-002746.zh: 填写缺失的短语：这些词用于标记段落中最突出的细节。

college-writing-002747.en: Some essays use a combination of time order and emphatic order.
college-writing-002747.zh: 一些文章采用时间顺序与强调顺序的结合方式。

college-writing-002748.en: For example, the essay on moviegoing in Chapter 1 includes time order: the writer first describes getting to the theater, then the theater itself, and finally the behavior of audience members during the movie.
college-writing-002748.zh: 例如，第一章中关于看电影的文章按照时间顺序展开：作者首先描述了前往电影院的过程，接着是电影院本身，最后才是观众在电影放映期间的行为表现。

college-writing-002749.en: At the same time, the writer uses emphatic order, ending with the most important reason for her dislike of moviegoing: “Some of the other patrons are even more of a problem than the theater itself.”
college-writing-002749.zh: 同时，作者采用了强调性的语序，最后提出了她对看电影不满的最主要原因：“其他观众比电影院本身更令人困扰。”

college-writing-002750.en: Part A Read the essays listed below (chapter numbers are in parentheses) and identify their method of organizing details─time order, emphatic order, or a combination of both.
college-writing-002750.zh: A部分：阅读下面列出的文章（章节编号在括号内），并判断其细节组织的方式——时间顺序、重点突出顺序，或两者的结合。

college-writing-002754.en: Part B Now see if you can complete the explanations that follow.
college-writing-002754.zh: B部分 现在看看能否完成接下来的说明。

college-writing-002755.en: The essay titled “Taking on a Disability” uses (add the missing word)
college-writing-002755.zh: 题为“应对残疾”的文章中使用了（补充缺失的单词）

college-writing-002757.en: The author begins with the challenge of learning to sit properly in the wheelchair, then moves on to learning to move in the wheelchair, and ends with several problems that occurred next, during the church service.
college-writing-002757.zh: 作者首先介绍了如何正确坐在轮椅上的技巧，接着讲述了如何在轮椅上移动的方法，最后提到了在教堂礼拜过程中出现的几个问题。

college-writing-002761.en: “A Vote for McDonald’s” uses (add the missing word) order.
college-writing-002761.zh: 《为麦当劳投一票》采用（补充缺失的单词）顺序。

college-writing-002762.en: The writer presents three advantages of eating at McDonald’s and ends with the most important one: reasonable prices.
college-writing-002762.zh: 作者介绍了在麦当劳用餐的三个优势，最后重点提到了最重要的一个：价格合理。

college-writing-002763.en: “Paying Attention to a Death” uses a combination of (add the missing words) and order.
college-writing-002763.zh: 《关注死亡》运用了（补充缺失的词语）与顺序的结合。

college-writing-002764.en: It begins with a chronological overview of both the essay and the film, but then it moves into important themes and ideas presented in both pieces.
college-writing-002764.zh: 文章首先按时间顺序对文章与电影进行了概述，随后则探讨了两作品中所呈现的重要主题与思想。

college-writing-002765.en: It ends with the significance and impact of each of the deaths.
college-writing-002765.zh: 最后阐述了每一起死亡事件的意义与影响。

college-writing-002767.en: Transitions signal the direction of a writer’s thoughts.
college-writing-002767.zh: 过渡段揭示了作者思想的走向。

college-writing-002768.en: They are like the road signs that guide travelers.
college-writing-002768.zh: 它们就像指引行人的路标。

college-writing-002769.en: In the box that follows are some common transitions, grouped according to the kind of signal they give to readers.
college-writing-002769.zh: 下面的框中列出了一些常见的转换方式，按它们向读者传递的信号类型进行分组。

college-writing-002770.en: Note that certain words provide more than one kind of signal.
college-writing-002770.zh: 请注意，某些词汇可以表示多种信号。

college-writing-002772.en: Addition Signals: one, first, second, the third reason, also, next, and, in addition, moreover, further, furthermore, finally, last, similarly, likewise, as well, too, besides.
college-writing-002772.zh: 补充信号：第一、首先、第二、第三个原因，此外，接下来，而且，再者，更进一步的，最终，最后，类似地，也一样，还有，除了这些之外。

college-writing-002773.en: Time Signals: first, then, next, after, as before, while, meanwhile, soon, now, during, finally, after a while, as soon as, at that time, by then, since, suddenly, then, thereafter, by then, in a few hours, by that time, previously, at last, later, all this time, shortly, formerly.
college-writing-002773.zh: 时间信号：首先、然后、接下来、之后、如同以前、同时、不久、现在、期间、最终、过一会儿、一立刻、那时、到那时、因为、突然、之后、到那时、几小时后、到那时、先前、最后、后来、所有这些时间、短暂地、以前。

college-writing-002774.en: Space Signals: next to, across, on the opposite side, to the left, to the right, above, below, near, nearby, beside, on top of, under, over, underneath, far from.
college-writing-002774.zh: 空间信号：旁边、对面、在另一侧、左侧、右侧、上方、下方、附近、邻近、在……之上、在……之下、远离。

college-writing-002775.en: Change-of-Direction Signals: but, however, yet, in contrast, although, otherwise, still, on the contrary, on the other hand, nevertheless, instead, nonetheless, otherwise, even though, unfortunately, alternatively.
college-writing-002775.zh: 方向变化的信号：但是、然而、尽管如此、相反地、另一方面、不过、还是、另外、依然、即便、不幸的是、作为替代。

college-writing-002776.en: Illustration Signals: for example, for instance, specifically, as an illustration, once, such as, accordingly.
college-writing-002776.zh: 示例信号：例如，具体来说，作为示例，曾经如此，相应地。

college-writing-002777.en: Conclusion Signals: therefore, consequently, thus, then, as a result, in summary, to conclude, last, finally, in review.
college-writing-002777.zh: 结论信号：因此、随之、然后、作为结果、总结来说、最终、回顾一下。

college-writing-002778.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 93
college-writing-002778.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 93

college-writing-002779.en: 1. Underline the four addition signals in the following selection: ACTIVITY 2
college-writing-002779.zh: 在以下选文中标出四个添加信号：ACTIVITY 2

college-writing-002780.en: Other Transitions: Conjunctive Adverbs and Transitional Phrases
college-writing-002780.zh: 其他过渡方式：并列副词与过渡短语

college-writing-002781.en: A conjunctive adverb is a word that, when used after a semicolon, connects two independent (main) clauses.
college-writing-002781.zh: 连接副词是一种词类，当它在分号之后使用时，可以连接两个独立的（主）句。

college-writing-002782.en: A transitional phrase is a group of words that, when used after a semicolon, connects two independent (main) clauses.
college-writing-002782.zh: 过渡短语是一组词语，当它们被置于分号之后时，能够连接两个独立的（主要）分句。

college-writing-002783.en: Conjunctive adverb: Napoleon successfully invaded Russia in 1812; however, he did not occupy it for long.
college-writing-002783.zh: 连系副词：拿破仑在1812年成功入侵了俄罗斯；然而，他并未长期占据该地。

college-writing-002784.en: Common conjunctive adverbs: also, anyway, besides, certainly, consequently, finally, further, furthermore, however, indeed, instead, likewise, moreover, nevertheless, otherwise, similarly, still, therefore.
college-writing-002784.zh: 常见的连接副词：也、反正、此外、当然、因此、最终、更、再者、然而、确实、相反、同样、此外、尽管如此、否则、相似地、仍然、所以。

college-writing-002785.en: Transitional phrase: Jean Piaget made major contributions to child psychology; in fact, he proved that children and adults reason differently.
college-writing-002785.zh: 过渡句：让·皮亚杰在儿童心理学领域做出了重大贡献；事实上，他证明了儿童和成人推理方式不同。

college-writing-002786.en: Common transitional phrases: for instance, in addition, in contrast, in spite of, in retrospect, once again, on the other hand.
college-writing-002786.zh: 常见的过渡性短语：例如、此外、相反地、尽管、回顾起来、再次、另一方面。

college-writing-002787.en: Like transitional words, conjunctive adverbs and transitional phrases signal the direction of the writer’s thoughts and guide the reader.
college-writing-002787.zh: 与过渡词一样，连接副词和过渡短语也表明了作者思路的方向，并引导读者。

college-writing-002788.en: Applying for financial aid is a very detailed process.
college-writing-002788.zh: 申请经济援助是一个非常繁琐的过程。

college-writing-002789.en: First, students should fill out the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA).
college-writing-002789.zh: 首先，学生应填写联邦学生资助免费申请表（FAFSA）。

college-writing-002790.en: This may require gathering a lot of specific information, but once it has been completed, the Student Aid Report (SAR) should arrive quickly.
college-writing-002790.zh: 这可能需要收集大量具体信息，但一旦完成，学生资助报告（SAR）应该会很快出炉。

college-writing-002791.en: Second, students should review their SAR to find out how much they will be expected to pay for college and how much aid they qualify for.
college-writing-002791.zh: 其次，学生应仔细查看自己的奖学金申请资料，了解预计需要支付多少学费，以及符合何种资助条件。

college-writing-002792.en: Next, they should compare financial aid packages offered by each of their chosen colleges.
college-writing-002792.zh: 接下来，他们应该比较所选大学提供的各种经济援助方案。

college-writing-002793.en: Finally, students should decide which financial aid package they are going to accept, contact the college, and prepare to fill out more paperwork to receive their financial aid.
college-writing-002793.zh: 最后，学生应决定要接受哪种经济援助方案，联系学院，并准备填写更多文件以获得经济援助。

college-writing-002794.en: To set up a realistic exercise regime, people need to follow a simple plan consisting of arranging time, making preparations, and starting off at a sensible pace.
college-writing-002794.zh: 为了建立合理的锻炼计划，人们需要遵循一个简单的步骤：安排时间、做好准备，并以合理的速度开始锻炼。

college-writing-002795.en: The first step is arranging time.

college-writing-002798.en: 2. Underline the three time signals in the following selection:
college-writing-002798.zh: 2. 在以下选文中突出显示三个时间信号：

college-writing-002800.en: 3. Underline the three space signals in the following selection:
college-writing-002800.zh: 3. 在以下选词中强调三个空格符号：

college-writing-002801.en: people who don’t regularly exercise have excuses for not exercising: a heavy schedule at work or school; being rushed in the morning and exhausted at night; or too many other responsibilities.
college-writing-002801.zh: 那些不经常锻炼的人总有不锻炼的借口：工作或学习任务繁重；早晨被催促着工作，晚上则疲惫不堪；或者还有太多其他责任要承担。

college-writing-002802.en: One simple solution is to get up half an hour earlier in the morning.
college-writing-002802.zh: 一个简单的解决方案就是早上提前半小时起床。

college-writing-002803.en: The next step is making preparations.

college-writing-002804.en: Having necessary items like workout clothes, videos, and exercise equipment laid out and ready makes it much easier to get started.
college-writing-002804.zh: 准备好运动服装、视频和健身器材等必要物品后，开始使用就变得容易多了。

college-writing-002805.en: Finally, people who are just beginning an exercise regime should start off at a sensible pace.
college-writing-002805.zh: 最后，刚开始锻炼的人应该以适中的速度开始。

college-writing-002806.en: Many workout videos have different levels of exercise programs, and new exercisers should always start with level one to avoid injuries.
college-writing-002806.zh: 许多锻炼视频包含不同难度的运动项目，新的锻炼者应始终从第一级开始，以避免受伤。

college-writing-002807.en: Through careful planning and common sense, anyone can start exercising.
college-writing-002807.zh: 通过精心规划和运用常识，任何人都可以开始锻炼。

college-writing-002808.en: The vegetable bin in my refrigerator contained an assortment of weird-looking items.
college-writing-002808.zh: 我的冰箱里的蔬菜箱里装着各种看起来很奇怪的物品。

college-writing-002809.en: Next to a shriveled, fuzz-coated lemon were two oranges covered with blue fur.
college-writing-002809.zh: 在那个萎缩、覆盖着绒毛的柠檬旁边，还有两个被蓝色毛皮覆盖的橙子。

college-writing-002810.en: To the right of the oranges was a bunch of carrots that had begun to sprout points, spikes, knobs, and tendrils.
college-writing-002810.zh: 橙子右边有一束胡萝卜，它们开始长出尖点、刺状物、结节和触须。

college-writing-002811.en: The carrots drooped into U shapes as I picked them up with the tips of my fingers.
college-writing-002811.zh: 当我用指尖拾起胡萝卜时，它们呈U形弯曲。

college-writing-002812.en: Near the carrots was a net bag of onions; each onion had sent curling shoots through the net until the whole thing resembled a mass of green spaghetti.
college-writing-002812.zh: 胡萝卜旁边有一个装洋葱的网袋；每颗洋葱都从网中长出了卷曲的嫩芽，整个东西看起来就像一团绿色的意大利面。

college-writing-002813.en: The most horrible item, though, was a head of lettuce that had turned into a pool of brown goo.
college-writing-002813.zh: 不过，最糟糕的是一株生菜叶，它已经变成了一团棕色的黏糊糊的东西。

college-writing-002814.en: It had seeped out of its bag and coated the bin with a sticky, evil-smelling liquid.
college-writing-002814.zh: 它从包里渗出来，在垃圾桶上覆盖了一层黏糊糊的、有恶臭的液体。

college-writing-002815.en: 4. Underline the two change-of-direction signals in the following selection:
college-writing-002815.zh: 4. 在以下选词中，标出两个方向变化的信号：

college-writing-002817.en: Taking small children on vacation sounds like a wonderful experience for the entire family.
college-writing-002817.zh: 带小孩去度假对全家人来说似乎是一种很棒的体验。

college-writing-002818.en: Although this may be true for most, vacations can also be scary or emotionally overwhelming times for children.
college-writing-002818.zh: 虽然对大多数人来说如此，但假期对儿童来说也可能是一种令人恐惧或情绪上难以承受的时光。

college-writing-002819.en: When children are taken away from their usual routine and brought to an unfamiliar place, they can become very frightened.
college-writing-002819.zh: 当孩子们被从日常生活中带离，被带到一个陌生的地方时，他们可能会非常害怕。

college-writing-002820.en: That strange bed in the motel room or the unusual noises in Grandma’s spare bedroom may cause nightmares.
college-writing-002820.zh: 汽车旅馆房间里的那张奇怪的床，或奶奶的临时卧室里那些不寻常的声音，都可能导致噩梦。

college-writing-002821.en: On vacations, too, children usually clamor to do as many things in one day as they can and to stay up past their usual bedtime.
college-writing-002821.zh: 在假期期间，孩子们也通常渴望在一天内做尽可能多的事情，并且熬夜到比平时更晚的睡觉时间。

college-writing-002822.en: Since it is vacation time, parents may decide to give in to the children’s demands.
college-writing-002822.zh: 由于正值假期，父母可能会满足孩子的要求。

college-writing-002824.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 95
college-writing-002824.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 95

college-writing-002825.en: 5. Underline the two illustration signals in the following selection:
college-writing-002825.zh: 5. 在以下选文中强调两个插图信号：

college-writing-002826.en: attitude like this, however, can lead to problems.
college-writing-002826.zh: 然而，这种态度可能会导致问题。

college-writing-002827.en: After a sixteen-hour day of touring the amusement park, eating in a restaurant, and seeing a movie, children can experience sensory and emotional overload.
college-writing-002827.zh: 在经历了16个小时的游乐园游览、餐厅用餐和看电影的经历后，孩子们可能会感到感官和情绪上的过载。

college-writing-002828.en: They become cranky, unhappy, or even rebellious and angry.
college-writing-002828.zh: 他们会变得暴躁、不快乐，甚至叛逆和愤怒。

college-writing-002829.en: Supermarkets also use psychology to encourage people to buy.
college-writing-002829.zh: 超市也利用心理学来促使人们购买。

college-writing-002830.en: For example, in most supermarkets, the milk and the bread are either at opposite ends of the store or located far away from the first aisle.
college-writing-002830.zh: 例如，在大多数超市中，牛奶和面包要么位于商店的相反两端，要么位于远离第一个通道的地方。

college-writing-002831.en: Even if a shopper stopped at the market only for staples like these, he or she must first pass hundreds of items.
college-writing-002831.zh: 即使购物者只是去市场购买一些基础商品，他或她首先必须通过数百种商品。

college-writing-002832.en: The odds are that instead of leaving with just a quart of milk, additional purchases will be made.
college-writing-002832.zh: 很有可能，人们不会只带一夸脱牛奶就离开，还会购买更多。

college-writing-002833.en: Special displays, such as a pyramid of canned green beans in an aisle or a large end display of cartons of paper towels, also increase sales.
college-writing-002833.zh: 特殊的展示方式，比如在通道里摆放的罐装青豆金字塔，或者摆放大量纸巾盒的展示架，也能促进销售。
