college-writing-002834.en: Because the shopper assumes that these items are a good buy, he or she may pick them up.
college-writing-002834.zh: 因为购买者认为这些商品很值得购买，所以他或她可能会购买它们。

college-writing-002835.en: However, the items may not even be on sale.
college-writing-002835.zh: 不过，这些商品可能甚至不出售。

college-writing-002836.en: Store managers know that the customer is automatically attracted to a display like this, and they will use it to move an overstocked product.
college-writing-002836.zh: 商店经理明白，这样的展示方式会吸引顾客，他们会利用它来推销过季商品。

college-writing-002837.en: 6. Underline the two conclusion signals in the following selection:
college-writing-002837.zh: 6. 在以下选文中强调两个结论标记：

college-writing-002838.en: Finally, my grandmother was extremely thrifty.
college-writing-002838.zh: 最后，我的祖母非常节俭。

college-writing-002839.en: She was one of those people who hoard pieces of used aluminum foil after carefully scrubbing off the cake icing or beef gravy.
college-writing-002839.zh: 她是那种在仔细擦除蛋糕糖霜或牛肉酱后，会囤积大量旧铝箔片的人之一。

college-writing-002840.en: She had a drawer full of old eyeglasses that dated back at least thirty years.
college-writing-002840.zh: 她的抽屉里装满了至少三十年前的旧眼镜。

college-writing-002841.en: The lens prescriptions were no longer accurate, but Gran couldn’t bear to throw away “a good pair of glasses.”
college-writing-002841.zh: 眼镜的处方已经不再准确了，但格兰无法忍受丢弃“一副好眼镜”。

college-writing-002842.en: She kept them “just in case,” but we could never figure out what situation would involve a desperate need for a dozen pairs of old eyeglasses.
college-writing-002842.zh: 她把那些东西留着“以备不时之需”，但我们永远无法想象会有什么情况会迫切需要十双旧眼镜。

college-writing-002843.en: We never realized the true extent of Gran’s thriftiness, though, until after she died.
college-writing-002843.zh: 直到她去世之后，我们才意识到格兰的节俭程度究竟有多严重。

college-writing-002844.en: Her house was to be sold; therefore, we cleaned out its dusty attic.
college-writing-002844.zh: 她的房子即将出售；因此，我们清理了里面积灰的阁楼。

college-writing-002845.en: In one corner was a cardboard box filled with two- and three-inch pieces of string.
college-writing-002845.zh: 一个角落里有一个纸板箱，里面装满了两英寸和三英寸长的绳子。

college-writing-002846.en: The box was labeled, in Gran’s spidery hand, “String too short to be saved.”
college-writing-002846.zh: 那个盒子被格兰那瘦小的手标上字，上面写着：“绳子太短，无法保存。”

college-writing-002850.en: Transitional sentences, or linking sentences, are used between paragraphs to help tie together the supporting paragraphs in an essay.
college-writing-002850.zh: 过渡句或连接句用于各段落之间，有助于将文章中的相关段落有机地连接起来。

college-writing-002851.en: They enable the reader to move smoothly from the idea in one paragraph to the idea in the next paragraph.
college-writing-002851.zh: 它们帮助读者能够流畅地从一段中的某个想法过渡到下一段中的另一个想法。

college-writing-002852.en: Here is the linking sentence used in the essay on moviegoing: Many of the other patrons are even more of a problem than the concession stand.
college-writing-002852.zh: 这是关于看电影的文章中使用的连接句：其他顾客中的许多人比那小餐馆更成问题。

college-writing-002853.en: The words concession stand remind us of the point of the first supporting paragraph, while Many of the other patrons presents the point to be developed in the second supporting paragraph.
college-writing-002853.zh: “让步”这个词组让我们想起了第一段辅助段落的要点，而其他许多内容则表明其要点需要在第二段辅助段落中进一步阐述。

college-writing-002854.en: Following is a partially completed diagram draft of an essay.
college-writing-002854.zh: 以下是文章的部分完成版示意图。

college-writing-002855.en: The second and third topic sentences serve as transitional, or linking, sentences.
college-writing-002855.zh: 第二个和第三个主题句起到过渡或连接句子的作用。

college-writing-002856.en: Each reminds us of the point in the preceding paragraph and announces the point to be developed in the current paragraph.
college-writing-002856.zh: 每一部分都提醒我们前一段的内容，并预示着当前段落中要阐述的内容。

college-writing-002857.en: In the spaces provided, add the words needed to complete the second and third topic sentences.
college-writing-002857.zh: 在提供的空白处，添加所需的词语以完成第二和第三个主题句。

college-writing-002858.en: The most memorable sites I visited in Washington, D.C., were the Capitol Building, the Lincoln Memorial, and the Vietnam Memorial.
college-writing-002858.zh: 我在华盛顿特区参观过最令人难忘的景点是国会大厦、林肯纪念堂以及越南纪念墙。

college-writing-002859.en: Our first stop was Capitol Hill, the very symbol of our democratic system. . . .
college-writing-002859.zh: 我们的第一个目的地是国会山，那是我们民主制度的象征……

college-writing-002864.en: After leaving the , we walked along the Mall to the
college-writing-002864.zh: 离开后，我们沿着购物中心行走。

college-writing-002865.en: A short distance to the right of the is the

college-writing-002866.en: Other Connecting Words In addition to transitions, there are three other kinds of connecting words that help tie together the specific evidence in a paper: repeated words, pronouns, and synonyms.
college-writing-002866.zh: 其他连接词除了过渡词外，还有三种有助于将论文中的具体证据串联起来的连接词：重复词、代词和同义词。

college-writing-002867.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 97
college-writing-002867.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 97

college-writing-002869.en: Many of us have been taught─correctly─not to repeat ourselves in writing.
college-writing-002869.zh: 我们许多人被正确地教导过，在写作中不要重复自己的话。

college-writing-002870.en: However, repeating key words helps tie together the flow of thought in a paper.
college-writing-002870.zh: 然而，重复关键词有助于将文章中的思路连贯起来。

college-writing-002871.en: Below, repeated words remind readers of the selection’s central idea.
college-writing-002871.zh: 在下方，重复的词语让读者想起该选段的核心思想。

college-writing-002872.en: One good reason for studying psychology is to help parents deal with their children.
college-writing-002872.zh: 学习心理学的一个重要原因，是帮助父母应对孩子的问题。

college-writing-002873.en: Perhaps a young daughter refuses to go to bed when she should and bursts into tears at the least mention of “lights out.”
college-writing-002873.zh: 或许是一个年轻的女儿在应该睡觉的时间拒绝睡觉，只要一提到“熄灯时间”，她就会哭起来。

college-writing-002874.en: A little knowledge of psychology comes in handy.
college-writing-002874.zh: 一些心理学知识会很有帮助。

college-writing-002875.en: If she is given a choice of staying up until 7:30 with the family or going upstairs and playing until 8:00, she gets to make the decision.
college-writing-002875.zh: 如果让她选择是和家人一起熬夜到7:30，还是上楼玩到8:00，她可以自己决定。

college-writing-002876.en: In this way, she does not feel so powerless and will not resist.
college-writing-002876.zh: 这样，她就不会感到如此无力，也不会反抗。

college-writing-002877.en: Psychology is also useful in rewarding a child for a job well done.
college-writing-002877.zh: 心理学在奖励孩子完成好工作时也有帮助。

college-writing-002878.en: Instead of telling a ten-year-old son what a good boy he is when he makes his own bed, good psychology says to focus on how neat it is and the fact that he did it by himself.
college-writing-002878.zh: 与其在十岁的儿子自己整理好床铺时告诉他他是个好孩子，好的心理学理念是关注床铺的整洁程度以及他是自己整理出来的这一事实。

college-writing-002879.en: The psychology books say that being a good boy is much harder to live up to than doing one job well.
college-writing-002879.zh: 心理学书籍指出，做一个好孩子比做好一份工作要难得多。

college-writing-002881.en: Pronouns (he, she, it, you, they, this, that, and others) are another way to connect ideas.
college-writing-002881.zh: 代词（他、她、它、你、他们、这个、那个等）是另一种表达观点的方式。

college-writing-002882.en: Also, using pronouns in place of other words can help you avoid needless repetition.
college-writing-002882.zh: 此外，使用代词代替其他词汇可以帮助你避免不必要的重复。

college-writing-002883.en: (Note, however, that pronouns should be used with care to avoid the problems described in Chapter 27.)
college-writing-002883.zh: （不过需要注意的是，应谨慎使用代词，以避免第27章中描述的问题。）

college-writing-002884.en: Here is a selection that makes good use of pronouns:
college-writing-002884.zh: 以下是一段充分利用代词的段落：

college-writing-002885.en: Lake Bled, Slovenia, is a destination worth visiting.
college-writing-002885.zh: 斯洛文尼亚的布雷德湖是一个值得一去的景点。

college-writing-002886.en: It is a small village in the Julian Alps, and the mountains surrounding the town are so magnificent that they inspire complete awe.
college-writing-002886.zh: 这是一个位于朱利安阿尔卑斯山区的小村庄，环绕小镇的山脉十分壮观，令人心生敬畏。

college-writing-002887.en: In the middle of the lake is the only island in the country, and to get to it, visitors have to take special flat-bottom boats.
college-writing-002887.zh: 湖中央有一座该国的唯一岛屿，要到达那里，游客必须乘坐特制的平底船。

college-writing-002888.en: While they are beautiful, they tip easily, so the boatmen are very careful about how they assign seats.
college-writing-002888.zh: 虽然它们很漂亮，但容易倾倒，因此船夫在分配座位时非常小心。

college-writing-002889.en: Most visitors go to the island to visit the church, but first they have to ascend the Baroque stairway.
college-writing-002889.zh: 大多数游客前往该岛是为了参观教堂，但首先他们必须登上巴洛克风格的楼梯。

college-writing-002890.en: It was built in 1655 and has ninety-nine steps leading to the church.
college-writing-002890.zh: 它建于1655年，有99级台阶通往教堂。

college-writing-002891.en: Many visitors have to stop numerous times before they are able to get to the top.
college-writing-002891.zh: 许多游客不得不多次停下来，才能到达山顶。

college-writing-002892.en: Luckily, the coffee shop offers them a place to rest before they finish their journey to the church.
college-writing-002892.zh: 幸运的是，咖啡店为他们提供了休息的地方，让他们在前往教堂的途中能够稍作休整。

college-writing-002893.en: Once people are done visiting the island, they can return to the shores of the lake and visit the small town of Bled or the romantic Bled Castle.
college-writing-002893.zh: 人们参观完这个岛屿后，可以回到湖边，去游览布雷德小镇或那座充满浪漫气息的布雷德城堡。

college-writing-002896.en: Synonyms are words alike in meaning.
college-writing-002896.zh: 同义词是指含义相近的词语。

college-writing-002897.en: Using synonyms can also help move the reader easily from one thought to the next.
college-writing-002897.zh: 使用同义词也能帮助读者轻松地从一个想法过渡到另一个想法。

college-writing-002898.en: In addition, the use of synonyms increases variety and interest by avoiding needless repetition.
college-writing-002898.zh: 此外，使用同义词能够避免不必要的重复，从而增加多样性与趣味性。

college-writing-002899.en: Note the synonyms for method in the following selection:
college-writing-002899.zh: 注意以下选段中“方法”的同义词：

college-writing-002900.en: Several methods of fund-raising work well with small organizations.
college-writing-002900.zh: 几种筹款方法适用于小型组织。

college-writing-002901.en: One technique is to hold an auction, with everyone either contributing an item from home or obtaining a donation from a sympathetic local merchant.
college-writing-002901.zh: 一种方法是举办拍卖会，每个人都可以从家中提供物品，或者从有善心的当地商人那里获得捐赠物。

college-writing-002902.en: Because all the merchandise and the services of the auctioneer have been donated, the entire proceeds can be placed in the organization’s treasury.
college-writing-002902.zh: 由于拍卖商所有的商品和服务都已被捐赠，所有收益都可以存入该组织的资金中。

college-writing-002903.en: A second fund-raising procedure is a car wash.
college-writing-002903.zh: 第二种筹款方式是洗车活动。

college-writing-002904.en: Club members and their children get together on a Saturday and wash all the cars in the neighborhood for a few dollars apiece.
college-writing-002904.zh: 俱乐部成员及其子女会在周六聚在一起，以每人的几美元费用清洗社区里的所有汽车。

college-writing-002905.en: A third, time-tested way to raise money is to hold a bake sale, with each family contributing homemade cookies, brownies, layer cakes, or cupcakes.
college-writing-002905.zh: 第三种经过时间验证的筹款方式是举办烘焙义卖活动，每个家庭可以贡献自制的饼干、布朗尼、层饼或纸杯蛋糕。

college-writing-002906.en: Sold by the piece or by the box, these baked goods will satisfyingly fill both the stomach and the pocketbook.
college-writing-002906.zh: 无论是按件购买还是按盒购买，这些烘焙食品都能让人的胃和钱包都感到满足。

college-writing-002907.en: Read the selection below and then answer the questions about it that follow.
college-writing-002907.zh: 阅读下面的选段，然后回答后续关于该选段的问题。

college-writing-002909.en: 1 When I think about my childhood in the 1930s, life today seems like the greatest of luxuries.
college-writing-002909.zh: 1. 当我想起 1930 年代的童年时，今天的生活似乎是最奢侈的。

college-writing-002910.en: 2In our house, we had only a wood-burning cookstove in the kitchen to keep us warm.
college-writing-002910.zh: 在我们家，厨房里只有一个燃烧木头的炉灶，用来取暖。

college-writing-002911.en: 3In the morning, my father would get up in the icy cold, go downstairs, and light a fire in the black iron range.
college-writing-002911.zh: 早上，父亲会在寒冷的天气中起床，下楼后，在黑铁炉里生火。

college-writing-002912.en: 4 When he called us, I would put off leaving my warm bed until the last possible minute and then quickly grab my school clothes.
college-writing-002912.zh: 4. 当他打电话给我们时，我会把温暖的床推迟到最后一分钟，然后迅速抓住我的校服。

college-writing-002913.en: 5 The water pitcher and washing basin in my room would be layered with ice, and my breath would come out as white puffs as I ran downstairs.
college-writing-002913.zh: 5. 我房间里的水壶和洗手盆会被冰层覆盖，当我跑下楼时，我的呼吸会像白色的粉扑一样浮出水面。

college-writing-002914.en: 6My sisters and I would all dress—as quickly as possible—in the chilly but bearable air of the kitchen.
college-writing-002914.zh: 我和我的姐妹们会尽快穿上——在寒冷但可忍受的厨房环境中。

college-writing-002915.en: 7 Our schoolroom, once we had arrived, didn’t provide much relief from the cold.
college-writing-002915.zh: 7. 我们的教室，一旦我们到达，并没有从寒冷中缓解太多。

college-writing-002916.en: 8 Students wore woolen mitts that left their fingers free but covered their palms and wrists.
college-writing-002916.zh: 8. 学生们戴着羊毛手套，手指自由，但遮住了手掌和手腕。

college-writing-002917.en: 9 Even with these, we occasionally suffered chilblains.
college-writing-002917.zh: 9. 即使有这些，我们偶尔也会遭受冻疮。

college-writing-002918.en: 10 The throbbing swellings on our hands made writing a painful process.
college-writing-002918.zh: 10. 我们手上跳动的肿胀使写作成为一个痛苦的过程。

college-writing-002919.en: 11 When we returned home in the afternoon, we spent all our indoor hours in the warm kitchen.
college-writing-002919.zh: 11. 当我们下午回到家时，我们把所有的室内时间都花在了温暖的厨房里。

college-writing-002920.en: 12We hated to leave it at bedtime to make the return trip to those cold bedrooms and frigid sheets.
college-writing-002920.zh: 我们不愿在就寝时间离开那里，那样就要回到那些寒冷的卧室和冰冷的床单中。

college-writing-002921.en: 13My mother made up hot-water bottles and gave us hot bricks to tuck under the covers, but nothing could eliminate the agony of that penetrating cold when we first slid under the bedclothes.
college-writing-002921.zh: 13 我母亲制作了热水袋，还给我们准备了暖砖，让我们把暖砖放在被罩下。但无论怎样，当我们刚钻进被褥下时那种刺骨的寒冷还是无法消除的。

college-writing-002922.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 99
college-writing-002922.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 99

college-writing-002923.en: 1. How many times is the key word cold used?
college-writing-002923.zh: “cold”这个关键词被使用了多少次？

college-writing-002924.en: 2. Write here the pronoun that is used for father (sentence 4):
college-writing-002924.zh: 2. 在此处填写用于“父亲”的代词（第4句）：

college-writing-002925.en: 3. Write here the words in sentence 3 that are used as a synonym for cookstove: ; write in the words in sentence 10 that are used as a synonym for chilblains: ; write in the word in sentence 12 that is used as a synonym for cold: .
college-writing-002925.zh: 3. 在此处写下第3句中作为“炉子”同词的词语；写下第10句中作为“冻疮”同词的词语；写下第12句中作为“寒冷”同词的词语。

college-writing-002927.en: So far, this chapter has discussed ways to organize and connect the supporting paragraphs of an essay.
college-writing-002927.zh: 到目前为止，本章讨论了如何组织和连接文章的辅助段落。

college-writing-002928.en: A well-organized essay, however, also needs a strong introductory paragraph, an effective concluding paragraph, and a good title.
college-writing-002928.zh: 然而，一篇组织良好的文章还需要一个有力的引言段、一个有效的结尾段，以及一个好的标题。

college-writing-002929.en: Introductory Paragraph Functions of the Introduction
college-writing-002929.zh: 引言段落 引言的功能

college-writing-002930.en: A well-written introductory paragraph performs four important roles:
college-writing-002930.zh: 一篇写得很好的引言段落具有四个重要的作用：

college-writing-002931.en: 1. It attracts readers’ interest, encouraging them to continue reading the essay.
college-writing-002931.zh: 1. 它能吸引读者的兴趣，促使他们继续阅读这篇文章。

college-writing-002932.en: 2. It supplies any background information that readers may need to understand the essay.
college-writing-002932.zh: 2. 它提供任何读者可能需要的背景信息，以帮助他们理解这篇文章。

college-writing-002933.zh: 3. 它提出了一种中心论点句。

college-writing-002934.en: This clear, direct statement of the main idea of the paper usually appears near the end of the introductory paragraph.
college-writing-002934.zh: 对本文核心观点的清晰、直白的陈述通常出现在引言段落的末尾。

college-writing-002935.en: 4. It indicates a plan of development.

college-writing-002936.en: In this preview, the major supporting points for the thesis are listed in the order in which they will be presented.
college-writing-002936.zh: 在这一预览中，论点的主要支撑点按呈现顺序列出。

college-writing-002937.en: In some cases, the thesis and plan of development appear in the same sentence.
college-writing-002937.zh: 有时，中心论点和展开提纲出现在同一句话中。

college-writing-002938.en: However, writers sometimes choose not to describe the plan of development.
college-writing-002938.zh: 不过，作者有时会选择省略展开提纲。

college-writing-002940.en: Here are some common methods of introduction.
college-writing-002940.zh: 以下是一些常见的引入方法。

college-writing-002941.en: Use any one method, or a combination of methods, to introduce your subject to the reader in an interesting way.
college-writing-002941.zh: 使用任意一种方法或多种方法的组合，以有趣的方式向读者介绍你的主题。

college-writing-002942.en: • Begin with a broad, general statement of your topic and narrow it down to your thesis statement.
college-writing-002942.zh: • 首先提出关于该主题的宽泛总体陈述，然后将其缩小到你的中心论点句上。

college-writing-002943.en: Broad, general statements ease the reader into your thesis statement by first introducing the topic.
college-writing-002943.zh: 宽泛、概括性的陈述先引入主题，再自然地把读者引向中心论点句。

college-writing-002944.en: In the following example, the writer talks generally about categories of students and then narrows down to comments on a specific type.
college-writing-002944.zh: 在以下示例中，作者先总体介绍了各类学生，然后具体针对某一种类型进行评论。

college-writing-002946.zh: 学校将人分为不同类别。

college-writing-002947.en: From the early grades, students are labeled “college track” or “vocational-technical” or “model citizen” or “trouble-maker.”
college-writing-002947.zh: 从小学阶段开始，学生就被标记为“大学预备生”、“职业技术类学生”、“模范公民”或“惹事生”。

college-writing-002948.en: Students pigeonhole their fellow students, too.
college-writing-002948.zh: 学生也会把其他学生归为特定的类别。

college-writing-002949.en: We’ve all known the “brain,” the “jock,” the “clown,” and the “teacher’s pet.”
college-writing-002949.zh: 我们都知道那种“学霸”、“运动员”、“小丑”以及“老师的宠儿”。

college-writing-002950.en: In most cases, these narrow labels are misleading and inaccurate.
college-writing-002950.zh: 在大多数情况下，这些狭窄的标签具有误导性且不准确。

college-writing-002951.en: But there is one label for a certain type of college student that says it all: “zombie.”
college-writing-002951.zh: 但有一种标签能概括某种类型的大学生：那就是“僵尸”。

college-writing-002952.zh: 大多数美国人并非酗酒者。

college-writing-002953.en: Most do not cruise city streets looking to score cocaine or heroin.
college-writing-002953.zh: 大多数人不会在城市街道上寻找可卡因或海洛因。

college-writing-002954.en: Relatively few try to con their doctors into prescribing unneeded mood-altering medications.
college-writing-002954.zh: 相对较少的人试图欺骗医生，要求他们开不必要的调节情绪的药物。

college-writing-002955.en: And yet, many Americans are traveling through life with their minds slightly out of kilter.
college-writing-002955.zh: 然而，许多美国人一生中都处于精神稍显不平稳的状态。

college-writing-002956.en: In its attempt to cope with modern life, the human mind seems to have evolved some defense strategies.
college-writing-002956.zh: 为了应对现代生活，人类大脑似乎演化出了一些防御策略。

college-writing-002957.en: Confronted with inventions like television, the shopping center, and the Internet, the mind will slip—all by itself—into an altered state.
college-writing-002957.zh: 面对电视、购物中心和互联网这类发明，人的思维会自然而然地陷入一种改变的状态。

college-writing-002958.en: Happy Child Preschool is a valuable and cherished part of our campus, but enrollment has declined dramatically over the past two years.
college-writing-002958.zh: 快乐儿童幼儿园是我们校园中珍贵且受重视的组成部分，但过去两年里入学人数大幅减少。

college-writing-002959.en: Thus, a task force was commissioned to analyze the causes.
college-writing-002959.zh: 因此，成立了一个特别小组来分析其原因。

college-writing-002960.en: The comparative analysis conducted by the task force uncovered numerous ways that other campus childcare centers have achieved success through advertising.
college-writing-002960.zh: 该小组进行的比较分析发现，其他校园儿童保育中心通过广告宣传取得了成功，这些方式多种多样。

college-writing-002961.en: The task force agrees that promotion is the number one issue that has been overlooked in the past and the area where major and immediate improvements are essential to the long-term success of the center.
college-writing-002961.zh: 特别工作组认为，推广是过去被忽视的首要问题，也是必须立即进行重大改进的领域，因为这对中心的长期发展至关重要。

college-writing-002962.en: In order to effectively market the preschool, promoting the center needs to remain at the top of the priority chart and should include proper advertising, publicity, and referrals.
college-writing-002962.zh: 为了有效推广幼儿园业务，该中心必须处于优先事项列表的顶端，并应开展适当的广告、宣传及推荐活动。

college-writing-002963.en: • Start with an idea or a situation that is the opposite of the one you will develop.
college-writing-002963.zh: • 从与你要开发的想法或情境完全相反的一个想法或情境开始。

college-writing-002964.en: This approach works because your readers will be surprised, and then intrigued, by the contrast between the opening idea and the thesis that follows it.
college-writing-002964.zh: 这种策略之所以有效，是因为读者会因开篇观点与后续论点之间的对比而感到惊讶，进而产生兴趣。

college-writing-002965.en: • Explain the importance of your topic to the reader.
college-writing-002965.zh: • 向读者说明你的主题的重要性。

college-writing-002966.en: If you can convince your readers that the subject in some way applies to them, or is something they should know more about, they will want to keep reading.
college-writing-002966.zh: 如果你能够让读者相信这个主题与他们有某种关联，或者是他们应该了解的内容，他们就会愿意继续阅读。

college-writing-002969.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 101
college-writing-002969.zh: 第四章 写作入门第101课的第三步

college-writing-002970.en: • Use an incident or a brief story.
college-writing-002970.zh: • 使用一个事件或简短的故事。

college-writing-002971.zh: 故事本身自然就很有趣。

college-writing-002972.en: They appeal to a reader’s curiosity.
college-writing-002972.zh: 它们激发着读者的好奇心。

college-writing-002973.en: In your introduction, an anecdote will grab the reader’s attention right away.
college-writing-002973.zh: 在引言部分，一个有趣的轶事能立刻吸引读者的注意力。

college-writing-002974.en: The story should be brief and should be related to your main idea.
college-writing-002974.zh: 故事应该简短，并且要与你的主要观点相关。

college-writing-002975.en: The incident in the story can be something that happened to you, something you have heard about, or something you have read about in a newspaper or magazine.
college-writing-002975.zh: 故事中的事件可能是你亲身经历的事情，也可能是你听说的，或者你在报纸或杂志上读到的内容。

college-writing-002976.en: Early Sunday morning, the young mother dressed her little girl warmly and gave her a candy bar, a picture book, and a well-worn stuffed rabbit.
college-writing-002976.zh: 周日清晨，年轻的母亲给她的女儿穿上了温暖的衣服，送了她一块糖果、一本图画书，以及一只用旧了的毛绒兔子。

college-writing-002977.en: Together, they drove downtown to a Methodist church.
college-writing-002977.zh: 他们一起驱车前往市中心的一座卫理公会教堂。

college-writing-002978.en: There the mother told the little girl to wait on the stone steps until children began arriving for Sunday school.
college-writing-002978.zh: 那时，母亲让小女孩在石阶上等待，直到孩子们来上主日学校课程。

college-writing-002979.en: Then the young mother drove off, abandoning her five-year-old because she couldn’t cope with being a parent anymore.
college-writing-002979.zh: 然后，那位年轻的母亲开车离开了，抛弃了她五岁的孩子，因为她再也无法承担为人母的责任了。

college-writing-002980.en: This incident is one of thousands of cases of child neglect and abuse that occur annually.
college-writing-002980.zh: 这起事件是每年发生的数千起儿童忽视和虐待案例之一。

college-writing-002981.en: Stories like this one highlight the need for better social programs to help struggling parents.
college-writing-002981.zh: 这样的故事凸显了需要更好的社会计划来帮助那些陷入困境的父母。

college-writing-002982.en: “Life is not fair, but with education you have a fair chance at life,” stated Tyrone J. Flowers, founder of Higher M-Pact, at the spring Excellence in Teaching awards ceremony.
college-writing-002982.zh: “生活并不公平，但通过教育，你就有公平的生活机会，”Higher M-Pact的创始人泰隆·J·弗劳尔斯在春季教学卓越奖颁奖典礼上说道。

college-writing-002983.en: As I listened to him, I realized that my desire to keep teaching was stronger than ever because I believe that education is the key to changing a life.
college-writing-002983.zh: 听着他的话，我意识到自己继续教学的渴望比以往更加强烈，因为我相信教育是改变人生的关键。

college-writing-002984.en: Many of my students come to my classroom underprepared and living in terrible situations, but it is my job to open their eyes to the possibilities.
college-writing-002984.zh: 我的许多学生来我的教室时准备不足，生活状况也很糟糕，但我的职责就是让他们意识到各种可能性。

college-writing-002985.en: Before I heard Mr. Flowers speak, I had been considering getting out of education, but his words inspired in me a new desire to become a better teacher.
college-writing-002985.zh: 在听到弗劳尔斯先生的演讲之前，我正考虑放弃教育行业，但他的话激发了我成为更优秀的教师的愿望。

college-writing-002987.en: A quotation can be something you have read in a book or an article.
college-writing-002987.zh: 报价可能来自你读过的书籍或文章。

college-writing-002988.en: It can also be something that you have heard: a popular saying or proverb (“Never give advice to a friend”), a current or recent advertising slogan (“Can you hear me now?”), or a favorite expression used by friends or family (“My father always says . . .”).
college-writing-002988.zh: 它也可能是你听过的某句话：一句流行的谚语或格言（“永远不要给朋友建议”），一个当前的或最近的广告口号（“你现在能听到我说话吗？”），或是朋友或家人常用的表达方式（“我父亲总是说……”）。

college-writing-002989.en: Using a quotation in your introductory paragraph lets you add someone else’s voice to your own.
college-writing-002989.zh: 在引言段落中使用引文，能让你将自己的观点与他人的观点相结合。

college-writing-002990.en: The box that follows summarizes the five kinds of introductions.
college-writing-002990.zh: 下面的框内容概述了五种介绍方式。

college-writing-002991.en: Read the introductions that come after it and, in the space provided, write the letter of the kind of introduction used in each case.
college-writing-002991.zh: 阅读其后的介绍内容，并在提供的空间中写出每种情况下所使用的介绍方式。

college-writing-002994.en: 1. The commercial begins with a shot of a beautiful, modern kitchen.
college-writing-002994.zh: 影片以一段美丽的现代厨房场景作为开头。

college-writing-002995.en: The focus sweeps to the clean counters, top-of-the-line appliances, and then focuses on a shiny, industrial-strength red blender.
college-writing-002995.zh: 焦点逐渐转移到干净整洁的台面、高端电器上，然后落在那闪亮、具有工业级性能的红色搅拌机上。

college-writing-002996.en: The next shot shows an attractive, athletically trim couple surrounded by gorgeous fruits, vegetables, and leafy greens, making delicious-looking smoothies.
college-writing-002996.zh: 下一张照片中，一对英俊潇洒的夫妇被美丽的水果、蔬菜和绿叶蔬菜环绕着，他们正在制作美味可口的冰沙。

college-writing-002997.en: As they add the fruits and greens to the blender, they smile and laugh as if this is the most wonderful thing to be doing in the morning.
college-writing-002997.zh: 当他们将水果和蔬菜放入搅拌机中时，他们微笑着、笑着，仿佛这是早晨最令人愉悦的事情。

college-writing-002998.en: The announcer claims that using this blender is the one change that will make being healthy easy.
college-writing-002998.zh: 播报员声称，使用这种搅拌器是让保持健康变得容易的唯一改变。

college-writing-002999.en: Viewers should not be taken in.

college-writing-003000.en: My blender turned out to be expensive, difficult to operate, and incredibly loud.
college-writing-003000.zh: 我的搅拌机价格昂贵，操作起来很困难，而且噪音极大。

college-writing-003001.en: 2. My father stubbornly says, “You can often tell a book by its cover,”
college-writing-003001.zh: 2. 我父亲固执地说：“通常可以通过书的封面来判断一本书。”

college-writing-003002.en: and when it comes to certain paperbacks, he’s right.
college-writing-003002.zh: 至于某些通俗读物，他是对的。

college-writing-003003.en: Whenever a person is browsing in the drugstore or supermarket and he or she sees a paperback featuring an attractive young woman in a low-cut dress fleeing from a handsome dark figure in a shadowy castle, it is obvious what the book will be about.
college-writing-003003.zh: 每当有人在药店或超市里浏览时，看到一本以穿着低胸裙的性感年轻女子在逃离一个英俊黑衣人、身处阴暗城堡中的场景为内容的纸质书，就能明白这本书的主题是什么了。

college-writing-003004.en: Every romance novel has the same elements: an innocent heroine, an exotic setting, and a mysterious hero.
college-writing-003004.zh: 每一本言情小说都包含相同的元素：无辜的女主角、异域的背景，以及神秘的男主角。

college-writing-003005.en: 3. We humans can be incredibly lazy.
college-writing-003005.zh: 3. 我们人类可能会极其懒惰。

college-writing-003006.zh: 而不是做一道简单的菜，

college-writing-003007.en: nourishing meal, we pop a frozen dinner into the oven.
college-writing-003007.zh: 吃一顿滋养的餐食后，我们把冷冻晚餐放入烤箱中。

college-writing-003008.en: Instead of studying a daily newspaper, we are contented with the capsule summaries on the network news.
college-writing-003008.zh: 我们并不研究日报，而是满足于网络新闻的简短摘要。

college-writing-003009.en: Worst of all, instead of walking even a few blocks to the local convenience store, we jump into our cars.
college-writing-003009.zh: 最糟糕的是，我们甚至不步行几条街就直接坐进车里，去当地的便利商店。

college-writing-003010.en: This dependence on the automobile, even for short trips, has robbed us of a valuable experience─walking.
college-writing-003010.zh: 这种对汽车的依赖，甚至对于短途出行而言，也让我们失去了一种宝贵的体验——步行。

college-writing-003011.en: If we drove less and walked more, we would save money, become healthier, and discover fascinating things about our surroundings.
college-writing-003011.zh: 如果我们少开车、多步行，就能节省开支、保持健康，还能发现我们周围世界的奇妙之处。

college-writing-003012.en: Concluding Paragraph A concluding paragraph is your chance to remind the reader of your thesis idea and bring the paper to a natural and graceful end.
college-writing-003012.zh: 结论段：结论段是您提醒读者您的论点观点、并让文章以自然、优雅的方式结束的机会。

college-writing-003014.zh: B. 从相反的方向开始

college-writing-003015.zh: C. 阐述主题的重要性

college-writing-003018.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 103
college-writing-003018.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 103

college-writing-003020.en: You may use any one of the methods below, or a combination of methods, to round off your paper.
college-writing-003020.zh: 你可以使用以下方法中的任意一种，或多种方法的组合，来对你的论文进行四舍五入。

college-writing-003021.en: • End with a summary and final thought.
college-writing-003021.zh: • 以总结和最终思考作为结尾。

college-writing-003022.en: When army instructors train new recruits, each of their lessons follows a three-step formula:
college-writing-003022.zh: 当军队教官培训新兵时，他们的每一节课都遵循一个三步流程：

college-writing-003023.en: 1. Tell them what you’re going to tell them.
college-writing-003023.zh: 1. 把你要告诉他们的内容告诉他们。

college-writing-003025.en: 3. Tell them what you’ve told them.
college-writing-003025.zh: 3. 把你告诉他们的那些话再重复一遍。

college-writing-003026.en: An essay that ends with a summary is not very different.
college-writing-003026.zh: 以总结结尾的文章并没有什么不同。

college-writing-003027.en: After you have stated your thesis (“Tell them what you’re going to tell them”) and supported it (“Tell them”), you restate the thesis and supporting points (“Tell them what you’ve told them”).
college-writing-003027.zh: 在阐述了你的论点（“告诉他们你要说什么”）并提供了支持依据（“告诉他们”）之后，你再次重申论点及支持观点（“把已经说过的再告诉他们”）。

college-writing-003028.en: However, don’t use the exact wording you used before.
college-writing-003028.zh: 不过，不要使用之前使用的确切表述。

college-writing-003030.en: Online shopping at home, then, has several advantages.
college-writing-003030.zh: 因此，在家进行在线购物具有诸多优势。

college-writing-003031.en: Such shopping is convenient, saves money, and saves time.
college-writing-003031.zh: 这种购物方式既方便，又能节省金钱和时间。

college-writing-003032.en: It is not surprising that growing numbers of people are doing the majority of their shopping on the Internet for everything from turnip seeds to televisions.
college-writing-003032.zh: 并不奇怪的是，越来越多的人在互联网上进行大部分购物行为，从萝卜种子到电视都包括在内。

college-writing-003033.en: Rude behavior has become commonplace and needs to stop.
college-writing-003033.zh: 无礼的行为已经变得普遍，必须停止。

college-writing-003034.en: People no longer treat each other with the respect and courtesy they should.
college-writing-003034.zh: 人们不再以应有的尊重与礼貌来对待彼此。

college-writing-003035.en: People talk on their cell phones at inappropriate times and places.
college-writing-003035.zh: 人们在不合时宜的场合使用手机交谈。

college-writing-003036.en: Cutting off other drivers in order to save mere seconds happens more and more often.
college-writing-003036.zh: 为了节省仅仅几秒时间，人们越来越常切断其他驾驶员的动力。

college-writing-003037.en: As the Dalai Lama said, “Love and kindness are the very basis of society. If we lose these feelings, society will face tremendous difficulties; the survival of humanity will be endangered.”
college-writing-003037.zh: 正如达赖喇嘛所说：“爱与善良是社会的根本。如果我们失去这些情感，社会将面临巨大的困难；人类的生存也将受到威胁。”

college-writing-003038.en: Note that the summary is accompanied by a final comment that rounds off the paper and brings the discussion to a close.
college-writing-003038.zh: 请注意，该摘要后面还附有最终评论，用于总结本文内容并结束讨论。

college-writing-003039.en: This combination of a summary and a final thought is the most common method of concluding an essay.
college-writing-003039.zh: 这种总结与最终观点相结合的写法，是结束文章时最常见的方式。

college-writing-003040.zh: • 包含一句能引发思考的引言。

college-writing-003041.en: A well-chosen quotation can be effective in re-emphasizing your point.
college-writing-003041.zh: 一个选得恰当的引文能够有效重申你的观点。

college-writing-003043.en: • End with a prediction or recommendation.
college-writing-003043.zh: • 以预测或建议作为结尾。

college-writing-003044.en: Predictions and recommendations encourage the reader to continue thinking about the essay.
college-writing-003044.zh: 这些预测与建议鼓励读者继续思考这篇文章。

college-writing-003045.en: A prediction states what may happen in the future:
college-writing-003045.zh: 一项预测说明了未来可能发生的情况：

college-writing-003046.zh: 104 第一部分 论文写作

college-writing-003047.en: In the space provided, note how each concluding paragraph ends: with a summary and final thought (write S in the space), with a prediction or recommendation (write P/R), or with a quotation (write Q).
college-writing-003047.zh: 在提供的空间里，请注意每个结尾段落的结束方式：以总结与最终观点结束（在空格中写S），以预测或建议结束（写P/R），或以引用结束（写Q）。

college-writing-003048.en: 1. Disappointments are unwelcome, but regular, visitors in everyone’s
college-writing-003048.zh: 1. 失望是令人不快的，但定期来访的客人，每个人都是……

college-writing-003050.en: We can feel depressed about them, or we can try to escape from them.
college-writing-003050.zh: 我们可以因他们而感到沮丧，也可以试图逃离他们。

college-writing-003051.en: The best thing, though, is to accept a disappointment and then try to use it somehow: step over the unwelcome visitor and then get on with life.
college-writing-003051.zh: 不过，最好的做法就是接受这种失望，然后设法利用它：跨过那个不想要的“障碍”，继续过下去。

college-writing-003052.en: 2. Saving the environment is up to each of us.
college-writing-003052.zh: 2. 保护环境是每个人的责任。

college-writing-003054.en: emissions would drop dramatically if we chose to carpool or take public transportation more often.
college-writing-003054.zh: 如果我们更频繁地选择拼车或乘坐公共交通，排放量将会显著下降。

college-writing-003055.en: Conserving fuel and electricity at home by sealing up leaky windows and using energy-saving light bulbs would help, too.
college-writing-003055.zh: 通过密封漏窗以及使用节能灯泡来节约家庭中的燃料和电力，也会起到帮助作用。

college-writing-003056.en: As David Orr once wrote, “When we heal the Earth, we heal ourselves.”
college-writing-003056.zh: 正如大卫·奥尔曾经所说：“当我们治愈地球时，我们也在治愈自己。”

college-writing-003057.en: 3. Some people dream of starring roles, their names in lights, and
college-writing-003057.zh: 3. 有些人梦想着扮演主角，他们的名字被载入史册，

college-writing-003058.en: their pictures on the cover of People magazine.
college-writing-003058.zh: 他们在《人物》杂志封面的照片。

college-writing-003059.en: I’m not one of them, though.
college-writing-003059.zh: 不过，我不是他们中的一员。

college-writing-003060.en: A famous person gives up private life, feels pressured all the time, and is never completely safe.
college-writing-003060.zh: 一位名人放弃私人生活，时刻承受压力，永远无法完全安全。

college-writing-003061.en: So let someone else have that cover story.
college-writing-003061.zh: 那就让其他人来承担那个 Cover Story。

college-writing-003062.en: I’d rather lead an ordinary, but calm, life than a stress-filled one.
college-writing-003062.zh: 我宁愿过一种普通但平静的生活，也不愿过一种充满压力的生活。

college-writing-003064.en: It is believed that as many as two million people are currently undiagnosed with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.
college-writing-003064.zh: 据信，目前有高达两百万人尚未被诊断出患有乳糜泻或麸质敏感性疾病。

college-writing-003065.en: There is currently no medication to cure the disease.
college-writing-003065.zh: 目前没有能够治愈该疾病的药物。

college-writing-003066.en: If doctors disregard patients who complain of symptoms of the disease, serious physical damage can occur.
college-writing-003066.zh: 如果医生忽视那些抱怨该疾病症状的患者，就会造成严重的身体损害。

college-writing-003067.en: But if doctors listen to their patients and administer the appropriate tests, proper diagnosis can be made in a timely manner.
college-writing-003067.zh: 但如果医生倾听患者的诉求并进行适当的检查，就能及时做出正确的诊断。

college-writing-003068.en: Stereotypes such as the ditzy blonde, harried executive, and annoying in-law are insulting enough to begin with.
college-writing-003068.zh: 诸如“愚蠢的金发女郎”、“疲惫不堪的高管”以及“烦人的岳父/岳母”这类刻板印象本身就带有侮辱性。

college-writing-003069.en: In magazine ads or television commercials, they become even more insulting.
college-writing-003069.zh: 在杂志广告或电视广告中，它们则显得更加侮辱性。

college-writing-003070.en: Now these unfortunate characters are not just being laughed at; they are being turned into hucksters to sell products to an unsuspecting public.
college-writing-003070.zh: 现在，这些不幸的人不再只是被嘲笑，他们还被当作骗子，向毫无戒备的公众推销产品。

college-writing-003071.en: Consumers should boycott companies whose advertising continues to use such stereotypes.
college-writing-003071.zh: 消费者应抵制那些继续使用此类刻板印象进行广告宣传的公司。

college-writing-003072.en: A recommendation suggests what should be done about a situation or problem: _
college-writing-003072.zh: 一项建议指出了应对某种情况或问题的办法：_

college-writing-003073.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 105
college-writing-003073.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 105

college-writing-003074.en: Titles A title is usually a very brief summary of what your paper is about.
college-writing-003074.zh: 标题：标题通常是对论文内容的简短概述。

college-writing-003075.en: It is often no more than several words.

college-writing-003076.en: You may find it easier to write the title after you have completed your paper.
college-writing-003076.zh: 完成论文后，你可能会觉得撰写标题更为容易。

college-writing-003077.en: Following are the introductory paragraphs for two of the essays in this text, along with the titles of the essays.
college-writing-003077.zh: 以下是本文中两篇文章的引言段落及文章标题。

college-writing-003078.en: I’m not just a consumer—I’m a victim.
college-writing-003078.zh: 我不仅仅是一个消费者——我是一个受害者。

college-writing-003079.en: If I order a product, it is sure to arrive in the wrong color, size, or quantity.
college-writing-003079.zh: 如果我订购产品，它很可能会以错误的颜色、尺寸或数量送达。

college-writing-003080.en: If I hire people to do repairs, they never arrive on the day scheduled.
college-writing-003080.zh: 如果我雇佣人进行维修工作，他们从来不会按预定的时间到达。

college-writing-003081.en: If I owe a bill, the computer is bound to overcharge me.
college-writing-003081.zh: 如果我欠了账单，电脑肯定会多收我钱。

college-writing-003082.en: Therefore, in self-defense, I have developed the following consumer’s guide to complaining effectively.
college-writing-003082.zh: 因此，出于自卫的考虑，我制定了以下有效投诉指南，供消费者参考。

college-writing-003084.zh: 学校将人分为不同类别。

college-writing-003085.en: From the early grades, students are labeled “college track” or “vocational-technical” or “model citizen” or “trouble-maker.”
college-writing-003085.zh: 从小学阶段开始，学生就被标记为“大学预备生”、“职业技术类学生”、“模范公民”或“惹事生”。

college-writing-003086.en: Students pigeonhole their fellow students, too.
college-writing-003086.zh: 学生也会把其他学生归为特定的类别。

college-writing-003087.en: We’ve all known the “brain,” the “jock,” the “clown,” and the “teacher’s pet.”
college-writing-003087.zh: 我们都知道那种“学霸”、“运动员”、“小丑”以及“老师的宠儿”。

college-writing-003088.en: In most cases, these narrow labels are misleading and inaccurate.
college-writing-003088.zh: 在大多数情况下，这些狭窄的标签具有误导性且不准确。

college-writing-003089.en: But there is one label for a certain type of college student that says it all: “zombie.”
college-writing-003089.zh: 但有一种标签能概括某种类型的大学生：那就是“僵尸”。

college-writing-003091.en: Note that you should not underline the title.
college-writing-003091.zh: 请注意，不应对标题进行下划线。

college-writing-003092.en: Nor should you put quotation marks around it.
college-writing-003092.zh: 也不应该用引号将其括起来。

college-writing-003093.en: On the other hand, you should capitalize all but small connecting words in the title.
college-writing-003093.zh: 另一方面，标题中除小连接词外，其余所有词都应大写。

college-writing-003094.en: Also, you should skip a space between the title and the first line of the text.
college-writing-003094.zh: 此外，标题与文本第一行之间不应有空格。

college-writing-003096.en: Write an appropriate title for each of the introductory paragraphs that follow.
college-writing-003096.zh: 为接下来的每个引言段落编写一个合适的标题。

college-writing-003097.en: 1. Returning to my hometown of Mercyville after five years, I discovered several newcomers on the same street as the pharmacy, hardware store, and restaurants I had patronized.
college-writing-003097.zh: 在离开家乡梅尔西维尔五年后回到这里，我发现与那些药店、五金店和餐馆同一条街上，还有几位新来的人。

college-writing-003098.en: A store selling African art had opened next to my favorite pizzeria.
college-writing-003098.zh: 我最喜欢的披萨店旁边开了一家出售非洲艺术的商店。

college-writing-003099.en: A few doors down was a Thai take-out restaurant, and across the street a Hindu grocer had set up shop.
college-writing-003099.zh: 离这里几扇门远的地方有一家泰国外卖餐厅，街对面的地方则有一家印度杂货店。

college-writing-003100.en: In the storefront where Charlie’s Hamburgers was once located, I found a fancy Hungarian bistro featuring an elegant New Year’s Eve dinner for $90 per person.
college-writing-003100.zh: 在查理汉堡店曾经所在的店铺里，我发现了一家豪华的匈牙利小酒馆，提供价格为每人90美元的优雅新年夜晚餐。

college-writing-003102.en: 2. When my parents bought a new home in a small town outside Chicago, they decided to fence in our yard so that our two Labrador retrievers
college-writing-003102.zh: 2. 当我的父母在芝加哥郊外的一个小镇买了新房子后，他们决定在院子里装围栏，以便让我们的两只拉布拉多猎犬有活动空间。

college-writing-003108.en: The contractor they hired informed them that they would have to apply for a permit, which would cost $150.
college-writing-003108.zh: 他们雇佣的承包商告诉他们，必须申请相关许可，费用为150美元。

college-writing-003109.en: After the shock wore off, my father went to town hall with the check, but the clerk informed him that he would have to submit an online request for the permit as well as a plot plan of our property.
college-writing-003109.zh: 冲击过后，父亲带着支票去了市政厅，但工作人员告诉他，他必须同时提交在线申请以及我们房产的规划方案才能获得许可。

college-writing-003110.en: After struggling with the online process for two hours, he called the office, but it was closed, and he realized he would have to wait until Monday to get help.
college-writing-003110.zh: 在为在线操作挣扎了两个小时后，他打电话到办公室，但办公室已经关门了，他意识到必须等到周一才能得到帮助。

college-writing-003111.en: After submitting everything, he learned that the town planning committee would not meet to consider our application for
college-writing-003111.zh: 提交完所有材料后，他得知镇规划委员会不会召开会议来审议我们的申请。

college-writing-003112.en: For further practice in writing titles, write an appropriate title for the image pictured here.
college-writing-003112.zh: 为了进一步练习写标题，请为这里展示的图像起一个合适的标题。

college-writing-003115.en: When they did meet, they refused to grant our permit because the proposed fence crossed a “designated wetlands” area, and they refused to refund our $150.
college-writing-003115.zh: 当他们实际见面时，他们拒绝发放我们的许可，因为所计划的围栏线穿过了一个“指定湿地”区域，他们也不愿意退还我们那150美元的款项。

college-writing-003117.en: 3. Having the ideal job doesn’t depend only on the amount of money it pays, the working conditions, or the opportunities for advancement.
college-writing-003117.zh: 3. 拥有理想的工作，不仅仅取决于其薪资水平、工作条件或晋升机会。

college-writing-003118.en: It also has to do with one’s fellow employees and, of course, the boss.
college-writing-003118.zh: 这也与同事以及老板有关。

college-writing-003119.en: While most people realize that bosses need to exercise careful supervision over the workplace and the employees, they prefer bosses who socialize with workers, make few demands, and look the other way when they don’t perform well.
college-writing-003119.zh: 虽然大多数人都明白，管理者需要对工作场所和员工进行严格的监督，但他们更偏好那些与员工互动良好、要求少、在员工表现不佳时也不干预的领导者。

college-writing-003120.en: Unfortunately, such supervisors too often turn out to be inefficient, disorganized, and unpredictable.
college-writing-003120.zh: 不幸的是，这类主管往往效率低下、缺乏组织性且难以预测。

college-writing-003121.en: A better alternative is someone who enforces rules predictably and demands that workers meet reasonable expectations.
college-writing-003121.zh: 更好的选择是那些能够可预测地执行规则，并要求员工满足合理期望的人。

college-writing-003123.en: Chapter 4 The Third Step in Essay Writing 107
college-writing-003123.zh: 第四章 写作的第三步步骤 107

college-writing-003124.en: Practice in Organizing and Connecting Specific Evidence
college-writing-003124.zh: 整理与关联具体证据的实践

college-writing-003125.en: You now know the third step in effective writing: organizing the specific evidence used to support the thesis of a paper.
college-writing-003125.zh: 现在你知道有效写作的第三步：整理用于支撑论文论点的具体证据。

college-writing-003126.en: This closing section will expand and strengthen your understanding of the third step in writing.
college-writing-003126.zh: 这一结尾部分将帮助你更深入、更全面地理解写作的第三步。

college-writing-003127.en: You will work through the following series of activities:
college-writing-003127.zh: 你将完成以下一系列活动：

college-writing-003128.en: • organizing through time or emphatic order
college-writing-003128.zh: • 按时间或重要程度进行组织

college-writing-003130.en: • identifying transitions and other connecting words
college-writing-003130.zh: • 识别过渡词和其他连接词

college-writing-003133.en: Organizing through Time or Emphatic Order Use time order to organize the scrambled lists of supporting ideas below.
college-writing-003133.zh: 按时间或重点顺序进行整理：利用时间顺序对下面那些混乱的支撑观点列表进行整理。

college-writing-003134.en: Write 1 beside the supporting idea that should come first in time, 2 beside the idea that logically follows, and 3 beside the idea that comes last in time.
college-writing-003134.zh: 在时间上应首先出现的支撑观点旁写1；在逻辑上紧随其后的观点旁写2；在时间上最后出现的观点旁写3。

college-writing-003135.en: 1. Thesis: When I was a child, Disney movies frightened me more than any other kind.

college-writing-003291.en: Read the three pairs of introductory and concluding paragraphs that follow.
college-writing-003291.zh: 阅读接下来的三段引言和结尾段落。

college-writing-003292.en: Then, in the spaces provided for each pair, write the letters of the kind of introduction and conclusion used in each paragraph.
college-writing-003292.zh: 然后，在每对对应的空格中，写下每个段落中使用的引言和结论的字母形式。

college-writing-003294.en: Introductions Conclusions A. General to narrow B. Starting with an opposite C. Stating importance of topic D. Incident or story E. Quotation
college-writing-003294.zh: 引言 结论 A. 从一般到具体 B. 以相反观点开始 C. 阐述主题的重要性 D. 事件或故事 E. 引文

college-writing-003295.en: F. Summary and final thought G. Quotation H. Prediction or recommendation
college-writing-003295.zh: F. 总结与最终思考  G. 引用  H. 预测或建议

college-writing-003298.en: Shortly before spring break, our local elementary school sponsored a fund-raising event at which classroom pets and their babies—hamsters, guinea pigs, and chicks—were available for adoption.
college-writing-003298.zh: 春假前夕，我们当地的小学举办了一场募捐活动，活动期间，教室里的宠物及其幼崽——仓鼠、豚鼠和小鸡——都可以被领养。

college-writing-003299.en: Afterward, as I was driving home, I saw a hand drop a baby hamster out of the car ahead of me. I barely avoided running over the tiny creature and quickly stopped to scoop it up.
college-writing-003299.zh: 之后，当我开车回家时，看到一只手从我前面的车里抛出了一只小仓鼠。我勉强没有碾到这个小生命，立刻停下来把它捡起来。

college-writing-003300.en: One of the parents had taken the pet, regretted the decision, and decided to get rid of it.
college-writing-003300.zh: 其中一位家长带走了宠物，后来后悔了决定，决定将其处理掉。

college-writing-003301.en: Such people have never stopped to consider the real obligations involved in owning a pet.
college-writing-003301.zh: 这些人从未停下来思考拥有宠物所涉及的真正责任。

college-writing-003302.en: A pet cannot be thrown onto a trash heap when it is no longer wanted or tossed into a closet if it begins to bore its owner.
college-writing-003302.zh: 当宠物开始令主人感到困扰时，就不能把它扔到垃圾堆里，或者扔进衣柜里。

college-writing-003303.en: A pet, like us, is a living thing that needs attention and care.
college-writing-003303.zh: 宠物和我们一样，都是需要关注与照顾的生命体。

college-writing-003304.en: Would-be owners, therefore, should think seriously about their responsibilities before they acquire a pet.
college-writing-003304.zh: 因此，潜在的宠物主人应在购买宠物之前认真考虑自己的责任。

college-writing-003306.en: Some forms of communication, like that of the bee, are through movement, while others include sound and movement.
college-writing-003306.zh: 某些形式的交流，如蜜蜂的交流方式，是通过动作进行的；而另一些则包含声音与动作。

college-writing-003307.en: Humans naturally communicate through a variety of methods, including body language and sounds, but they also communicate through methods that don’t require physical proximity.
college-writing-003307.zh: 人类自然会通过多种方式进行交流，包括肢体语言和声音，但他们也可以通过不需要身体接近的方式来进行交流。

college-writing-003308.en: Texts, phone calls, and e-mails are such forms of communication, often entailing serious drawbacks.
college-writing-003308.zh: 文本、电话和电子邮件都是沟通方式，往往带来严重的弊端。

college-writing-003310.en: Neither texts, phone calls, nor e-mails guarantee perfect communication.
college-writing-003310.zh: 无论是文本、电话还是电子邮件，都无法确保沟通的完美。

college-writing-003311.en: With all our sophisticated skills, we human beings often communicate less effectively than howling wolves or chattering monkeys.
college-writing-003311.zh: 尽管拥有各种高超的技能，我们人类在交流时往往不如咆哮的狼或喋喋不休的猴子有效。

college-writing-003312.en: We always seem to find some way to foul up the message.
college-writing-003312.zh: 我们总是能找到办法破坏信息的传递。

college-writing-003313.en: “Few things are harder to put up with,” said Mark Twain, “than the annoyance of a good example.”
college-writing-003313.zh: “很少有事情比看到好的榜样所带来的困扰更难以忍受，”马克·吐温说。

college-writing-003314.en: Twain obviously knew the problems faced by siblings cursed with older brothers or sisters who are models of perfection.
college-writing-003314.zh: 特韦恩显然知道那些拥有完美模样的兄长或姐长的兄弟姐妹所面临的困境。

college-writing-003315.en: All our lives, my older sister Shelley and I have been compared.
college-writing-003315.zh: 在我们的整个人生中，我和姐姐雪莉总是被拿来比较。

college-writing-003316.en: Unfortunately, in competition with my sister’s virtues, my looks, talents, and accomplishments always ended up on the losing side.
college-writing-003316.zh: 不幸的是，与姐姐的优点相比，我的外貌、才能和成就总是处于劣势。

college-writing-003317.en: Although I always lost in the sibling contests of looks, talents, and accomplishments, Shelley and I have somehow managed not to turn into deadly enemies.
college-writing-003317.zh: 虽然我在外貌、才能和成就方面总是输给兄弟姐妹们，但谢莉和我却设法没有变成死对头。

college-writing-003318.en: Feeling like the dud of the family, in fact, helped me to develop a drive to succeed and a sense of humor.
college-writing-003318.zh: 感觉自己像个无足轻重的人，实际上反而帮助我培养了追求成功的动力和幽默感。

college-writing-003319.en: In our sibling rivalry, we both managed to win.
college-writing-003319.zh: 在我们兄弟间的竞争中，我们两人都取得了胜利。

college-writing-003321.en: What differences do you notice about the students in the photograph above?
college-writing-003321.zh: 你注意到上图中的学生有什么不同吗？

college-writing-003322.en: Most likely, you can identify with at least a couple of them.
college-writing-003322.zh: 很可能，你至少能认同其中的几个。

college-writing-003323.en: Thinking about your own experiences in the classroom, write an essay about one or more teachers or instructors who have conducted classes that made you glad to learn or, alternatively, left you daydreaming in class.
college-writing-003323.zh: 回想一下你在课堂上的经历，写一篇关于某位或几位让你乐于学习，或者让你在课堂上一时入迷的教师的文章。

college-writing-003324.en: Once you have written your first draft, read it aloud to make sure all your sentences flow smoothly and clearly.
college-writing-003324.zh: 完成初稿后，大声朗读一遍，确保所有句子都流畅且清晰。

college-writing-003326.en: C H A P T E R5

college-writing-003327.en: The Fourth Step in Essay Writing

college-writing-003328.en: This chapter will show you how to • revise so that your sentences flow smoothly and clearly • edit so that your sentences are error free
college-writing-003328.zh: 本章将指导你如何•修改文本，使句子流畅且清晰•编辑文本，确保句子无错误

college-writing-003329.en: Up to now, this book has emphasized the first three goals in effective writing: unity, support, and coherence.
college-writing-003329.zh: 到目前为止，这本书强调了有效写作的前三个目标：统一性、支撑性以及连贯性。

college-writing-003330.en: This chapter focuses on the fourth goal of writing effectively: sentence skills.
college-writing-003330.zh: 本章重点讨论有效写作的第四个目标：句子技巧。

college-writing-003331.en: You’ll learn how to revise an essay so that your sentences flow smoothly and clearly.
college-writing-003331.zh: 你将学习如何修改文章，使句子流畅且清晰。

college-writing-003332.en: Then you’ll review how to edit a paper for mistakes in grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
college-writing-003332.zh: 然后，你将学习如何编辑论文，以纠正语法、标点和拼写错误。

college-writing-003334.zh: 116 第一部分 论文写作

college-writing-003336.en: These strategies will help you to revise your sentences effectively:
college-writing-003336.zh: 这些策略将帮助你有效地修改句子：

college-writing-003338.en: • Use a consistent point of view.

college-writing-003343.en: Use Parallelism Words in a pair or a series should have parallel structure.
college-writing-003343.zh: 在成对或序列中应使用平行结构。

college-writing-003344.en: By balancing the items in a pair or a series so that they have the same kind of structure, you will make the sentence clearer and easier to read.
college-writing-003344.zh: 通过将各项以配对或串联的方式排列，使其具有相同的结构，就能让句子更清晰、更易阅读。

college-writing-003345.en: Notice how the parallel sentences that follow read more smoothly than the nonparallel ones.
college-writing-003345.zh: 注意一下，接下来的平行句子比非平行句子读起来更流畅。

college-writing-003346.zh: 非平行（未平衡） 平行（平衡） 我的工作包括检查库存、签署订单，以及联系供应商。

college-writing-003427.en: When writing a paper, you should not shift your point of view unnecessarily.
college-writing-003427.zh: 撰写论文时，不应不必要的改变观点。

college-writing-003428.en: Be consistent in your use of first-, second-, or third-person pronouns.
college-writing-003428.zh: 使用第一、第二或第三人称代词时保持一致性。

college-writing-003430.en: Singular Plural First-person pronouns I (my, mine, me) we (our, us) Second-person pronouns you (your) you (your) Third-person pronouns they (their, them) they (their, them) he (his, him) she (her) it (its)
college-writing-003430.zh: 单数复数第一人称代词：我（我的，我的）我们（我们的，我们）第二人称代词：你（你的）你（你的）第三人称代词：他们（他们的，他们）他（他的，他）她（她的）它（它的）

college-writing-003432.en: For instance, if you start writing in the first person, I, do not jump suddenly to the second person, you.
college-writing-003432.zh: 例如，如果你开始用第一人称写作，即“我”，就不会突然突然变成第二人称“你”。

college-writing-003433.en: Or if you are writing in the third person, they, do not shift unexpectedly to you.
college-writing-003433.zh: 或者，如果你用第三人称来写作，他们不会突然转向你。

college-writing-003435.en: INCONSISTENT CONSISTENT One of the fringe benefits of my job is that you can use a company credit card for gasoline.
college-writing-003435.zh: 不一致/一致 我工作的好处之一是，可以使用公司信用卡购买汽油。

college-writing-003436.en: (The most common mistake people make is to let you slip into their writing after they start with another pronoun.)
college-writing-003436.zh: 人们最常见的错误是，在使用其他代词开始之后，又让你混入他们的写作中。

college-writing-003437.en: One of the fringe benefits of my job is that I can use a company credit card for gasoline.
college-writing-003437.zh: 我工作的好处之一是可以使用公司的信用卡购买汽油。

college-writing-003438.en: Though we like most of our neighbors, there are a few you can’t get along with.
college-writing-003438.zh: 虽然我们喜欢大多数邻居，但也有少数人无法相处。

college-writing-003439.en: (The writer begins with the first-person pronouns we and our but then shifts to the second-person you.)
college-writing-003439.zh: （作者从第一人称代词“我们”和“我们的”开始，然后转向第二人称“你”。）

college-writing-003440.en: Though we like most of our neighbors, there are a few we can’t get along with.
college-writing-003440.zh: 虽然我们大多数都喜欢邻居，但也有少数人我们无法相处。

college-writing-003441.en: Cross out inconsistent pronouns in the following sentences, and revise with the correct form of the pronoun above each crossed-out word.
college-writing-003441.zh: 在以下句子中划去不一致的代词，并在划掉的词上方用正确的代词形式进行修正。

college-writing-003442.en: example When I examined the used car, you could see that one of the front
college-writing-003442.zh: 示例：在检查那辆二手车时，你可以看到其前部有一个……

college-writing-003444.en: 1. Many people are ignorant of side effects that diets can have on your health.
college-writing-003444.zh: 1. 许多人不了解饮食对健康可能产生的副作用。

college-writing-003445.en: 2. I am always nervous when my dentist examines my teeth because you never
college-writing-003445.zh: 2. 当牙医检查我的牙齿时，我总是很紧张，因为你永远无法……

college-writing-003447.en: 3. It is expensive for us to take public transportation to work every day, but what
college-writing-003447.zh: 3. 每天乘坐公共交通上班对我们来说成本较高，但是……

college-writing-003448.en: choice do you have if you can’t afford a car?
college-writing-003448.zh: 如果你买不起车，你有什么选择呢？

college-writing-003449.en: 4. During the border crisis, each country refused to change their aggressive
college-writing-003449.zh: 4. 在边境危机期间，每个国家都拒绝改变其侵略性政策。

college-writing-003454.en: Any person, place, or thing, as well as any indefinite pronoun such as one, anyone, someone, and so on (see Chapter 27), is a third-person word.
college-writing-003454.zh: 任何人、任何地方、任何事物，以及诸如“一个”、“任何人”、“某人”等不定代词（参见第27章），都属于第三人称词。

college-writing-003455.en: Chapter 5 The Fourth Step in Essay Writing 121
college-writing-003455.zh: 第五章 写作的第四步 121

college-writing-003456.en: 5. If we go to Chicago, you should visit the Art Institute.
college-writing-003456.zh: 5. 如果去芝加哥，你应该去艺术馆参观。

college-writing-003457.en: 6. We don’t have enough money to travel to Egypt, but you can learn about the
college-writing-003457.zh: 6. 我们的钱不够用于去埃及旅行，但你可以了解相关情况。

college-writing-003459.en: 7. Maria loves algebra problems because solving them gives you a sense of
college-writing-003459.zh: 7. 玛丽亚喜欢代数问题，因为解决这些问题能让她感受到……

college-writing-003461.en: 8. It’s hard for us to pay for health insurance, but you don’t dare go without
college-writing-003461.zh: 8. 我们很难支付医疗保险费用，但你不敢不买。

college-writing-003463.en: 9. People often take a first-aid course so that we can learn how to help choking
college-writing-003463.zh: 9. 人们经常参加急救课程，这样我们就能学会如何救助窒息的人。

college-writing-003464.zh: 以及心脏病发作的受害者。

college-writing-003465.en: 10. There are several ways you can impress your new boss.
college-writing-003465.zh: 10. 你有几种方法可以给新老板留下好印象。

college-writing-003467.en: should dress well, arrive at work on time, and complete tasks efficiently.
college-writing-003467.zh: 应穿着得体，按时上班，并高效完成任务。

college-writing-003468.en: Use Specific Words To be an effective writer, you must use specific words rather than general words.
college-writing-003468.zh: 使用具体词汇作为有效作家，你必须使用具体词汇而非泛泛之词。

college-writing-003469.en: Specific words create pictures in the reader’s mind.
college-writing-003469.zh: 特定的词汇在读者脑海中形成画面。

college-writing-003470.en: They help capture interest and make your meaning clear.
college-writing-003470.zh: 它们有助于吸引关注并让你的意思更清晰。

college-writing-003472.en: GENERAL SPECIFIC The plane landed at the airport.
college-writing-003472.zh: 具体信息：飞机降落在机场。

college-writing-003473.en: The United Airlines 747 landed at Reagan National Airport.
college-writing-003473.zh: 联合航空的747飞机降落在里根国家机场。

college-writing-003474.zh: 动物们穿过了那个地方。

college-writing-003475.en: Hungry lions padded silently through the savanna.
college-writing-003475.zh: 饥饿的狮子悄无声息地穿行在草原上。

college-writing-003477.en: The biology teacher hastily scribbled his name on the course withdrawal slip.
college-writing-003477.zh: 生物课老师匆忙地在退课申请表上写下了他的名字。

college-writing-003478.en: The specific sentences create clear pictures in our minds.
college-writing-003478.zh: 那些具体的句子在我们脑海中勾勒出清晰的画面。

college-writing-003479.en: The details show us exactly what has happened.
college-writing-003479.zh: 这些细节清楚地展示了究竟发生了什么。

college-writing-003480.en: Here are four ways to make your sentences specific.
college-writing-003480.zh: 以下是四种让句子更具体的方法。

college-writing-003482.en: Leymah fixed the muffler on his car.
college-writing-003482.zh: 莱玛把消音器装在了他的车里。

college-writing-003483.en: Leymah fixed the muffler on his 2011 Chevrolet Impala.
college-writing-003483.zh: 莱玛在他的2011年款雪佛兰Impala上装了消音器。

college-writing-003486.en: The flag moved in the breeze.

college-writing-003487.en: The flag fluttered in the breeze.

college-writing-003488.zh: 3. 在名词前使用描述性词汇（修饰语）。

college-writing-003489.en: A worker strained to lift the crate.
college-writing-003489.zh: 一名工人努力抬起那个箱子。

college-writing-003490.en: A brawny, perspiring worker strained to lift the heavy wooden crate.
college-writing-003490.zh: 一个肌肉结实、满身大汗的工人努力举起那个沉重的木箱。

college-writing-003491.en: 4. Use words that relate to the senses─sight, hearing, taste, smell, touch.
college-writing-003491.zh: 4. 使用与感官相关的词汇——视觉、听觉、味觉、嗅觉、触觉。

college-writing-003492.en: The tourists enjoyed a picnic lunch of cheese, bread, and olives.
college-writing-003492.zh: 游客们享用了以奶酪、面包和橄榄为主的野餐午餐。

college-writing-003493.en: The tourists enjoyed a picnic lunch of sharp cheese, crusty bread, and spicy olives.
college-writing-003493.zh: 游客们享用了由脆奶酪、面包和辣橄榄组成的野餐午餐。

college-writing-003495.en: The campers built a fire of pine and cedar.
college-writing-003495.zh: 露营者们生起了松树和雪松的火。

college-writing-003496.en: The campers built a fire of aromatic pine and cedar.
college-writing-003496.zh: 露营者们用芳香的松树和雪松生火。

college-writing-003498.en: A noise told the crowd that there were two minutes left to play.
college-writing-003498.zh: 一声噪音告诉人群，还有两分钟的时间进行比赛。

college-writing-003499.en: A piercing whistle told the cheering crowd that there were two minutes left to play.
college-writing-003499.zh: 一声尖锐的哨声告知欢呼的观众，还有两分钟的比赛时间。

college-writing-003501.en: When he returned, all he found in the refrigerator was bread and milk.
college-writing-003501.zh: 他回来后，在冰箱里只找到面包和牛奶。

college-writing-003502.en: When he returned, all he found in the refrigerator was stale bread and sour milk.
college-writing-003502.zh: 他回来后，在冰箱里只找到陈旧的面包和酸牛奶。

college-writing-003504.en: Neil stroked the kitten’s fur until he felt its tiny claws on his hand.
college-writing-003504.zh: 尼尔轻抚着小猫的毛发，直到感觉到它小小的爪子贴在手上。

college-writing-003505.en: Neil stroked the kitten’s velvety fur until he felt its tiny, needle-sharp claws on his hand.
college-writing-003505.zh: 尼尔轻抚着小猫柔软的毛发，直到感觉到它那 tiny、像针一样锋利的爪子贴在手上。

college-writing-003507.en: Fran placed a sachet in her bureau drawer.
college-writing-003507.zh: 弗兰把一个小袋子放在了她的文件柜抽屉里。

college-writing-003508.en: Fran placed a lilac-scented sachet in her bureau drawer.
college-writing-003508.zh: 弗兰在她的文件柜抽屉里放了一个带有紫罗兰香味的小袋。

college-writing-003510.zh: 修改以下句子，用明确、具体的词汇替换那些模糊、不明确的词语。

college-writing-003511.zh: 示例：我们的几台设备同时出现了故障。

college-writing-003512.zh: 新房子配备了节能电器。

college-writing-003514.en: Our washer, refrigerator, and television broke .
college-writing-003514.zh: 我们的洗衣机、冰箱和电视都坏了。

college-writing-003515.zh: 第五章 写作的第四步 123

college-writing-003516.en: 2. I swept aside the things on my desk to spread out the road map.
college-writing-003516.zh: 2. 我把桌上的东西都扔到一旁，以便铺开地图。

college-writing-003518.en: 4. Several sections of the newspaper were missing.

college-writing-003519.en: 5. The doctor examined various parts of my body before diagnosing my illness as
college-writing-003519.zh: 5. 在诊断出我的疾病之前，医生检查了我的身体各个部位。

college-writing-003521.en: Again, you will practice changing vague, indefinite writing into lively, image-filled writing that helps capture the reader’s interest and makes your meaning clear.
college-writing-003521.zh: 同样，你需要练习将模糊、不具体的文字，转化为生动、富有意象的文字，从而吸引读者的兴趣并让你的意思更清晰。

college-writing-003522.en: With the help of the methods described in the preceding section, add specific details to the five sentences that follow.
college-writing-003522.zh: 借助前一小节中描述的方法，为接下来的五个句子添加具体的细节。

college-writing-003524.zh: 示例：那个人下了公交车。

college-writing-003525.zh: 她整个夏天都努力工作。

college-writing-003528.en: The teenage boy bounded down the steps of the shiny yellow school bus.
college-writing-003528.zh: 那个少年快步走向那辆闪亮的黄色校车台阶。

college-writing-003529.en: All summer, Eva sorted peaches and blueberries in the hot, noisy canning factory.
college-writing-003529.zh: 整个夏天，伊娃在炎热且嘈杂的罐头厂里分拣桃子与蓝莓。

college-writing-003531.zh: 2. 桌子上的东西堆得乱七八糟。

college-writing-003532.zh: 3. 这位女士发现失散的儿子后欣喜若狂。

college-writing-003535.en: Rewrite the sign pictured here using lively, imagefilled writing that will grab people’s attention.
college-writing-003535.zh: 用生动、富有画面感的文字重新书写这里的标志，以吸引人们的注意力。

college-writing-003538.en: Chapter 5 The Fourth Step in Essay Writing 125
college-writing-003538.zh: 第五章 写作的第四步 125

college-writing-003539.en: Use Active Verbs When the subject of a sentence performs the action of the verb, the verb is in the active voice.
college-writing-003539.zh: 当句子的主语执行动词所表示的动作时，该动词就处于主动语态。

college-writing-003540.en: When the subject of a sentence receives the action of a verb, the verb is in the passive voice.
college-writing-003540.zh: 当句子的主语接受动词的谓语时，该动词就处于被动语态。

college-writing-003541.en: Passive voice uses a form of the verb to be (am, is, are, was, were) and the past participle of the main verb (usually the same as its past-tense form).
college-writing-003541.zh: 被动语态使用“be”动词的形式（am, is, are, was, were）以及主要动词的过去分词形式（通常与其过去式形式相同）。

college-writing-003542.en: Look at the following active and passive forms.
college-writing-003542.zh: 看看以下主动和被动形式。

college-writing-003543.en: PASSIVE ACTIVE The computer was turned on by Hakim.

college-writing-003545.en: The car’s air conditioner was fixed by the mechanic.
college-writing-003545.zh: 这辆车的空调由机械师修理好了。

college-writing-003546.en: The mechanic fixed the car’s air conditioner.
college-writing-003546.zh: 机械师修理了汽车的空调。

college-writing-003547.en: The stream was diverted by the engineers.
college-writing-003547.zh: 工程师们对水流进行了调整。

college-writing-003548.en: A Country Doctor, a novel by Sarah Orne Jewett, was written in 1884.
college-writing-003548.zh: 《乡村医生》是莎拉·奥恩·朱维特所著的一本小说，创作于1884年。

college-writing-003550.en: Sarah Orne Jewett wrote the novel A Country Doctor in 1884.
college-writing-003550.zh: 莎拉·奥恩·朱维特在1884年创作了小说《乡村医生》。

college-writing-003551.en: In World War II, France, Holland, Norway, Hungary, Poland, Russia, and other countries were invaded by Germany.
college-writing-003551.zh: 在第二次世界大战中，法国、荷兰、挪威、匈牙利、波兰、俄罗斯等国家遭到了德国的入侵。

college-writing-003552.en: In World War II, Germany invaded France, Holland, Norway, Hungary, Poland, Russia and other countries.
college-writing-003552.zh: 在第二次世界大战中，德国入侵了法国、荷兰、挪威、匈牙利、波兰、俄罗斯等国家。

college-writing-003553.en: In general, active verbs are more effective than passive verbs.
college-writing-003553.zh: 一般来说，主动动词比被动动词更有效。

college-writing-003554.en: Active verbs give your writing a simpler and more vigorous style.
college-writing-003554.zh: 主动动词让你的写作风格更加简洁且富有活力。

college-writing-003555.en: Revise the following sentences, changing verbs from the passive to the active voice and making any other word changes necessary.
college-writing-003555.zh: 修改以下句子，将动词从被动语态改为主动语态，并做出其他必要的词变化。

college-writing-003556.en: example Fruits and vegetables are painted often by artists.
college-writing-003556.zh: 水果和蔬菜的图案常被艺术家绘制出来。

college-writing-003557.zh: 1. 许多不健康的食品都存在于典型的美国饮食中。

college-writing-003558.en: 2. The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) was established by the
college-writing-003558.zh: 2. 北大西洋条约组织（NATO）是由……成立的

college-writing-003559.en: United States, Great Britain, and nine other countries in 1949.
college-writing-003559.zh: 1949年，美国、英国及另外九个国家。

college-writing-003560.en: 3. The soldier’s wounds were attacked by gangrene-producing bacteria.
college-writing-003560.zh: 3. 士兵的伤口受到了产生坏疽的细菌的侵袭。

college-writing-003562.en: Artists often paint fruits and vegetables.
college-writing-003562.zh: 艺术家经常画水果和蔬菜。

college-writing-003564.en: 4. A second Nobel Prize was won by Marie Curie in 1911.
college-writing-003564.zh: 4. 1911年，玛丽·居里获得了第二个诺贝尔奖。

college-writing-003565.en: 5. Final grades will be determined by the instructor on the basis of class
college-writing-003565.zh: 5. 最终成绩由教师根据课堂表现来评定。

college-writing-003567.en: Use Concise Words Wordiness─using more words than necessary to express a meaning─is often a sign of lazy or careless writing.
college-writing-003567.zh: 使用冗长词汇——用比必要更多的词汇来表达意思——通常表明写作态度懒散或粗心。

college-writing-003568.en: Your readers may resent the extra time and energy they must spend when you have not done the work needed to make your writing direct and concise.
college-writing-003568.zh: 您的读者可能会对您不得不花费更多时间和精力来撰写内容感到不满，因为您没有完成使文章更加简洁明了所需的工作。

college-writing-003569.en: Here are two examples of wordy sentences:
college-writing-003569.zh: 以下是两个冗长句子的例子：

college-writing-003570.en: All of the employees who are new to this institution are required to attend a meeting that is scheduled for the first Friday and Saturday of August, which is August 8 and August 9.
college-writing-003570.zh: 所有刚加入该机构的员工都必须参加定于8月第一个周五和周六举行的会议，即8月8日和8月9日。

college-writing-003571.en: In Ben’s opinion, streaming services have changed and altered our movie and video watching habits.
college-writing-003571.zh: 在本看来，流媒体服务已经改变了我们的电影和视频观看习惯。

college-writing-003572.en: Omitting needless words improves these sentences:
college-writing-003572.zh: 省略不必要的词语就能让这些句子更流畅：

college-writing-003573.en: New employees are required to attend a meeting on August 8 and 9.
college-writing-003573.zh: 新员工须在8日和9日参加会议。

college-writing-003574.en: Ben thinks streaming services have changed our viewing habits.
college-writing-003574.zh: 本认为流媒体服务改变了我们的观看习惯。

college-writing-003575.en: Following is a list of some wordy expressions that could be reduced to single words.
college-writing-003575.zh: 以下是一些可以缩为单个单词的冗长表达列表。

college-writing-003578.en: Wordy Form Shorter Form at this time now in the present now in the event that if due to the fact that because for the reason that because in every instance always in this day and age today during the time that while a large number of many
college-writing-003578.zh: 当前使用的是简略形式，因为在这个时代，总是有大量的内容需要表达。

college-writing-003580.en: Chapter 5 The Fourth Step in Essay Writing 127
college-writing-003580.zh: 第五章 写作的第四步 127

college-writing-003581.en: Revise the following sentences, omitting needless words.
college-writing-003581.zh: 修改以下句子，删除不必要的词汇。

college-writing-003582.en: 1. The bird was purple, red, orange, and yellow in color, and its body was
college-writing-003582.zh: 那只鸟有着紫色、红色、橙色和黄色的颜色，它的身体是

college-writing-003584.zh: 2. 控制儿童所接触的屏幕时间的质量与时长

college-writing-003585.en: is a continuing challenge to parents that they must meet on a daily basis.
college-writing-003585.zh: 这是父母每天必须面对的持续挑战。

college-writing-003586.en: 3. A large number of people are now seeking out various electronic devices as
college-writing-003586.zh: 3. 目前有很多人正在寻找各种电子设备。

college-writing-003587.en: presents to give to others on their birthdays.
college-writing-003587.zh: 在生日时赠送给他人的礼物。

college-writing-003588.en: 4. In 1962, Linus Pauling, who was an American, was awarded the Nobel Prize,
college-writing-003588.zh: 4. 1962年，美国人林纳斯·保尔宁获得了诺贝尔奖。

college-writing-003589.en: which was given to him for his attempts to limit the making of nuclear arms and to curtail the spread of nuclear testing.
college-writing-003589.zh: 这是因为他的努力限制了核武器的制造，并遏制了核试验的扩散而授予他的。

college-writing-003591.zh: 词形更简短，尺寸更大，颜色为红色，数量为五，12点午夜/12点中午，往返返回，效果良好，合作，完全一致，一致同意，往返往返，推迟到以后再处理

college-writing-003593.en: 5. I found out recently that Benito Mussolini (1883–1945), the dictator of the
college-writing-003593.zh: 5. 我最近发现，贝尼托·墨索里尼（1883–1945），这位独裁者……

college-writing-003594.en: fascist nation of Italy for a period lasting nearly twenty-one years, was named after the Mexican political leader who went by the name of Benito Juarez (1806–1872).
college-writing-003594.zh: 那个持续了近二十一年的法西斯国家——意大利，以墨西哥政治领袖本尼托·华雷斯（1806–1872）的名字来命名。

college-writing-003595.en: 6. In today’s uncertain economic climate, it is clear that people, namely, average
college-writing-003595.zh: 6. 在当今不稳定的经济环境下，很明显，人们，也就是普通人，
