college-writing-004550.zh: 第6章 修改论文的四个基础 167

college-writing-004552.en: 30My average this year was higher than the averages of several of my teammates, yet none of them acted resentful or threatened.
college-writing-004552.zh: 30我今年的平均水平高于我的几个队友的平均水平，但他们都没有表现出怨恨或威胁。

college-writing-004553.en: 31On several occasions I was taken out late in a game for a pinch runner, but other slow players on the team were also lifted at times for pinch runners.
college-writing-004553.zh: 31 有几次我在比赛后期被淘汰出局，但团队中的其他慢速球员有时也会被解雇，因为他会被夹击跑者。

college-writing-004554.en: 32 Every woman should have a team like the Browns!
college-writing-004554.zh: 32. 每个女人都应该有一支像布朗队这样的球队！

college-writing-004555.en: The number of the irrelevant sentence:

college-writing-004556.en: 33 Because I really had problems only with the new teams, I’ve concluded that it’s when people are faced with an unfamiliar situation that they react defensively.
college-writing-004556.zh: 33. 因为我真的只对新球队有问题，所以我得出的结论是，当人们面临着一种陌生的情况时，他们会做出防御性的反应。

college-writing-004557.en: 34 Once a rival team has gotten used to seeing me on the field, I’m no big deal.
college-writing-004557.zh: 34. 一旦一个对手球队习惯了在球场上见到我，我就没什么大不了的。

college-writing-004558.en: 35 Still, I suspect that the Browns secretly feel we’re a little special.
college-writing-004558.zh: 35. 尽管如此，我怀疑布朗队暗中觉得我们有点特别。

college-writing-004559.en: 36 After all, we are the only team with a woman on it.
college-writing-004559.zh: 36. 毕竟，我们是唯一一个有女人的团队。

college-writing-004561.en: 1 Since 1971, in both presidential election years and in non-presidential election years, voter turn-out has been consistently lower than 70 percent.
college-writing-004561.zh: 1. 自 1971 年以来，在总统选举年和非总统选举年，选民投票率一直低于 70%。

college-writing-004562.en: 2 Those who don’t vote claim that their vote wouldn’t make any difference and they are powerless to change anything.
college-writing-004562.zh: 2. 那些不投票的人声称他们的投票不会产生任何影响，他们无力改变任何事情。

college-writing-004563.en: 3 However, in January 2012, websites like Wikipedia and Google demonstrated just how powerful the voices of the American people really are.
college-writing-004563.zh: 3. 然而，在 2012 年 1 月，维基百科和谷歌等网站展示了美国人民的声音的真正强大。

college-writing-004564.en: 4In October 2011, two bills, the Stop Online Piracy Act (SOPA) and the Protect Intellectual Property Act (PIPA), were introduced.
college-writing-004564.zh: 4 2011 年 10 月，引入了两项法案，即停止在线盗版法 (SOPA) 和保护知识产权法 (PIPA)。

college-writing-004565.en: 5 Bills are regularly introduced in both the House and the Senate.
college-writing-004565.zh: 5. 众议院和参议院都定期提出法案。

college-writing-004566.en: 6 The purpose of these bills was to make it easier for the U.S. Department of Justice to block sites that sell or distribute pirated copyrighted material like music and movies as well as sites that sell counterfeit items like purses and watches.
college-writing-004566.zh: 6. 这些法案的目的是让美国司法部更容易阻止销售或分发盗版版权材料（如音乐和电影）以及出售钱包和手表等假冒物品的网站的网站。

college-writing-004567.en: 7 Neither of the bills would have necessarily shut down the sites, but it would have allowed the U.S. Department of Justice to require Internet service providers to block access to the sites and stop providers, search engines, and advertisers from doing business with such sites.
college-writing-004567.zh: 7. 这两项法案都不一定会关闭这些网站，但它将允许美国司法部要求互联网服务提供商阻止对这些网站的访问，并阻止提供商、搜索引擎和广告商与此类网站开展业务。

college-writing-004568.en: 8 Those in favor of the bills claimed the bills would protect jobs and revenue, but those against the bills saw them as an infringement of freedom of information.
college-writing-004568.zh: 8. 那些支持法案的人声称这些法案将保护工作和收入，但反对这些法案的人认为这些法案侵犯了信息自由。

college-writing-004571.en: The number of the irrelevant sentence:

college-writing-004572.en: 9 Those in favor of the bill, like many of the major Hollywood studios and several news corporations, claimed the bills would protect jobs and revenue.
college-writing-004572.zh: 9. 那些支持该法案的人，就像许多主要的好莱坞工作室和几家新闻公司一样，声称这些法案将保护就业和收入。

college-writing-004573.en: 10In December 2011, Chris Dodd, Chair of the Motion Picture Association of America (MPAA), wrote, “Indeed, the theft of intellectual property (which costs our nation 373,000 jobs and $58 billion in economic output each year) is itself the true threat to free speech, because it threatens to silence the artists whose creations — and livelihoods — are being stolen.” 11Dodd’s support of the bill demonstrates his concern for those he represents — the film industry.
college-writing-004573.zh: 2011 年 12 月 10 日，美国电影协会 (MPAA) 主席克里斯·多德 (Chris Dodd) 写道：“事实上，盗窃知识产权（我们国家每年损失 373,000 个工作岗位和 580 亿美元的经济产出）本身就是真实的 对言论自由的威胁，因为它可能会使那些创作——和生计——被盗的艺术家保持沉默。” 11 多德对该法案的支持表明了他对他所代表的人——电影业的担忧。

college-writing-004574.en: 12 Art industries have also been victims of piracy.
college-writing-004574.zh: 12. 艺术产业也是盗版的受害者。

college-writing-004575.en: 13 The White House also maintains that online piracy is problematic and does threaten American jobs and the economy.
college-writing-004575.zh: 13. 白宫还坚持认为，在线盗版存在问题，确实威胁到美国的就业和经济。

college-writing-004576.en: 14 However, on January 14, 2012, in response to a petition against the SOPA bill that had over 50,000 signatures, the White House released a statement that said, “Online piracy by foreign websites is a serious problem that requires a serious legislative response, [but] we will not support legislation that reduces freedom of expression, increases cybersecurity risk, or undermines the dynamic, innovative global Internet.”
college-writing-004576.zh: 14. 然而，在2012年1月14日，白宫针对SOPA法案提出了超过50,000个签名的请愿书，发表声明称：“外国网站的在线盗版是一个严重的问题，需要认真的立法回应，[但是]我们 不支持降低言论自由、增加网络安全风险或破坏充满活力的创新全球互联网的立法。”

college-writing-004577.en: The number of the irrelevant sentence:

college-writing-004578.en: 15On January 18, 2012, a coordinated service blackout was led by the English Wikipedia and Reddit.
college-writing-004578.zh: 15 2012 年 1 月 18 日，英语维基百科和 Reddit 领导了一次协调服务停电。

college-writing-004579.en: 16 Reddit is a social news website founded in 2005.
college-writing-004579.zh: 16. Reddit是一个社交新闻网站，成立于2005年。

college-writing-004580.en: 17 Other sites like Google offered a link to sign a petition, but didn’t stop service.
college-writing-004580.zh: 17. 谷歌等其他网站提供了签署请愿书的链接，但没有停止服务。

college-writing-004581.en: 18 Still other sites like Twitter, MoveOn.org, and Mozilla vocalized their protest, but didn’t participate in the blackout.
college-writing-004581.zh: 18. 还有其他网站，如 Twitter、Moveon.org 和 Mozilla 表达了他们的抗议，但没有参与停电。

college-writing-004582.en: 19 NetCoalition, a group that provides a platform for and represents companies like Google, eBay, Expedia, and Amazon.com, released national radio and print ads against SOPA and PIPA.
college-writing-004582.zh: 19. NetCoalition 是一个为 Google、eBay、Expedia 和 Amazon.com 等公司提供平台并代表公司的集团，发布了针对 SOPA 和 PIPA 的国家广播和平面广告。

college-writing-004583.en: 20In a statement, Google’s news team said, “Like many businesses, entrepreneurs and Web users, we oppose these bills because there are smart, targeted ways to shut down foreign rogue websites without asking American companies to censor the Internet. 21So tomorrow we will be joining many other tech companies to highlight this issue on our U.S. home page.”
college-writing-004583.zh: 20 在一份声明中，谷歌的新闻团队说：“像许多企业、企业家和网络用户一样，我们反对这些法案，因为有一些明智的、有针对性的方式来关闭外国流氓网站，而无需要求美国公司审查互联网。 21所以明天我们将加入许多其他技术 公司在美国主页上强调这个问题。”

college-writing-004584.en: The number of the irrelevant sentence:

college-writing-004586.en: 22 More than four and a half million people signed Google’s anti- SOPA/PIPA petition.
college-writing-004586.zh: 22. 超过四百万人签署了谷歌的反SOPA/PIPA请愿书。

college-writing-004587.en: 23As a result of the outpouring of opinion, both bills lost congressional support and the votes were postponed pending
college-writing-004587.zh: 23 由于意见倾诉的结果，两项法案都失去了国会的支持，投票被推迟了未决

college-writing-004588.en: Chapter 6 Four Bases for Revising Essays 169
college-writing-004588.zh: 第6章 修订论文的四个基础 169

college-writing-004590.en: 24 There were a lot of people who expressed angry reactions about the bills going back to the discussion table.
college-writing-004590.zh: 24. 有很多人对这些法案回到讨论桌上表示愤怒的反应。

college-writing-004591.en: 25 The blackout of January 18 is a strong example of the power of the people; it is something that should inspire more people to participate in the civic responsibility of voting.
college-writing-004591.zh: 25. 1 月 18 日的停电是人民力量的有力典范； 它应该激励更多的人参与投票的公民责任。

college-writing-004593.en: 1 The study of happiness and what creates it has become a multimillion-dollar business.
college-writing-004593.zh: 1. 对幸福的研究以及创造幸福的原因已成为一项价值数百万美元的业务。

college-writing-004594.en: 2 Some people say that happiness comes from wealth, but most researchers say that happiness comes from within.
college-writing-004594.zh: 2. 有人说幸福来自财富，但大多数研究人员说幸福来自内心。

college-writing-004595.en: 3In pursuit of happiness, many people create goals, but often find once they have achieved them, the expected contentment is not present.
college-writing-004595.zh: 3、在追求幸福的过程中，很多人创造了目标，但一旦实现，往往会发现，预期的满足感是不存在的。

college-writing-004596.en: 4 Martha Beck, a life coach with a Ph.D. from Harvard, writes that “Over and over, researchers studying happiness have found that the situational elements people crave — money, social status, possessions — don’t reliably lead to an experience of well-being. 5 Learning to find joy in the present moment . . . increases life satisfaction, improves health, and allows us to live longer more fulfilling lives.” 6Finding joy in the present moment might be difficult at first, but if one focuses on what truly matters, this joy can lead to a better life.
college-writing-004596.zh: 4. 玛莎·贝克（Martha Beck），拥有博士学位的生活教练。 哈佛写道：“研究幸福的研究人员一遍又一遍地发现，人们渴望的情境因素——金钱、社会地位、财产——不能可靠地带来幸福的体验。 5学会在当下找到快乐。 满意，改善健康，让我们活得更长久，更充实。” 6 一开始在当下找到快乐可能很困难，但如果一个人专注于真正重要的事情，这种快乐可以带来更好的生活。

college-writing-004597.en: 7 The first step in learning to find joy is to learn to be in the present.
college-writing-004597.zh: 7. 学习找到快乐的第一步是学会活在当下。

college-writing-004598.en: 8 Instead of seeing a rainy day as a negative thing, they see a rainy day and think about splashing and jumping in puddles.
college-writing-004598.zh: 8. 他们没有将下雨天视为负面的事情，而是看到下雨天，并考虑在水坑中泼水和跳跃。

college-writing-004599.en: 9 They see caterpillars as fascinating, not gross, objects to observe and follow.
college-writing-004599.zh: 9. 他们认为毛毛虫是迷人的，而不是粗俗的，可以观察和跟随的物体。

college-writing-004600.en: 10 They see life as a series of exciting gifts that need to be experienced.
college-writing-004600.zh: 10. 他们将生活视为一系列令人兴奋的礼物，需要体验。

college-writing-004601.en: 11 Instead of always focusing on what is coming next, learning to find joy means pausing.
college-writing-004601.zh: 11. 学习寻找快乐不是总是专注于接下来会发生什么，而是停下来。

college-writing-004602.en: 12 Whether it is taking a moment to deeply breathe in the aroma of that first cup of coffee or marveling at the way toothpaste foams, finding satisfaction in the little moments of the day will lead to a more positive outlook.
college-writing-004602.zh: 12. 无论是花点时间深呼吸第一杯咖啡的香气，还是对牙膏泡沫的方式感到惊讶，在一天中的小时刻找到满足感都会带来更积极的前景。

college-writing-004603.en: The spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004603.zh: 需要 支撑细节 的位置出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004604.en: The number of the irrelevant sentence:

college-writing-004605.en: Revising Essays for Support Both of the essays below lack supporting details at certain key points.
college-writing-004605.zh: 修改论文以支持以下两篇论文在某些关键点缺乏 支撑细节。

college-writing-004606.en: In each essay, identify the spots where details are needed.
college-writing-004606.zh: 在每篇文章中，确定需要详细信息的地点。

college-writing-004609.en: 13 The second step in finding joy is to focus on experiences instead of things.
college-writing-004609.zh: 13. 寻找快乐的第二步是专注于体验而不是事物。

college-writing-004610.en: 14 Buying a television might be exciting at first, but sitting in a room watching television alone isn’t going to contribute to a sense of happiness.
college-writing-004610.zh: 14. 起初买电视可能很令人兴奋，但独自坐在房间里看电视并不能带来幸福感。

college-writing-004611.en: 15 According to Thomas A. Glass, professor at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, studies show that people who live longer lives have strong social connections and that people who have weak or no social connections will die earlier, despite seemingly good health.
college-writing-004611.zh: 15. 根据约翰霍普金斯大学布隆伯格公共卫生学院教授 Thomas A. Glass 的说法，研究表明，寿命更长的人的社会联系很强，社会关系薄弱或没有社会联系的人会更早地死亡，尽管看起来健康。

college-writing-004612.en: The first spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004612.zh: 第一个需要 支撑细节 的地方出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004613.en: The second spot occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004613.zh: 第二点出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004614.en: 16 Finally, it is important to live generously.
college-writing-004614.zh: 16. 最后，慷慨地生活很重要。

college-writing-004615.en: 17 Many people report that when they spend more time volunteering or learning something new, they find happiness.
college-writing-004615.zh: 17. 许多人报告说，当他们花更多的时间做志愿者或学习新事物时，他们会找到幸福。

college-writing-004616.en: 18 This intrinsic desire to better themselves or the world around them leads people to a sense of worth and happiness.
college-writing-004616.zh: 18. 这种改善自己或周围世界的内在愿望会使人们产生一种价值和幸福的感觉。

college-writing-004617.en: The spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004617.zh: 需要 支撑细节 的位置出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004618.en: 19 Pursuing happiness can always remain a goal, or it can become a reality.
college-writing-004618.zh: 19. 追求幸福永远是一个目标，也可以成为现实。

college-writing-004619.en: 20 All a person needs to do is focus on the present, focus on experiences, and live generously.
college-writing-004619.zh: 20. 一个人需要做的就是专注于当下，专注于体验，慷慨地生活。

college-writing-004620.en: 21 Together these actions can lead to a longer, happier life.
college-writing-004620.zh: 21. 这些行动可以共同带来更长久、更幸福的生活。

college-writing-004622.en: 1 With the increase of international students on campus, it is important that the academic community be aware of the major issues these students face.
college-writing-004622.zh: 1. 随着校园内国际学生的增加，学术界必须了解这些学生面临的主要问题。

college-writing-004623.en: 2 Many international students struggle with language barriers, cultural barriers, and social barriers.
college-writing-004623.zh: 2. 许多国际学生在语言障碍、文化障碍和社会障碍方面苦苦挣扎。

college-writing-004624.en: 3In order to effectively educate our students, the counseling department, in conjunction with the College Orientation department and the Honors Student Ambassador Program, will be implementing an orientation program that all international students will be required to attend.
college-writing-004624.zh: 3 为了有效地教育我们的学生，咨询部门与大学迎新部和荣誉学生大使计划一起实施所有国际学生都必须参加的迎新计划。

college-writing-004625.en: 4To address the language barriers, all international students will be tested on their English language skills.
college-writing-004625.zh: 4. 为解决语言障碍，所有国际学生都将接受他们的英语语言能力测试。

college-writing-004626.en: 5If they have already taken the TOEFL, that score will be used in place of the added testing.
college-writing-004626.zh: 5如果他们已经参加了托福，则将使用该分数来代替增加的测试。

college-writing-004627.en: 6 Students who are more proficient will be partnered with students in the Student Ambassador program.
college-writing-004627.zh: 6. 更熟练的学生将与学生大使计划的学生合作。

college-writing-004628.en: 7 These pairings will allow students to work with a peer to ask questions, have subjects clarified, and seek the necessary
college-writing-004628.zh: 7. 这些配对将允许学生与同龄人一起提出问题，澄清主题，并寻求必要的

college-writing-004631.en: Chapter 6 Four Bases for Revising Essays 171
college-writing-004631.zh: 第6章 修订论文的四个基础 171

college-writing-004633.en: 8 This peer mentoring will be a way to increase student engagement, thus enhancing student success.
college-writing-004633.zh: 8. 这种同伴指导将是提高学生参与度的一种方式，从而提高学生的成功率。

college-writing-004634.en: 9 Students who are less fluent in English will be linked up with all the helpful elements that our ESL program can offer.
college-writing-004634.zh: 9. 英语不太流利的学生将与我们的 ESL 计划可以提供的所有有用元素联系起来。

college-writing-004635.en: 10 Not only will the orientation program offer students an opportunity to improve their English language skills, but it will offer them connections with other students and professors who are aware of the added struggles faced by international students.
college-writing-004635.zh: 10. 迎新课程不仅为学生提供了提高英语语言技能的机会，而且还将为他们提供与其他学生和教授的联系，这些学生和教授意识到国际学生面临的额外困难。

college-writing-004636.en: The spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004636.zh: 需要 支撑细节 的位置出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004637.en: 11To address the cultural barriers, the orientation classes will focus specifically on American culture in comparison to the cultures represented by the students in the class.
college-writing-004637.zh: 11 为了解决文化障碍，迎新班将专门关注美国文化，与课堂上学生所代表的文化相比。

college-writing-004638.en: 12 Many students come from countries that view education and professors differently.
college-writing-004638.zh: 12. 许多学生来自对教育和教授有不同看法的国家。

college-writing-004639.en: 13 Specific focus will be placed on American classroom culture and the expected behavior of student-professor interaction.
college-writing-004639.zh: 13. 具体的重点将放在美国的课堂文化和学生与教授互动的预期行为上。

college-writing-004640.en: 14 Students will also be instructed about the many differing aspects of American social culture.
college-writing-004640.zh: 14. 学生还将被告知美国社会文化的许多不同方面。

college-writing-004641.en: 15 Students will be encouraged to share their cultures and customs to create a deeper understanding and bond within the class.
college-writing-004641.zh: 15. 将鼓励学生分享他们的文化和习俗，以在课堂上建立更深入的理解和联系。

college-writing-004642.en: 16 This type of learning will create a strong learning community that will aid in students’ acclimation.
college-writing-004642.zh: 16. 这种类型的学习将创建一个强大的学习社区，有助于学生的适应。

college-writing-004643.en: The spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004643.zh: 需要 支撑细节 的位置出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004644.en: 17 The final problems many international students face are social barriers.
college-writing-004644.zh: 17. 许多国际学生面临的最后问题是社会障碍。

college-writing-004645.en: 18 Most students attending college are forging new social connections.
college-writing-004645.zh: 18. 大多数上大学的学生都在建立新的社会联系。

college-writing-004646.en: 19 However, it is generally much harder for international students as they are also trying to learn new customs, languages, and etiquette.
college-writing-004646.zh: 19. 然而，对于国际学生来说，这通常要困难得多，因为他们也在努力学习新的习俗、语言和礼仪。

college-writing-004647.en: 20 Within the safety of the orientation class, students will be able to form a cohort of other international students who are also facing social barriers.
college-writing-004647.zh: 20. 在迎新班的安全范围内，学生将能够组成一批其他也面临社会障碍的国际学生。

college-writing-004648.en: 21 For many reasons, the Student Ambassadors will be vital to this part of the orientation class.
college-writing-004648.zh: 21. 由于许多原因，学生大使对迎新班的这一部分至关重要。

college-writing-004649.en: The spot where supporting details are needed occurs after sentence .
college-writing-004649.zh: 需要 支撑细节 的位置出现在句子之后。

college-writing-004650.en: 22 Our international students face many added challenges, and they give much to our college community.
college-writing-004650.zh: 22. 我们的国际学生面临许多额外的挑战，他们给我们的大学社区带来了很多挑战。

college-writing-004651.en: 23 Studies show that students who attend orientation programs often are far more successful in school.
college-writing-004651.zh: 23. 研究表明，参加迎新课程的学生通常在学校更成功。

college-writing-004652.en: 24 Offering an orientation that is specifically geared toward the obstacles our international students face will help them to have a more positive experience, which in turn should greatly improve our retention of our international students.
college-writing-004652.zh: 24. 提供专门针对我们的国际学生面临的障碍的方向将帮助他们获得更积极的体验，这反过来应该会大大提高我们对国际学生的保留。

college-writing-004654.en: Revising Essays for Coherence Both of the essays that follow could be revised to improve their coherence.
college-writing-004654.zh: 修改论文以确保连贯性 接下来的两篇文章都可以进行修改，以提高它们的连贯性。

college-writing-004655.en: Answer the questions about coherence that come after each essay.
college-writing-004655.zh: 回答每篇文章后关于连贯性的问题。

college-writing-004658.en: 1 Natural sounds — waves, wind, birdsong — are so soothing that companies sell recordings of them to anxious people seeking a relaxing atmosphere at home or in the car.
college-writing-004658.zh: 1. 自然的声音——海浪、风、鸟鸣——令人心旷神怡，以至于公司将它们的录音出售给焦虑的人，在家中或车内寻求轻松的氛围。

college-writing-004659.en: 2 One reason why “environmental sounds” are big business is that ordinary citizens, especially city dwellers, are bombarded by noise pollution.
college-writing-004659.zh: 2. “环境声音”是大生意的原因之一是普通公民，尤其是城市居民，受到噪音污染的轰炸。

college-writing-004660.en: 3On the way to work, on the job, and on the way home, the typical urban resident must cope with a continuing barrage of unpleasant sounds.
college-writing-004660.zh: 3 在上班的路上，在工作中，在回家的路上，典型的城市居民必须应对持续不断的不愉快声音。

college-writing-004661.en: 4 The noise level in an office can be unbearable.
college-writing-004661.zh: 4. 办公室的噪音水平可能难以忍受。

college-writing-004662.en: 5 From nine to five o’clock, phones and fax machines ring, computer keyboards chatter, intercoms buzz, and copy machines thump back and forth.
college-writing-004662.zh: 5. 从九点到五点钟，电话和传真机响起，电脑键盘喋喋不休，对讲机嗡嗡作响，复印机来回乱跳。

college-writing-004663.en: 6 Every time the receptionists can’t find people, they resort to a nerve-shattering public address system.
college-writing-004663.zh: 6. 每次接待员找不到人时，他们都会求助于令人伤脑筋的公共广播系统。

college-writing-004664.en: 7 And because the managers worry about the employees’ morale, they graciously provide the endless droning of canned music.
college-writing-004664.zh: 7. 而且因为管理者担心员工的士气，他们慷慨地提供了无休止的罐装音乐的嗡嗡声。

college-writing-004665.en: 8 This effectively eliminates any possibility of a moment of blessed silence.
college-writing-004665.zh: 8. 这有效地消除了任何有福的沉默的可能性。

college-writing-004666.en: 9 Traveling home from work provides no relief from the noisiness of the office.
college-writing-004666.zh: 9. 下班回家无法缓解办公室的喧嚣。

college-writing-004667.en: 10 The ordinary sounds of blaring taxi horns and rumbling buses are occasionally punctuated by the ear-piercing screech of car brakes.
college-writing-004667.zh: 10. 偶尔会被汽车刹车刺耳的尖叫声打断，发出响亮的出租车喇叭和隆隆的公共汽车的声音。

college-writing-004668.en: 11 Taking a shortcut through the park will bring the weary worker face to face with chanting religious cults, freelance musicians, screaming children, and barking dogs.
college-writing-004668.zh: 11. 走捷径将使疲惫的工人与高呼宗教崇拜、自由音乐家、尖叫的孩子和吠叫的狗面对面。

college-writing-004669.en: 12 None of these sounds can compare with the loud music that park visitors play.
college-writing-004669.zh: 12. 这些声音都无法与公园游客演奏的响亮音乐相提并论。

college-writing-004670.en: 13 Each of their devices blasts out something different, from heavy-metal rock to baseball, at decibel levels so strong that they make eardrums throb in pain.
college-writing-004670.zh: 13. 他们的每一个设备都爆出了一些不同的东西，从重金属岩石到棒球，在分贝水平上如此强大，以至于他们让耳膜在痛苦中跳动。

college-writing-004671.en: 14If there are birds singing or wind in the trees, the harried commuter will never hear them.
college-writing-004671.zh: 14 若有鸟在树上歌唱或风声，受苦的通勤者将永远听不见。

college-writing-004672.en: 15 Even a trip to work at 6:00 or 7:00 a.m. isn’t quiet.
college-writing-004672.zh: 15. 即使是早上 6:00 或 7:00 上班也不安静。

college-writing-004673.en: 16No matter which route a worker takes, there is bound to be a noisy construction site somewhere along the way.
college-writing-004673.zh: 16 无论工人走哪条路，沿途的某个地方都必然会有一个嘈杂的建筑工地。

college-writing-004674.en: 17 Hard hats will shout from third-story windows to warn their coworkers below before heaving debris out and sending it crashing to earth.
college-writing-004674.zh: 17. 安全帽会从三楼的窗户大喊，警告他们在下面的同事，然后将碎片扔出并将其撞到地球上。

college-writing-004675.en: 18 Huge front-end loaders will crunch into these piles of rubble and back up, their warning signals letting out loud, jarring beeps.
college-writing-004675.zh: 18. 巨大的前端装载机将挤入这些成堆的碎石和后备，它们的警告信号发出响亮的刺耳的哔哔声。

college-writing-004676.en: 19 Air hammers begin an earsplitting chorus of rat-a-tat-tat sounds guaranteed to shatter sanity as well as concrete.
college-writing-004676.zh: 19. 空气锤开始了一个令人耳目一新的 Rat-a-tat-tat 声音合唱，保证了清醒和混凝土的破坏。

college-writing-004677.en: 20 Before reaching the office, the worker is already completely frazzled.
college-writing-004677.zh: 20. 在到达办公室之前，工人已经完全疲惫不堪。

college-writing-004678.en: 21 Noise pollution is as dangerous as any other kind of pollution.
college-writing-004678.zh: 21. 噪音污染与任何其他类型的污染一样危险。

college-writing-004679.en: 22 The endless pressure of noise probably triggers countless nervous breakdowns, vicious arguments, and bouts of depression.
college-writing-004679.zh: 22. 无休止的噪音压力可能会引发无数的神经衰弱、恶毒的争论和抑郁症。

college-writing-004680.en: 23 And imagine the world problems we could solve, if only the noise stopped long enough to let us think.
college-writing-004680.zh: 23. 想象一下我们可以解决的世界问题，只要噪音停止足够长的时间让我们思考。

college-writing-004682.zh: 第6章 修订论文的四个基础 173

college-writing-004693.zh: 7. 文章中使用的关键词发声有多少次？

college-writing-004694.zh: 8. 三个支持段落的时间顺序混淆了。

college-writing-004695.zh: 应该首先出现的支持段落的数量是多少？

college-writing-004699.en: 1 The big fraternity party turned out to be the low point of my first year at college.
college-writing-004699.zh: 1. 大型联谊会原来是我上大学第一年的低谷。

college-writing-004700.en: 2I was in heaven until I discovered that my date with handsome Greg, the fraternity vice president, was a hoax: he had used me to win the “ugliest date” contest.
college-writing-004700.zh: 2我一直在天堂，直到我发现与兄弟会副总裁格雷格的约会是一个骗局：他利用我赢得了“最丑陋的约会”比赛。

college-writing-004701.en: 3I ran sobbing back to the dorm, wanting to resign from the human race.
college-writing-004701.zh: 3我哭着跑回宿舍，想从人类中辞职。

college-writing-004702.en: 4 Then I realized that it was time to stop kidding myself about my weight.
college-writing-004702.zh: 4. 然后我意识到是时候停止自欺欺人了。

college-writing-004703.en: 5 Within the next two years, I lost forty-two pounds and turned my life around.
college-writing-004703.zh: 5. 在接下来的两年里，我减掉了 42 磅，改变了我的生活。

college-writing-004704.en: 6 Losing weight gave me self-confidence socially, emotionally, and professionally.
college-writing-004704.zh: 6. 减肥在社交、情感和专业上给了我自信。

college-writing-004706.en: 8 Just being able to abandon dark colors, baggy sweaters, and tent dresses in favor of bright colors, T-shirts, and designer jeans made me feel better in social situations.
college-writing-004706.zh: 8. 仅仅能够放弃深色、宽松的毛衣和帐篷连衣裙，转而选择鲜艳的颜色、T 恤和名牌牛仔裤，就让我在社交场合感觉更好。

college-writing-004707.en: 9I am able to do more things.

college-writing-004708.en: 10I once turned down an invitation for a great camping trip with my best friend’s family, making up excuses about sun poisoning and allergies.
college-writing-004708.zh: 10 我曾经拒绝与我最好朋友的家人一起进行一次愉快的露营旅行的邀请，为太阳中毒和过敏找借口。

college-writing-004709.en: 11 Really, I was too embarrassed to tell them that I couldn’t fit into the bathroom in their Winnebago!
college-writing-004709.zh: 11. 真的，我很尴尬地告诉他们我不能进入他们的温尼巴戈浴室！

college-writing-004710.en: 12I made up for it last summer when I was one of the organizers of a college backpacking trip through the Rockies.
college-writing-004710.zh: 12 去年夏天，当我是一次穿越落基山脉的大学背包旅行的组织者时，我弥补了这一点。

college-writing-004711.en: 13 Most important, losing weight helped me seek new professional goals.
college-writing-004711.zh: 13. 最重要的是，减肥帮助我寻求新的职业目标。

college-writing-004712.en: 14 When I was obese, I organized my whole life around my weight, as
college-writing-004712.zh: 14. 当我肥胖时，我围绕我的体重组织了我的整个生活，因为

college-writing-004715.en: 1. In “Weight Loss,” what is the number of the sentence to which the transition
