college-writing-005565.zh: 206 第 2 部分 论文发展模式

college-writing-005567.en: Traditionally, essay writing has been divided into the following patterns of development.
college-writing-005567.zh: 传统上，作文写作分为以下发展模式。

college-writing-005568.en: However, it’s important to remember that essays often emphasize one pattern while employing additional patterns to help support the thesis.
college-writing-005568.zh: 然而，重要的是要记住，论文通常强调一种模式，同时使用额外的模式来帮助支持论文。

college-writing-005569.zh: • 描述 • 叙述 • 说明

college-writing-005572.zh: 原因和/或影响 划分分类 • 论点

college-writing-005573.en: Description emphasizes verbal pictures of people, places, or things.
college-writing-005573.zh: 描述强调人物、地点或事物的口头图片。

college-writing-005574.en: Narration is used when a writer tells the story of something that happened.
college-writing-005574.zh: 当作家讲述发生的事情的故事时，使用叙述。

college-writing-005575.en: In exposition, the writer provides information about and explains a particular subject.
college-writing-005575.zh: 在阐述中，作者提供了有关特定主题的信息和解释。

college-writing-005576.en: Patterns of development often used within exposition include giving examples (exemplification); detailing a process of doing or making something; analyzing causes and effects; comparing or contrasting; defining a term or concept; and dividing something into parts or classifying it into categories.
college-writing-005576.zh: 阐述中经常使用的发展模式包括举例（例证）； 详细说明做某事或做某事的过程； 分析原因和影响； 比较或对比； 定义术语或概念； 并将某物划分为部分或将其分类为类别。

college-writing-005577.en: Finally, in argument, a writer attempts to support a controversial point or to defend a position on which there is a difference of opinion.
college-writing-005577.zh: 最后，在论证中，作者试图支持一个有争议的观点或捍卫存在意见分歧的立场。

college-writing-005578.en: The pages ahead present individual chapters that describe how to write essays that emphasize each pattern.
college-writing-005578.zh: 前面的页面展示了描述如何撰写强调每种模式的论文的各个章节。

college-writing-005579.en: You will have a chance, then, to learn nine different patterns or methods for organizing material in your papers.
college-writing-005579.zh: 然后，您将有机会学习九种不同的模式或方法来组织论文中的材料。

college-writing-005580.en: As you practice writing essays, keep these two points in mind:
college-writing-005580.zh: 练习写论文时，请牢记这两点：

college-writing-005581.en: • While each essay that you write will involve one predominant pattern, very often one or more additional patterns may be involved.
college-writing-005581.zh: • 虽然您撰写的每篇文章都涉及一种主要模式，但通常可能涉及一种或多种附加模式。

college-writing-005582.en: For example, consider the two student essays in Chapter 10, “Exemplification.”
college-writing-005582.zh: 例如，考虑第 10 章“例证”中的两篇学生论文。

college-writing-005583.en: The first essay there, “Paying Attention to a Death,” is developed through a series of anecdotes, scenes, and examples.
college-writing-005583.zh: 那里的第一篇文章“关注死亡”是通过一系列轶事、场景和例子发展起来的。

college-writing-005584.en: But there is also an element of comparison/contrast because the writer is discussing two different works that treat the same theme.
college-writing-005584.zh: 但也有比较/对比的一个元素，因为作者正在讨论处理同一主题的两件不同的作品。

college-writing-005585.en: In the second essay, “Altered States,” exemplification is again the predominant pattern, but in a lesser way the author is also explaining the causes of altered states of mind.
college-writing-005585.zh: 在第二篇文章“改变状态”中，例证再次成为主要模式，但作者也在较小的方式解释了心灵状态改变的原因。

college-writing-005586.en: • No matter which pattern or patterns you use, each essay will probably involve some form of argumentation.
college-writing-005586.zh: • 无论您使用哪种模式或模式，每篇文章都可能涉及某种形式的论证。

college-writing-005587.en: You will advance a point and then

college-writing-005588.zh: 第二部分 论文发展模式 207

college-writing-005589.en: go on to support that point.

college-writing-005590.en: In “Paying Attention to a Death,” for instance, the author uses exemplification to support their point that both the movie and the essay take a similar position about capital punishment.
college-writing-005590.zh: 例如，在“关注死亡”中，作者使用例证来支持他们的观点，即电影和文章都对死刑采取了类似的立场。

college-writing-005591.en: In “Celiac Disease Needs to Be Diagnosed to Be Controlled,” a writer supports the point that celiac disease needs to be diagnosed and controlled by providing a number of descriptive details.
college-writing-005591.zh: 在“需要诊断以控制乳糜泻”中，作者支持需要通过提供许多描述性细节来诊断和控制乳糜泻的观点。

college-writing-005592.en: In “A Night of Violence,” another writer claims that a certain experience in his life was frightening and then uses a narrative to persuade us of the truth of this statement.
college-writing-005592.zh: 在“暴力之夜”中，另一位作家声称他生活中的某种经历令人恐惧，然后使用叙述说服我们相信这个陈述的真实性。

college-writing-005593.en: Yet another author states that a fast-food restaurant can be preferable to a fancy one and then supplies comparative information about both to support his statement (“A Vote for McDonald’s”).
college-writing-005593.zh: 另一位作者指出，一家快餐店可能比一家花哨的餐厅更可取，然后提供有关两者的比较信息以支持他的声明（“投票给麦当劳”）。

college-writing-005594.en: Much of your writing, in short, will have the purpose of persuading your reader that the idea you have advanced is valid.
college-writing-005594.zh: 简而言之，您的大部分写作都旨在说服您的读者您提出的想法是有效的。

college-writing-005595.en: The Progression in Each Chapter In Chapters 8 through 16, after each pattern is explained, student essays and a model essay illustrating that emphasized pattern are presented, followed by questions about the essays.
college-writing-005595.zh: 在第 8 章到第 16 章的每一章中的进展，在解释每个模式后，呈现学生论文和说明强调模式的模型论文，然后是关于论文的问题。

college-writing-005596.en: The questions relate to unity, support, and coherence─ principles of effective writing explained earlier in this book and outlined on the inside back cover.
college-writing-005596.zh: 这些问题与本书前面解释的有效写作的统一、支持和连贯性原则有关，并在封底内进行了概述。

college-writing-005597.en: You are then asked to write your own essay.
college-writing-005597.zh: 然后你被要求写你自己的论文。

college-writing-005598.en: In most cases, the first assignment has a personal focus, is fairly structured, and provides a good deal of guidance for the writing process.
college-writing-005598.zh: 在大多数情况下，第一个作业有个人重点，结构合理，并为写作过程提供了大量的指导。

college-writing-005599.en: The other assignments typically have academic and work focuses and frequently require you to write with a specific purpose and for a specific audience.
college-writing-005599.zh: 其他作业通常以学术和工作为重点，经常要求您为特定目的和特定受众写作。

college-writing-005600.en: In some instances, the academic assignments require outside reading of literary works; a student model is provided for each of these assignments.
college-writing-005600.zh: 在某些情况下，学术作业需要外部阅读文学作品； 为每个作业提供了一个学生模型。

college-writing-005601.en: Finally, some of the work assignments ask you to research local and campus issues, and in a few instances, to write about your own workplace.
college-writing-005601.zh: 最后，一些工作任务要求您研究本地和校园问题，以及在少数情况下，写下您自己的工作场所。

college-writing-005602.en: Think about your college graduation day and write an essay about what you imagine it will be like.
college-writing-005602.zh: 想想你的大学毕业日，写一篇关于你想象它会是什么样子的文章。

college-writing-005604.en: What sights and sounds will surround you?
college-writing-005604.zh: 什么景象和声音会围绕着你？

college-writing-005605.en: Will your family and friends be there to congratulate you?
college-writing-005605.zh: 你的家人和朋友会在那里祝贺你吗？

college-writing-005606.en: Describe the day and bring it to life in your essay.
college-writing-005606.zh: 描述这一天，并在你的文章中实现它。

college-writing-005609.en: C H A P T E R

college-writing-005610.en: This chapter will explain and illustrate how to • develop an essay with emphasis on description • write an essay with emphasis on description • revise an essay with emphasis on description
college-writing-005610.zh: 本章将解释和说明如何 • 撰写以描述为重点的论文 • 撰写一篇强调描述的论文 • 修改文章，强调描述

college-writing-005611.en: In addition, you will read and consider • two student essays that emphasize description • one professional model essay that emphasizes description
college-writing-005611.zh: 此外，您将阅读和考虑 • 两篇强调描述的学生论文 • 一篇强调描述的专业模型论文

college-writing-005612.en: When you describe someone or something, you give your readers a picture in words.
college-writing-005612.zh: 当你描述某人或某事时，你会用文字给你的读者一张照片。

college-writing-005613.en: To make the word picture as vivid and real as possible, you must observe and record specific details that appeal to your readers’ senses (sight, hearing, taste, smell, and touch).
college-writing-005613.zh: 为了使图片文字尽可能生动和真实，您必须观察和记录吸引读者感官的特定细节（视觉、听觉、味觉、嗅觉和触觉）。

college-writing-005614.en: More than any other type of essay, a paper that emphasizes description needs sharp, colorful details.
college-writing-005614.zh: 与任何其他类型的论文相比，强调描述的论文更需要清晰、丰富多彩的细节。

college-writing-005615.en: Here is a sentence in which there is almost no appeal to the senses: “In the window was a fan.”
college-writing-005615.zh: 这是一个几乎没有吸引感官的句子：“窗户里是一个粉丝。”

college-writing-005616.en: In contrast, here is a description rich in sense impressions: “The blades of the rusty window fan clattered and whirled as they blew out a stream of warm, soggy air.
college-writing-005616.zh: 相比之下，这里有一个丰富的感官印象的描述：

college-writing-005620.en: ” Sense impressions in this second example include sight (rusty window fan, whirled), hearing (clattered), and touch (warm, soggy air).
college-writing-005620.zh: ” 第二个例子中的感官印象包括视觉（生锈的窗扇、旋转）、听力（咔哒声）和触摸（温暖、湿透的空气）。

college-writing-005621.en: The vividness and sharpness provided by the sensory details give us a clear picture of the fan and enable us to share the writer’s experience.
college-writing-005621.zh: 感官细节提供的生动和清晰，让我们清楚地了解风扇，使我们能够分享作者的经验。

college-writing-005622.en: In this chapter, you will be asked to describe a person, place, or thing sharply, by using words rich in sensory details.
college-writing-005622.zh: 在本章中，您将被要求通过使用丰富的感官细节的词来尖锐地描述一个人、地方或事物。

college-writing-005623.en: To prepare for this assignment, read the student essays and the model essay that follow and work through the questions that accompany each piece of writing.
college-writing-005623.zh: 为了准备这项作业，请阅读学生论文和随后的模型论文，并解决每篇文章随附的问题。

college-writing-005625.en: My great-grandmother, who is ninety-five years old, recently sent me a photograph of herself that I had never seen before.
college-writing-005625.zh: 我九十五岁的曾祖母最近给我发了一张我以前从未见过的照片。

college-writing-005626.en: While cleaning out the attic of her Florida home, she came across a studio portrait she had taken about a year before she married my great-grandfather.
college-writing-005626.zh: 在清理她佛罗里达州家的阁楼时，她看到了她在嫁给我的曾祖父之前大约一年拍摄的工作室肖像。

college-writing-005627.en: This picture of my great-grandmother as a twenty-year-old girl and the story behind it have fascinated me from the moment I began to consider it.
college-writing-005627.zh: 这张我曾祖母 20 岁的女孩的照片以及它背后的故事从我开始考虑的那一刻起就让我着迷。

college-writing-005628.en: The young woman in the picture has a face that resembles my own in many ways.
college-writing-005628.zh: 照片中的年轻女子有一张在很多方面都像我自己的脸。

college-writing-005629.en: Her face is a bit more oval than mine, but the softly waving brown hair around it is identical.
college-writing-005629.zh: 她的脸比我的更椭圆形，但它周围柔和的棕色头发是一模一样的。

college-writing-005630.en: The small, straight nose is the same model I was born with.
college-writing-005630.zh: 小而直的鼻子和我天生的模型相同。

college-writing-005631.en: My great-grandmother’s mouth is closed, yet there is just the slightest hint of a smile on her full lips.
college-writing-005631.zh: 我曾祖母的嘴闭上了，但她丰满的嘴唇上却只有一丝微笑。

college-writing-005632.en: I know that if she had smiled, she would have shown the same wide grin and down-curving “smile lines” that appear in my own snapshots.
college-writing-005632.zh: 我知道如果她笑了，她会表现出与我自己的快照中出现的同样宽大的笑容和下弯的“微笑线”。

college-writing-005633.en: The most haunting feature in the photo, however, is my great-grandmother’s eyes.
college-writing-005633.zh: 然而，照片中最令人难忘的特征是我曾祖母的眼睛。

college-writing-005634.en: They are an exact duplicate of my own large, dark brown ones.
college-writing-005634.zh: 它们完全是我自己的大而深棕色的复制品。

college-writing-005635.en: Her brows are plucked into thin lines, which are like two pencil strokes added to highlight those fine, luminous eyes.
college-writing-005635.zh: 她的眉毛被梳成细线，就像添加了两个铅笔笔触，突出了那双细而明亮的眼睛。

college-writing-005636.en: I’ve also carefully studied the clothing and jewelry in the photograph.
college-writing-005636.zh: 我还仔细研究了照片中的服装和珠宝。

college-writing-005637.en: Although the photo was taken seventy-five years ago, my greatgrandmother is wearing a blouse and skirt that could easily be worn today.
college-writing-005637.zh: 虽然这张照片是七十五年前拍的，但我的曾祖母穿着今天很容易穿的衬衫和裙子。

college-writing-005638.en: The blouse is made of heavy eggshell-colored satin and reflects the light in its folds and hollows.
college-writing-005638.zh: 这件衬衫由厚重的蛋壳色缎面制成，并在其褶皱和空洞中反射光线。

college-writing-005639.en: It has a turned-down cowl collar and smocking on the shoulders and below the collar.
college-writing-005639.zh: 它有一个翻转的整流领，肩膀和衣领下方有抽吸。

college-writing-005640.en: The smocking (tiny rows of gathered material) looks hand-done.
college-writing-005640.zh: 工作服（一排排收集的材料）看起来是手工制作的。

college-writing-005641.en: The skirt, which covers my great-grandmother’s calves, is straight and made of light wool or flannel.
college-writing-005641.zh: 这条裙子覆盖着我曾祖母的小腿，是直的，由浅色羊毛或法兰绒制成。

college-writing-005644.zh: 210 第 2 部分 论文发展模式

college-writing-005646.en: They are about two inches long and roughly shield-shaped.
college-writing-005646.zh: 它们大约有两英寸长且大致为盾形。

college-writing-005647.en: On her left wrist is a matching bracelet.
college-writing-005647.zh: 在她的左手腕上是一个相配的手镯。

college-writing-005648.en: My greatgrandmother can’t find this bracelet now, despite our having spent hours searching through the attic for it.
college-writing-005648.zh: 我的曾祖母现在找不到这个手镯，尽管我们花了几个小时在阁楼上寻找它。

college-writing-005649.en: On the third finger of her left hand is a ring with a large, square-cut stone.
college-writing-005649.zh: 在她的左手的无名指上，是一个带有方形切割大石头的戒指。

college-writing-005650.en: The story behind the picture is as interesting to me as the young woman it captures.
college-writing-005650.zh: 照片背后的故事对我来说和它捕捉到的年轻女子一样有趣。

college-writing-005651.en: Great-Grandmother, who was earning twenty-five dollars a week as a file clerk, decided to give her boyfriend (my greatgrandfather) a picture of herself.
college-writing-005651.zh: 曾祖母作为档案文员每周收入 25 美元，她决定给她的男朋友（我的曾祖父）一张她自己的照片。

college-writing-005652.en: She spent almost two weeks’ salary on the skirt and blouse, which she bought at a fancy department store downtown.
college-writing-005652.zh: 她在市中心一家高档百货公司买的裙子和衬衫上花了将近两周的薪水。

college-writing-005653.en: She borrowed the earrings and bracelet from her older sister, Ana.
college-writing-005653.zh: 她从姐姐安娜那里借了耳环和手镯。

college-writing-005654.en: The ring she wore was a present from another young man she was dating at the time.
college-writing-005654.zh: 她戴的戒指是她当时正在约会的另一个年轻人的礼物。

college-writing-005655.en: Great-Grandmother spent another chunk of her salary to pay the portrait photographer for the hand-tinted print in old-fashioned tones of brown and tan.
college-writing-005655.zh: 曾祖母又花了一大笔薪水支付了肖像摄影师的老式棕色和棕褐色的手工印刷版画。

college-writing-005656.en: Just before giving the picture to my great-grandfather, she scrawled at the lower left, “Sincerely, Rosa.”
college-writing-005656.zh: 就在把照片交给我的曾祖父之前，她在左下角潦草地写着：“真诚的，罗莎。”

college-writing-005657.en: When I study this picture, I react in many ways.
college-writing-005657.zh: 当我研究这张照片时，我会在很多方面做出反应。

college-writing-005658.en: I think about the trouble that my great-grandmother went to in order to impress the young man who was to be my great-grandfather.
college-writing-005658.zh: 我想起了我的曾祖母为了给将要成为我曾祖父的年轻人留下深刻印象而遇到的麻烦。

college-writing-005659.en: I laugh when I look at the ring, which was probably worn to make him jealous.
college-writing-005659.zh: 当我看着戒指时，我笑了，这可能是为了让他嫉妒而戴的。

college-writing-005660.en: I smile at the serious, formal inscription my great-grandmother used at this stage of the budding relationship.
college-writing-005660.zh: 我对我曾祖母在萌芽关系的这个阶段使用的严肃、正式的铭文微笑。

college-writing-005661.en: Sometimes, I am filled with a mixture of pleasure and sadness when I look at this frozen long-ago moment.
college-writing-005661.zh: 有时，当我看到这片冰冷的很久以前的时刻时，我充满了快乐和悲伤的混合。

college-writing-005662.en: It is a moment of beauty, of love, and—in a way—of my own past.
college-writing-005662.zh: 这是一个美丽的时刻，爱的时刻，而且——在某种程度上——是我自己过去的时刻。

college-writing-005664.en: People who read fiction often do so because the worlds inside the book covers are filled with the excitement and characters that everyday life lacks.
college-writing-005664.zh: 阅读小说的人经常这样做，因为书封面内的世界充满了日常生活所缺乏的兴奋和人物。

college-writing-005665.en: Delving into the lives of characters of differing cultures and beliefs helps readers learn empathy, tolerance, and perseverance—traits that can transfer into their daily lives.
college-writing-005665.zh: 深入了解不同文化和信仰的人物的生活，有助于读者学习同理心、宽容和毅力——这些特征可以转移到他们的日常生活中。

college-writing-005666.en: Characters in nonfiction books are usually not as interesting as those in fiction books.
college-writing-005666.zh: 非小说类书籍中的人物通常不像小说书籍中的人物那样有趣。

college-writing-005667.en: Three of the best female friends a reader will find in the world of books are Hermione Granger (Harry Potter); Elizabeth Bennet (Pride and Prejudice); and Katniss Everdeen (The Hunger Games).
college-writing-005667.zh: 读者会在书籍世界中找到的三个最好的女性朋友是赫敏·格兰杰（哈利·波特）； 伊丽莎白班纳特（骄傲和偏见）； 和 Katniss Everdeen（饥饿游戏）。

college-writing-005668.en: Hermione Granger is the girl everyone loves to hate but secretly wants to know.
college-writing-005668.zh: 赫敏格兰杰是每个人都爱恨但暗自想知道的女孩。

college-writing-005669.en: With her thick brown hair, which is often out of control, to her larger-than-usual front teeth, Hermione is often teased about her appearance.
college-writing-005669.zh: 赫敏的长发常常失控，对她的门牙来说比平时还要大，所以赫敏经常被取笑她的外表。

college-writing-005670.en: However, it is her intelligence and calmness that make her invaluable to those around her.
college-writing-005670.zh: 然而，正是她的智慧和冷静使她对周围的人来说是无价的。

college-writing-005671.en: Her ability to cast spells, and to remember
college-writing-005671.zh: 她施展咒语和记忆的能力

college-writing-005675.en: 1. In which supporting paragraph of “Fictional Female Friends” does the topic
college-writing-005675.zh: 1.《虚构女性朋友》的支持段落中的主题

college-writing-005676.en: sentence appear at the paragraph’s end, rather than the beginning?
college-writing-005676.zh: 句子出现在段落的结尾，而不是开头？

college-writing-005681.en: the correct spells even in tense situations, saves her friends Ron and Harry numerous times.
college-writing-005681.zh: 即使在紧张的情况下，正确的咒语也会多次拯救她的朋友罗恩和哈利。

college-writing-005682.en: Her loyalty is another quality that inspires those around her to want to be her friend.
college-writing-005682.zh: 她的忠诚是另一个激励她周围人想成为她朋友的品质。

college-writing-005683.en: Even under the most dreadful of circumstances, Hermione never wavers in her loyalty to her friends or those she respects.
college-writing-005683.zh: 即使在最可怕的情况下，赫敏也从不动摇她对朋友或她所尊重的人的忠诚。

college-writing-005684.en: Her know-it-all attitude might be annoying at times, but her other qualities make her one of the best friends a person could ask for.
college-writing-005684.zh: 她的无所不知的态度有时可能很烦人，但她的其他品质使她成为一个人可以要求的最好的朋友之一。

college-writing-005685.en: While she has what are described as expressive eyes, they are this way because they tend to reflect what is going on in Elizabeth’s mind.
college-writing-005685.zh: 虽然她有被描述为富有表现力的眼睛，但它们是这样的，因为它们倾向于反映伊丽莎白的脑海中正在发生的事情。

college-writing-005686.en: Her intelligence and wit are often unmatched by any other woman.
college-writing-005686.zh: 她的智慧和智慧往往是任何其他女人都无法比拟的。

college-writing-005687.en: In fact, she often challenges men’s comments and observations despite society’s views that women should be secondary to men.
college-writing-005687.zh: 事实上，尽管社会认为女性应该是男性，但她经常挑战男性的评论和观察。

college-writing-005688.en: What is most endearing, however, about Elizabeth is her love of family—despite the numerous times they make fools of themselves or of her.
college-writing-005688.zh: 然而，最讨人喜欢的是，伊丽莎白是她对家庭的热爱——尽管他们多次自欺欺人。

college-writing-005689.en: Her ability to love and forgive is a quality that every friend should have.
college-writing-005689.zh: 她爱和宽恕的能力是每个朋友都应该拥有的品质。

college-writing-005690.en: Unlike Hermione, Elizabeth Bennet is described as a great beauty, but her looks are not her most important qualities.
college-writing-005690.zh: 与赫敏不同，伊丽莎白班纳特被描述为一个伟大的美女，但她的外表并不是她最重要的品质。

college-writing-005691.en: Katniss Everdeen is not only a fierce warrior but also a fierce friend.
college-writing-005691.zh: Katniss Everdeen 不仅是一个凶猛的战士，也是一个凶猛的朋友。

college-writing-005692.en: She believes in doing what is right for humanity even if that means going against society’s laws.
college-writing-005692.zh: 她相信为人类做正确的事，即使这意味着违反社会法律。

college-writing-005693.en: Before she becomes a tribute, she spends her time focusing on surviving by hunting and trading to feed her family.
college-writing-005693.zh: 在她成为致敬之前，她将时间花在了通过狩猎和交易来养家糊口的生存上。

college-writing-005694.en: While her focus is on family, she doesn’t overlook the hardships others face and, in spite of danger, does what she can to help.
college-writing-005694.zh: 虽然她的重点是家庭，但她并没有忽视别人面临的困难，尽管有危险，她还是尽其所能提供帮助。

college-writing-005695.en: Her desire to protect her family is what forces her to partake in the Hunger Games, a sacrifice not many would be willing to make.
college-writing-005695.zh: 她保护家人的愿望迫使她参加饥饿游戏，这是没有多少人愿意做出的牺牲。

college-writing-005696.en: Once in the games, Katniss doesn’t lose herself to the hatred and evil that is prevalent.
college-writing-005696.zh: 一旦在游戏中，Katniss 并没有迷失在普遍存在的仇恨和邪恶中。

college-writing-005697.en: Instead, she finds many ways to demonstrate her humanity—from creating a memorial for Rue, the young girl from District 11, to risking death as she challenges the Capitol to save Peeta’s life.
college-writing-005697.zh: 相反，她找到了许多方法来展示她的人性——从为来自第 11 区的年轻女孩 Rue 创建一个纪念碑，到在挑战国会大厦以拯救皮塔的生命时冒着死亡的风险。

college-writing-005698.en: Everyone should have a friend who is as passionate as Katniss.
college-writing-005698.zh: 每个人都应该有一个像凯特尼斯一样热情的朋友。

college-writing-005699.en: Reading books can have great impact.
college-writing-005699.zh: 读书可以产生很大的影响。

college-writing-005700.en: Opening a book and experiencing the world between the covers can transform a person’s point of view and thinking.
college-writing-005700.zh: 打开一本书，在封面之间体验世界可以改变一个人的观点和思维。

college-writing-005701.en: The characters inside these fictional worlds offer so much more than just their stories.
college-writing-005701.zh: 这些虚构世界中的人物提供的不仅仅是他们的故事。

college-writing-005702.en: Good characters can demonstrate what good friends should look like.
college-writing-005702.zh: 好角色可以展示好朋友应该是什么样子。

college-writing-005703.en: Even though they may be fictional, they can help readers learn about the types of qualities their real-life friends should have.
college-writing-005703.zh: 尽管它们可能是虚构的，但它们可以帮助读者了解他们现实生活中的朋友应该具备的品质类型。
