college-writing-007182.en: Cedric read his classmate’s comments and reviewed the essay himself.
college-writing-007182.zh: 塞德里克阅读了他同学的评论并自己复习了这篇文章。

college-writing-007183.en: He agreed with their criticisms about point of view and the need for stronger supporting details.
college-writing-007183.zh: 他同意他们对观点和对更强的需要的批评支撑细节。

college-writing-007184.en: He also decided that the Internet was his strongest supporting point and should be saved for the last paragraph.
college-writing-007184.zh: 他还认为互联网是他最有力的支持点，应该保存在最后一段中。

college-writing-007185.en: He then wrote the final version of his essay, the version that appears at the beginning of this chapter.
college-writing-007185.zh: 然后他写了他的文章的最终版本，出现在本章开头的版本。

college-writing-007188.en: Then answer the questions and read the comments that follow.
college-writing-007188.zh: 然后回答问题并阅读下面的评论。

college-writing-007191.en: The first memory I have of him─of anything, really─is his strength.
college-writing-007191.zh: 我对他的第一个记忆——真的是他的力量。

college-writing-007192.en: It was in the late afternoon in a house under construction near ours.
college-writing-007192.zh: 那是在下午晚些时候在我们附近正在建设的房子里。

college-writing-007193.en: The unfinished wood floors had large, terrifying holes whose yawning darkness I knew led to nowhere good.
college-writing-007193.zh: 未完工的木地板上有大而可怕的洞，我知道它们打着的黑暗导致了无处可去。

college-writing-007194.en: His powerful hands, then age thirty-three, wrapped all the way around my tiny arms, then age four, and easily swung me up to his shoulders to command all I surveyed.
college-writing-007194.zh: 他强大的手，然后三十三岁，一直缠绕在我的小手臂上，然后四岁，轻松地将我甩到他的肩膀上，指挥我所调查的一切。

college-writing-007195.en: The relationship between a son and his father changes over time.
college-writing-007195.zh: 儿子和父亲的关系会随着时间的推移而改变。

college-writing-007196.en: It may grow and flourish in mutual maturity.
college-writing-007196.zh: 它可能在相互成熟的情况下生长和繁荣。

college-writing-007197.en: It may sour in resented dependence or
college-writing-007197.zh: 它可能会在怨恨的依赖中变酸或

college-writing-007199.en: Dazed shoppers begin to feel like mountain climbers trapped in a blinding snowstorm.
college-writing-007199.zh: 目瞪口呆的购物者开始觉得像登山者被困在令人眼花缭乱的暴风雪中。

college-writing-007200.zh: 突然间，一切看起来都一样。

college-writing-007201.en: My father is the worst of all when it comes to shopping in an altered state.
college-writing-007201.zh: 在改变状态下购物时，我的父亲是最糟糕的。

college-writing-007202.en: He comes back from the mall looking like he’d been through a war.
college-writing-007202.zh: 他从商场回来，看起来像是经历了一场战争。

college-writing-007203.en: After about fifteen minutes of shopping, he can’t concentrate enough to know what he’s looking for.
college-writing-007203.zh: 经过大约 15 分钟的购物，他无法集中注意力，无法知道自己在寻找什么。

college-writing-007204.en: Internet surfers, TV viewers, and shoppers all have one thing in common.
college-writing-007204.zh: 互联网冲浪者、电视观众和购物者都有一件事。

college-writing-007205.en: They’re just trying to cope with the mind-numbing inventions of modern life.
college-writing-007205.zh: 他们只是想应对现代生活中令人麻木的发明。

college-writing-007206.en: I hope that someday we’ll turn away from such inventions and return to a simpler and more healthy way of life.
college-writing-007206.zh: 我希望有一天我们会远离这些发明，回到更简单、更健康的生活方式。

college-writing-007212.en: about modern shoppers, not just one
college-writing-007212.zh: 关于现代购物者，而不仅仅是一种

college-writing-007214.en: This final sentence seems to introduce
college-writing-007214.zh: 这最后一句话似乎介绍了

college-writing-007215.en: a new topic—that we shouldn’t get
college-writing-007215.zh: 一个新的话题——我们不应该得到

college-writing-007216.en: caught up in TV and the Internet, etc.
college-writing-007216.zh: 被电视和互联网等吸引。

college-writing-007217.zh: 第262章 论文发展模式

college-writing-007219.en: With many children living in single-parent homes today, it may not even exist.
college-writing-007219.zh: 今天有许多孩子住在单亲家庭中，它甚至可能不存在。

college-writing-007220.en: But to a little boy right after World War II, a father seemed a god with strange strengths and uncanny powers enabling him to do and know things that no mortal could do or know.
college-writing-007220.zh: 但对于二战后的一个小男孩来说，一位父亲似乎是一位具有奇怪力量和不可思议的力量的神，使他能够做和知道凡人无法做或知道的事情。

college-writing-007221.en: Amazing things, like putting a bicycle chain back on, just like that.
college-writing-007221.zh: 令人惊奇的事情，比如重新打开自行车链条，就像那样。

college-writing-007223.en: Or guiding a jigsaw so it formed the letter F; I learned the alphabet that way in those pretelevision days, one letter or number every other evening plus a review of the collection.
college-writing-007223.zh: 或引导拼图以形成字母 F； 在那些预电视时代，我以这种方式学习了字母表，每隔一个晚上就有一封信或数字，加上对该系列的评论。

college-writing-007224.en: (The vowels we painted red because they were special somehow.)
college-writing-007224.zh: （我们把元音画成红色，因为它们很特别。）

college-writing-007225.en: He seemed to know what I thought before I did.
college-writing-007225.zh: 他似乎在我之前知道我的想法。

college-writing-007226.en: “You look like you could use a cheeseburger and a chocolate shake,” he would say on hot Sunday afternoons.
college-writing-007226.zh: “你看起来可以用芝士汉堡和巧克力奶昔，”他会在炎热的周日下午说。

college-writing-007227.en: When, at the age of five, I broke a neighbor’s garage window with a wild curveball and waited in fear for ten days to make the announcement, he seemed to know about it already and to have been waiting for something.
college-writing-007227.zh: 当我五岁时，我用一个狂野的曲线球打破了邻居的车库窗户，害怕了十天才宣布，他似乎已经知道这件事并且一直在等待什么。

college-writing-007228.en: There were, of course, rules to learn.

college-writing-007230.en: None of those fishy little finger grips, but a good firm squeeze accompanied by an equally strong gaze into the other’s eyes.
college-writing-007230.zh: 那些鱼腥味的小手指都没有抓住，而是一个很好的紧紧的挤压，伴随着同样强烈的凝视对对方的眼睛。

college-writing-007231.en: “The first thing anyone knows about you is your handshake,” he would say.
college-writing-007231.zh: “任何人都知道你的第一件事就是你的握手，”他会说。

college-writing-007232.en: And we’d practice it each night on his return from work, the serious toddler in the battered Cleveland Indians cap running up to the giant father to shake hands again and again until it was firm enough.
college-writing-007232.zh: 我们每天晚上下班后都会练习它，那个严肃的蹒跚学步的克利夫兰印第安人帽子跑到巨大的父亲身边，一次又一次地握手，直到它足够坚定。

college-writing-007233.en: When my cat killed a bird, he defused the anger of a nine-year-old with a little chat about something called “instinked.”
college-writing-007233.zh: 当我的猫杀死一只鸟时，他用一个叫做“Insinked”的东西聊天，化解了一个九岁的孩子的愤怒。

college-writing-007234.en: The next year, when my dog got run over and the weight of sorrow was just too immense to stand, he was there, too, with his big arms and his own tears and some thoughts on the natural order of life and death, although what was natural about a speeding car that didn’t stop always escaped me.
college-writing-007234.zh: 第二年，当我的狗被撞倒，悲伤的重量太大而无法站立时，他也在那里，他的大手臂和自己的眼泪以及对生与死的自然秩序的一些想法，尽管一辆不停的超速车总是逃脱的 我。

college-writing-007235.en: As time passed, there were other rules to learn.
college-writing-007235.zh: 随着时间的推移，还有其他规则需要学习。

college-writing-007236.en: “Always do your best.” “Do it now.” “NEVER LIE!”
college-writing-007236.zh: “永远尽力而为。” “现在就做。” “永远不要说谎！”

college-writing-007237.en: And, most important, “You can do whatever you have to do.”
college-writing-007237.zh: 而且，最重要的是，“你可以做任何你必须做的事情。”

college-writing-007238.en: By my teens, he wasn’t telling me what to do anymore, which was scary and heady at the same time.
college-writing-007238.zh: 到我十几岁的时候，他不再告诉我该做什么，这同时既可怕又令人兴奋。

college-writing-007239.en: He provided perspective, not telling me what was around the great corner of life but letting me know there was a lot more than just today and the next, which I hadn’t thought of.
college-writing-007239.zh: 他提供了视角，没有告诉我生活的伟大角落是什么，而是让我知道不仅仅是今天和下一个，我没有想到。

college-writing-007240.en: When the most important girl in the world─I forget her name now─turned down a movie date, he just happened to walk by the kitchen phone.
college-writing-007240.zh: 当世界上最重要的女孩——我现在忘记了她的名字——拒绝了电影约会时，他恰好在厨房的电话旁边走。

college-writing-007241.en: “This may be hard to believe right now,” he said, “but someday you won’t even remember her name.”
college-writing-007241.zh: “现在可能很难相信，”他说，“但总有一天你甚至不会记住她的名字。”

college-writing-007242.en: One day, I realize now, there was a change.
college-writing-007242.zh: 有一天，我现在意识到，发生了变化。

college-writing-007243.en: I wasn’t trying to please him so much as I was trying to impress him.
college-writing-007243.zh: 我并没有试图取悦他，因为我试图给他留下深刻印象。

college-writing-007244.en: I never asked him to come to my football games.
college-writing-007244.zh: 我从来没有要求他来参加我的足球比赛。

college-writing-007245.en: He had a high-pressure career, and it meant driving through most of Friday night.
college-writing-007245.zh: 他的职业生涯很高，这意味着周五晚上的大部分时间都在开车。

college-writing-007246.en: But for all the big games, when I looked over at the sideline, there was that familiar fedora.
college-writing-007246.zh: 但是对于所有大型游戏，当我看着边线时，有那个熟悉的 Fedora。

college-writing-007247.en: And, by God, did the opposing team captain ever get a firm handshake and a gaze he would remember.
college-writing-007247.zh: 而且，天哪，对方队长有没有牢牢握手和他会记得的凝视。

college-writing-007249.en: Then, a school fact contradicted something he said.
college-writing-007249.zh: 然后，一个学校的事实与他所说的相矛盾。

college-writing-007250.en: Impossible that he could be wrong, but there it was in the book.
college-writing-007250.zh: 他不可能是错的，但书中就有了。

college-writing-007251.en: These accumulated over time, along with personal experiences, to buttress1 my own developing sense of values.
college-writing-007251.zh: 这些随着时间的推移而积累，以及个人经验，以支持我自己发展中的价值观。

college-writing-007252.en: And I could tell we had each taken our own, perfectly normal paths.
college-writing-007252.zh: 我可以说我们每个人都走了自己的、完全正常的道路。

college-writing-007253.en: I began to see, too, his blind spots, his prejudices, and his weaknesses.
college-writing-007253.zh: 我也开始看到他的盲点、他的偏见和他的弱点。

college-writing-007254.en: I never threw these up at him.
college-writing-007254.zh: 我从来没有向他吐过这些。

college-writing-007255.en: He hadn’t to me, and, anyway, he seemed to need protection.
college-writing-007255.zh: 他对我没有，而且，无论如何，他似乎需要保护。

college-writing-007256.en: I stopped asking his advice; the experiences he drew from no longer seemed relevant to the decisions I had to make.
college-writing-007256.zh: 我不再征求他的意见； 他从中汲取的经验似乎不再与我必须做出的决定有关。

college-writing-007257.en: On the phone, he would go on about politics at times, why he would vote the way he did or why some incumbent was a jerk.
college-writing-007257.zh: 在电话中，他有时会继续谈论政治，为什么他会以他的方式投票，或者为什么有些现任者是个混蛋。

college-writing-007258.en: And I would roll my eyes to the ceiling and smile a little, though I hid it in my voice.
college-writing-007258.zh: 我会把眼睛翻到天花板上微笑，尽管我把它藏在我的声音里。

college-writing-007259.en: He volunteered advice for a while.
college-writing-007259.zh: 他自愿提供了一段时间的建议。

college-writing-007260.en: But then, in more recent years, politics and issues gave way to talk of empty errands and, always, to ailments─his friends’, my mother’s, and his own, which were serious and included heart disease.
college-writing-007260.zh: 但是，在最近几年，政治和问题让位于谈论空的差事，而且总是会因为疾病——他的朋友、我母亲和他自己的疾病而让位于，这些疾病是严重的，包括心脏病。

college-writing-007261.en: He had a bedside oxygen tank, and he would ostentatiously2 retire there during my visits, asking my help in easing his body onto the mattress.
college-writing-007261.zh: 他有一个床头氧气罐，他会在我访问期间炫耀地退休，请求我帮助将他的身体放松到床垫上。

college-writing-007262.en: “You have very strong arms,” he once noted.
college-writing-007262.zh: “你的手臂很强壮，”他曾经指出。

college-writing-007263.en: From his bed, he showed me the many sores and scars on his misshapen body and all the bottles of medicine.
college-writing-007263.zh: 从他的床上，他向我展示了他畸形身体和所有药瓶上的许多疮和疤痕。

college-writing-007264.en: He talked of the pain and craved much sympathy.
college-writing-007264.zh: 他谈到了痛苦，渴望得到很多同情。

college-writing-007266.en: But the scene was not attractive.

college-writing-007267.en: He told me, as the doctor had, that his condition would only deteriorate.
college-writing-007267.zh: 他告诉我，正如医生所说，他的病情只会恶化。

college-writing-007268.en: “Sometimes,” he confided, “I would just like to lie down and go to sleep and not wake up.”
college-writing-007268.zh: “有时，”他透露，“我只想躺下睡觉而不是醒来。”

college-writing-007269.en: After much thought and practice (“You can do whatever you have to do”), one night last winter, I sat down by his bed and remembered for an instant those terrifying dark holes in another house thirty-five years before.
college-writing-007269.zh: 经过深思熟虑和练习（“你可以做任何你必须做的事情”），去年冬天的一个晚上，我坐在他的床边，一瞬间想起了三十五年前另一所房子里那些可怕的黑洞。

college-writing-007270.en: I told my father how much I loved him.
college-writing-007270.zh: 我告诉父亲我有多爱他。

college-writing-007271.en: I described all the things people were doing for him.
college-writing-007271.zh: 我描述了人们为他做的所有事情。

college-writing-007272.en: But, I said, he kept eating poorly, hiding in his room, and violating other doctors’ orders.
college-writing-007272.zh: 但是，我说，他一直吃得不好，躲在房间里，违反了其他医生的命令。

college-writing-007273.en: No amount of love could make someone else care about life, I said: it was a two-way street.
college-writing-007273.zh: 再多的爱也不能让别人关心生活，我说：那是一条两条路。

college-writing-007276.en: He said he knew how hard my words had been to say and how proud he was of me.
college-writing-007276.zh: 他说他知道我的话有多难说，他为我感到多么自豪。

college-writing-007277.en: “I had the best teacher,” I said.

college-writing-007278.en: “You can do whatever you have to do.”
college-writing-007278.zh: “你可以做任何你必须做的事情。”

college-writing-007279.en: He smiled a little, and we shook hands, firmly, for the last time.
college-writing-007279.zh: 他微微一笑，我们最后一次坚定地握手。

college-writing-007280.en: Several days later, at about 4 A.M., my mother heard Dad shuffling about their dark room.
college-writing-007280.zh: 几天后，大约凌晨 4 点，我妈妈听到爸爸在他们的黑暗房间里拖着脚步。

college-writing-007281.en: “I have some things I have to do,” he said.

college-writing-007282.en: He paid a bundle of bills.

college-writing-007283.en: He composed for my mother a long list of legal and financial what-to-do’s “in case of emergency.”
college-writing-007283.zh: 他为我妈妈写了一长串法律和财务要做的“万一万一”。

college-writing-007284.en: And he wrote me a note.

college-writing-007285.en: Then he walked back to his bed and laid himself down.

college-writing-007286.zh: 他自然而然地去睡觉了。

college-writing-007287.en: And he did not wake up.

college-writing-007296.zh: B. 宠物是一个吸引我父亲和我的话题。

college-writing-007297.zh: c.  我父亲帮助我理解生活的悲剧。

college-writing-007299.zh: 3. 写出可能作为第 10 段 主题句 的句子。

college-writing-007302.zh: 父亲“似乎是一位具有奇怪力量和不可思议力量的神。”

college-writing-007303.zh: 5. 马尔科姆在第 14 段中支持他的陈述

college-writing-007306.zh: 6. 第 8 段中的轶事支持什么观点或想法？

college-writing-007308.zh: 7. 什么事件让马尔科姆开始以更现实的方式看到他的父亲，更少

college-writing-007310.en: 8. In paragraph 6, find each of the following: a.
college-writing-007310.zh: 8. 在第 6 段中，找到以下各项：

college-writing-007318.zh: 9. 马尔科姆在他的文章中使用哪种组织方法？

college-writing-007324.en: 10. The conclusion of “Dad” is made up of

college-writing-007325.en: a. a summary of the narrative and a final thought.
college-writing-007325.zh: 一。 叙述的总结和最后的想法。

college-writing-007327.en: c. the last event of the story about Malcolm and his father.
college-writing-007327.zh: c.  关于马尔科姆和他父亲的故事的最后一个事件。

college-writing-007328.en: d. a prediction of what kind of father Malcolm hopes to be himself.
college-writing-007328.zh: D. 预测马尔科姆希望成为什么样的父亲。

college-writing-007329.en: Writing an Essay with Emphasis on Exemplification
college-writing-007329.zh: 写一篇强调例证的论文

college-writing-007330.en: In this assignment, write an essay that exemplifies how you best learn and should study.
college-writing-007330.zh: 在这项作业中，写一篇文章，说明您如何最好地学习和应该学习。

college-writing-007333.en: Using whatever prewriting method works best for you, write down past
college-writing-007333.zh: 使用最适合您的预写方法，写下过去

college-writing-007334.en: experiences, both good and bad, of studying for tests.
college-writing-007334.zh: 学习测试的经验，无论好坏。

college-writing-007335.en: Note what made the experiences positive and negative.
college-writing-007335.zh: 注意是什么让这些经历变得积极和消极。

college-writing-007337.zh: 访问 http://www.vark-learn.com 并单击“问卷”。

college-writing-007339.en: questionnaire to discover what type of learner you are.
college-writing-007339.zh: 问卷调查以发现您是哪种类型的学习者。

college-writing-007340.en: Once you have determined your type, click on “Helpsheets” to read about studying suggestions geared toward that type.
college-writing-007340.zh: 确定您的类型后，单击“帮助表”以阅读有关研究针对该类型的建议的信息。

college-writing-007342.en: In order to properly present the information you have gathered, read Chapter 19,
college-writing-007342.zh: 为了正确呈现您收集的信息，请阅读第 19 章，

college-writing-007343.en: “Writing a Source-Based Essay,” and Chapter 20, “Writing a Research Essay,” paying attention to how to write your information and how to avoid plagiarism.
college-writing-007343.zh: “写一篇基于来源的论文”和第 20 章，“撰写研究论文”，关注如何编写您的信息以及如何避免抄袭。

college-writing-007345.en: Using all the information you have gathered, write a topic sentence that intro-
college-writing-007345.zh: 使用您收集到的所有信息，编写一个 主题句

college-writing-007346.en: duces your learner type and what it means.
college-writing-007346.zh: 决定您的学习者类型及其含义。

college-writing-007347.en: Sample topic sentences have been provided to get you started:
college-writing-007347.zh: 已提供示例 主题句 以帮助您入门：

college-writing-007348.en: • After reading the VARK website, I understand that I am a Read/Write learner and to be successful, I need to employ specific study skills.
college-writing-007348.zh: • 阅读 Vark 网站后，我了解到我是一名阅读/写作学习者，要取得成功，我需要运用特定的学习技能。

college-writing-007349.en: • I always struggled in school because I was terrible at studying, but since I now know that I am a kinesthetic learner, I have a better idea of how I should study.
college-writing-007349.zh: • 我在学校总是很挣扎，因为我在学习方面很糟糕，但因为我现在知道我是一个动觉学习者，我对我应该如何学习有了更好的了解。

college-writing-007351.zh: 第266章 论文发展模式

college-writing-007353.en: Write the first draft of your essay and support your thesis sentence by incorporating a definition of your study type, facts from the helpsheets, and examples or anecdotes from past studying experiences.
college-writing-007353.zh: 写下你的论文的初稿，并结合你的研究类型的定义、帮助表中的事实以及过去学习经历的例子或轶事来支持你的论文句子。

college-writing-007355.en: After you have completed the first draft of the paper, set it aside for a while if you can.
college-writing-007355.zh: 完成论文的初稿后，如果可以的话，将其搁置一段时间。

college-writing-007356.en: When you review it, try to do so as critically as you would if it were not your own work.
college-writing-007356.zh: 当您查看它时，请尝试尽可能批判地进行，如果它不是您自己的工作。

college-writing-007357.en: Better yet, read it aloud to a friend or classmate whose judgment you trust.
college-writing-007357.zh: 更好的是，大声朗读给你信任的朋友或同学。

college-writing-007358.en: As you read, use the questions in the FOUR BASES Checklist at the end of this chapter as a guide to help you revise.
college-writing-007358.zh: 阅读时，请使用本章末尾的四个基础清单中的问题作为帮助您修改的指南。

college-writing-007359.en: As you revise your essay through one or more additional drafts, continue to refer to that checklist until you can answer “yes” to each question.
college-writing-007359.zh: 当您通过一份或多份附加草稿修改论文时，请继续参考该清单，直到您可以对每个问题回答“是”。

college-writing-007360.zh: 詹姆斯伍德森/盖蒂图片社

college-writing-007361.en: Write an essay that emphasizes exemplification based upon an outside reading.
college-writing-007361.zh: 写一篇强调基于外部阅读的例证的文章。

college-writing-007362.en: It might be a selection recommended by your instructor, or it might be a piece by one of the following authors, all of whom have written books of essays that should be available in your college library.
college-writing-007362.zh: 它可能是您的导师推荐的选择，也可能是以下作者之一的作品，他们都写过应该在您的大学图书馆中提供的论文书籍。

college-writing-007363.en: Malcolm Gladwell Ellen Goodman bell hooks Aldous Huxley Molly Ivins Maxine Hong Kingston Gabriel Garcia Marquez Vladimir Nabokov George Orwell Cynthia Ozick Ann Patchett
college-writing-007363.zh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔·艾伦·古德曼·贝尔·贝尔·古德曼·贝尔·贝尔·古德曼·贝尔·霍克斯利

college-writing-007364.en: Anna Quindlen Marilynne Robinson Richard Rodriguez Amy Tan Deborah Tannen Henry David Thoreau Calvin Trillin Alice Walker Marie Winn Virginia Woolf Jenny Zhang
college-writing-007364.zh: 安娜·奎德伦·玛丽莲·罗宾逊 理查德·罗德里格斯 艾米·坦·德博拉·坦南·亨利·大卫·索罗·卡尔文·特罗林 爱丽丝·沃克·玛丽·温·弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫·珍妮·张

college-writing-007365.en: Base your essay on an idea in the selection you have chosen, and provide a series of examples to back up your idea.
college-writing-007365.zh: 基于您选择的选择中的想法，并提供一系列示例来支持您的想法。

college-writing-007366.en: Of course, you may want to draw information from the reading selection by quoting from it or making other types of references.
college-writing-007366.zh: 当然，您可能希望通过引用或引用其他类型的引用来从阅读选择中提取信息。

college-writing-007372.en: In this essay that emphasizes exemplification, you will write with a specific purpose and for a specific audience.
college-writing-007372.zh: 在这篇强调例证的文章中，您将有特定的目的和特定的受众。

college-writing-007373.en: Your essay should present a strong explanation to your boss about exactly what you do on a daily basis and why you should be given a raise.
college-writing-007373.zh: 你的文章应该向你的老板提供一个强有力的解释，说明你每天到底做了什么，以及为什么你应该加薪。

college-writing-007374.en: Strive to incorporate as many specific examples of the tasks you perform every day and describe why you are good at them.
college-writing-007374.zh: 努力整合您每天执行的任务的尽可能多的具体示例，并描述您为什么擅长这些任务。

college-writing-007375.en: For instance, perhaps you work at an animal shelter and clean kennels every day, and you have streamlined the process to be quicker and less stressful on the animals.
college-writing-007375.zh: 例如，也许您每天都在动物收容所工作并清洁狗窝，并且您已经简化了流程，以使动物更快、更少压力。

college-writing-007376.en: Possibly you work as a UPS package handler and have figured out a better route plan for your territory.
college-writing-007376.zh: 可能您是一名 UPS 包裹处理程序，并为您的领土找到了更好的路线计划。

college-writing-007377.en: You may want to review Chapter 8, “Description,” to help you provide specific details explaining what your daily duties are.
college-writing-007377.zh: 您可能想查看第 8 章“描述”，以帮助您提供解释您的日常职责的具体细节。

college-writing-007378.en: You may also want to check Chapter 16, “Argument,” to help you create a persuasive tone to your essay.
college-writing-007378.zh: 您可能还想查看第 16 章“论证”，以帮助您为您的论文创造一种有说服力的语气。

college-writing-007380.en: you might also use examples from other sources, perhaps something else you have read, a movie you have seen, or a personal experience.
college-writing-007380.zh: 您还可以使用来自其他来源的示例，也许是您读过的其他内容、您看过的电影或个人经历。

college-writing-007381.en: You may want to review Chapter 19, “Writing a Source-Based Essay,” and Chapter 20, “Writing a Research Essay,” to help you properly report and document the author’s original information.
college-writing-007381.zh: 您可能想复习第 19 章“撰写基于来源的论文”和第 20 章“撰写研究论文”，以帮助您正确报告和记录作者的原始信息。

college-writing-007382.en: The student literary analysis essay, “Paying Attention to a Death,” in the beginning of the chapter offers a model essay for this assignment.
college-writing-007382.zh: 本章开头的学生文学分析论文“关注死亡”为这项作业提供了一篇模型论文。

college-writing-007383.en: Writing for a Specific Purpose and Audience
college-writing-007383.zh: 为特定目的和受众写作

college-writing-007384.zh: 第268章 论文发展模式

college-writing-007389.en: Reprinted by permission of the author.

college-writing-007392.en: Have I included a thesis statement that illustrates the topic I am going to discuss?
college-writing-007392.zh: 我是否包含了一个 中心论点句 来说明我将要讨论的主题？

college-writing-007393.en: Are there portions of the essay that do not support my thesis and therefore should be eliminated or rewritten?
college-writing-007393.zh: 文章中是否有部分不支持我的论文，因此应该被删除或重写？

college-writing-007395.en: Have I included enough vivid details that will help my readers understand the point I am trying to make?
college-writing-007395.zh: 我是否包含了足够生动的细节来帮助我的读者理解我想要表达的观点？

college-writing-007396.en: Does my conclusion clearly tie up the essay and explain why my topic is significant?
college-writing-007396.zh: 我的结论是否清楚地结合了这篇文章并解释了为什么我的主题很重要？

college-writing-007398.en: Does each paragraph support a topic sentence that connects to the thesis?
college-writing-007398.zh: 每个段落是否支持与论文相关的 主题句？

college-writing-007399.en: Do transitional words and phrases, and linking sentences between paragraphs, help readers follow my train of thought?
college-writing-007399.zh: 过渡词和短语，以及在段落之间链接句子，是否有助于读者遵循我的思路？

college-writing-007401.en: Have I used a consistent point of view throughout my essay?
college-writing-007401.zh: 我在整个论文中都使用了一致的观点吗？

college-writing-007402.en: Have I used specific rather than general words?
college-writing-007402.zh: 我使用过特定的而不是一般的词吗？

college-writing-007403.en: Have I avoided wordiness and used concise wording?
college-writing-007403.zh: 我是否避免冗长并使用简洁的措辞？

college-writing-007405.en: Have I edited for spelling and other sentence skills errors, as listed in the checklist at the back of the book?
college-writing-007405.zh: 我是否编辑了书面清单中列出的拼写和其他句子技能错误？

college-writing-007406.en: Write an essay that informs a reader about how to perform a particular hobby or activity you enjoy.
college-writing-007406.zh: 写一篇文章，告知读者如何执行您喜欢的特定爱好或活动。

college-writing-007407.en: Depending on the hobby or activity you are writing about, you may prefer to use a humorous approach.
college-writing-007407.zh: 根据您所写的爱好或活动，您可能更喜欢使用幽默的方法。

college-writing-007409.en: C H A P T E R 11 11 Process
college-writing-007409.zh: C h a p t e r 11 11 工艺

college-writing-007410.en: This chapter will explain and illustrate how to • develop an essay with emphasis on process • write an essay with emphasis on process • revise an essay with emphasis on process
college-writing-007410.zh: 本章将解释和说明如何 • 撰写一篇强调过程的论文 • 撰写一篇强调过程的论文 • 修改论文并强调过程

college-writing-007411.en: In addition, you will read and consider • two student essays that emphasize process • one professional model essay that emphasizes process
college-writing-007411.zh: 此外，您将阅读和考虑 • 两篇强调过程的学生论文 • 一篇强调过程的专业模型论文

college-writing-007412.en: Every day we perform many activities that are processes, that is, series of steps carried out in a definite order.
college-writing-007412.zh: 每天我们执行许多活动，即以一定的顺序执行的一系列步骤。

college-writing-007413.en: Many of these processes are familiar and automatic: for example, loading film into a camera, diapering a baby, or making an omelet.
college-writing-007413.zh: 其中许多过程是熟悉且自动的：例如，将胶片装入相机、给婴儿换尿布或制作煎蛋卷。

college-writing-007414.en: We are thus seldom aware of the sequence of steps making up each activity.
college-writing-007414.zh: 因此，我们很少意识到构成每个活动的步骤序列。

college-writing-007415.en: In other cases─for example, when someone asks us for directions to a particular place, or when we try to read and follow directions to build an IKEA set of Billy bookcases─we may be painfully conscious of the whole series of steps involved in the process.
college-writing-007415.zh: 在其他情况下——例如，当有人向我们询问前往特定地点的路线时，或者当我们尝试阅读并遵循指示构建一套宜家的比利书柜时——我们可能会痛苦地意识到整个过程中涉及的一系列步骤。

college-writing-007416.en: In this chapter, you will be asked to write an essay with emphasis on process─one that explains clearly how to do or make something.
college-writing-007416.zh: 在本章中，您将被要求写一篇强调过程的论文——一个清楚地解释如何做或做某事的文章。

college-writing-007419.zh: 270 第二部分 论文发展模式

college-writing-007421.en: To prepare for this assignment, you should first read the student papers and the model essay and then answer the questions that follow them.
college-writing-007421.zh: 为了准备这项作业，您应该首先阅读学生论文和模型论文，然后回答他们之后的问题。

college-writing-007422.zh: 营销计划：快乐儿童学前班

college-writing-007423.en: Happy Child Preschool is a valuable and cherished part of our campus, but enrollment has declined dramatically over the past two years.
college-writing-007423.zh: 快乐儿童幼儿园是我们校园中珍贵且受重视的组成部分，但过去两年里入学人数大幅减少。

college-writing-007424.en: Thus, a task force was commissioned to analyze the causes.
college-writing-007424.zh: 因此，成立了一个特别小组来分析其原因。

college-writing-007425.en: The comparative analysis conducted by the task force uncovered numerous ways that other campus childcare centers have achieved success through marketing.
college-writing-007425.zh: 工作组进行的比较分析揭示了其他校园托儿中心通过营销取得成功的多种方式。

college-writing-007426.en: The task force agrees that promotion is the number one issue that has been overlooked in the past and the area where major and immediate improvements are essential to the long-term success of the center.
college-writing-007426.zh: 特别工作组认为，推广是过去被忽视的首要问题，也是必须立即进行重大改进的领域，因为这对中心的长期发展至关重要。

college-writing-007427.en: In order to effectively market the preschool, promoting the center needs to remain at the top of the priority chart and should include proper advertising, publicity, and referrals.
college-writing-007427.zh: 为了有效推广幼儿园业务，该中心必须处于优先事项列表的顶端，并应开展适当的广告、宣传及推荐活动。

college-writing-007428.en: The first step is proper advertising that must start with a well-designed multi-layered website that includes general information, enrollment forms, and profiles of teachers and staff.
college-writing-007428.zh: 第一步是适当的广告，必须从一个精心设计的多层网站开始，其中包括一般信息、注册表以及教师和工作人员的概况。

college-writing-007429.en: The general information page should contain the hours of operation, location, and contact information.
college-writing-007429.zh: 一般信息页面应包含营业时间、地点和联系信息。

college-writing-007430.en: The top of the page should include a banner with scrolling photos of children and staff at the center.
college-writing-007430.zh: 页面顶部应包括一个横幅，上面有儿童和工作人员的滚动照片。

college-writing-007431.en: Underneath the banner, several links, including the enrollment forms and profiles, should be prominently placed.
college-writing-007431.zh: 在横幅下方，应突出放置几个链接，包括注册表格和个人资料。

college-writing-007432.en: Having a direct link to online enrollment and other business forms will encourage potential families to enroll because families can fill out the application forms when it is convenient for them, not when the center is open.
college-writing-007432.zh: 直接链接到在线注册和其他商业表格将鼓励潜在的家庭注册，因为家庭可以在方便的时候填写申请表，而不是在中心开放时填写。

college-writing-007433.en: Making the application process easier than the current process should increase interest.
college-writing-007433.zh: 使申请过程比当前流程更容易应该会增加兴趣。

college-writing-007434.en: The page with teacher profiles is a great place to bring attention to our quality educators.
college-writing-007434.zh: 带有教师简介的页面是吸引我们优质教育工作者关注的好地方。

college-writing-007435.en: Including pictures, background information, and education will help promote our facility because all the teachers at our center are highly qualified.
college-writing-007435.zh: 包括图片、背景信息和教育将有助于推广我们的设施，因为我们中心的所有教师都是高素质的。

college-writing-007436.en: All of this information will demonstrate our strengths and help potential families appreciate the top quality of education our center provides.
college-writing-007436.zh: 所有这些信息都将展示我们的优势，并帮助潜在的家庭欣赏我们中心提供的优质教育。

college-writing-007437.en: Publicity could include a monthly column in the local newspaper that highlights what is currently going on at the preschool.
college-writing-007437.zh: 宣传方式可以包括在当地报纸上刊登每月一次的专栏文章，报道幼儿园当前正在开展的活动。

college-writing-007442.en: curriculum is a blend of Montessori and Carden methods, we have a unique offering; calling attention to the special achievements, programs, and students in our school would offer the positive publicity needed to interest potential families.
college-writing-007442.zh: 课程融合了蒙台梭利和卡登方法，我们有独特的产品； 提请注意我们学校的特殊成就、计划和学生将提供让潜在家庭感兴趣的积极宣传。

college-writing-007443.en: Each column’s publication should be followed by an open house, so potential families can actually visit our school.
college-writing-007443.zh: 每列报道之后都应安排开放日，以便潜在的家庭能够实际参观我们的学校。

college-writing-007444.en: These open houses should also occur during key enrollment periods to encourage greater attendance.
college-writing-007444.zh: 这些开放日活动也应在重要的报名期间进行，以鼓励更多人参与。

college-writing-007445.en: In addition, hosting one or two major events will continue to raise awareness of our school within the community.
college-writing-007445.zh: 此外，举办一两个重大活动将继续提高对我们学校在社区内的认识。

college-writing-007446.en: The final and best way to increase enrollment is to utilize our currently enrolled families.
college-writing-007446.zh: 增加入学率的最终也是最好的方法是利用我们目前注册的家庭。

college-writing-007447.en: Word-of-mouth is one of the best ways to increase enrollment.
college-writing-007447.zh: 口碑是增加入学率的最佳方式之一。

college-writing-007448.en: Families who are pleased with their children’s schools are often more than happy to tell others.
college-writing-007448.zh: 对孩子的学校感到满意的家庭通常非常乐意告诉其他人。

college-writing-007449.en: Offering referral rewards to families will help encourage families to tell others about the school.
college-writing-007449.zh: 向家庭提供推荐奖励将有助于鼓励家庭向其他人介绍学校的信息。

college-writing-007450.en: The task force looked at several referral programs and determined that a program that offers families monetary rewards that are applied to monthly fees would be a cost-effective program.
college-writing-007450.zh: 工作组查看了几个推荐计划，并确定为家庭提供的适用于每月费用的金钱奖励的计划将是一个具有成本效益的计划。

college-writing-007451.en: Partnering with local colleges’ education programs would also be a cost-effective program.
college-writing-007451.zh: 与当地大学的教育计划合作也是一项具有成本效益的计划。

college-writing-007452.en: By putting these approaches into place, we project that our enrollment should increase to capacity within the next two years.
college-writing-007452.zh: 通过将这些方法付诸实施，我们预计我们的入学人数应在未来两年内增加到容量。

college-writing-007453.en: These key components have been overlooked in the past, so we are hopeful that the committee will accept this new direction.
college-writing-007453.zh: 这些关键组成部分过去被忽视，因此我们希望委员会能够接受这一新方向。

college-writing-007454.en: It will play a significant role in the future of the success of the school.
college-writing-007454.zh: 它将在学校的成功中发挥重要作用。

college-writing-007456.en: I’m not just a consumer—I’m a victim.
college-writing-007456.zh: 我不仅仅是一个消费者——我是一个受害者。

college-writing-007457.en: If I order a product, it is sure to arrive in the wrong color, size, or quantity.
college-writing-007457.zh: 如果我订购产品，它很可能会以错误的颜色、尺寸或数量送达。

college-writing-007458.en: If I hire people to do repairs, they never arrive on the day scheduled.
college-writing-007458.zh: 如果我雇佣人进行维修工作，他们从来不会按预定的时间到达。

college-writing-007459.en: If I owe a bill, the computer program is bound to overcharge me.
college-writing-007459.zh: 如果我欠账单，计算机程序一定会多收我的费用。

college-writing-007460.en: Therefore, in self-defense, I have developed the following consumer’s guide to complaining effectively.
college-writing-007460.zh: 因此，出于自卫的考虑，我制定了以下有效投诉指南，供消费者参考。

college-writing-007461.en: The first step is getting organized.

college-writing-007462.en: I save all sales slips and original boxes.
college-writing-007462.zh: 我保存所有销售单和原始盒子。

college-writing-007463.en: Also, I keep a special file for warranty cards and appliance guarantees.
college-writing-007463.zh: 此外，我保留了一个用于保修卡和设备保证的特殊文件。

college-writing-007464.en: This file does not prevent a product from falling apart the day after the guarantee runs out.

college-writing-007476.en: When I compose my letter of complaint, I find it is not necessary to exaggerate.
college-writing-007476.zh: 当我撰写投诉信时，我发现没有必要夸大其词。

college-writing-007477.en: I just stick to the facts.

college-writing-007478.en: The next step is to send the complaint to the person who will get results quickly.
college-writing-007478.zh: 下一步是将投诉发送给能够快速获得结果的人。

college-writing-007479.en: My experience has shown that the president of the company is the best person to contact.
college-writing-007479.zh: 我的经验表明，公司总裁是最好的联系人。

college-writing-007480.en: I call the company to find out the president’s name and make sure I note the proper spelling.
college-writing-007480.zh: 我打电话给公司找出总统的名字，并确保我记下了正确的拼写。

college-writing-007481.en: Then I write directly to that person, and I usually get prompt action.
college-writing-007481.zh: 然后我直接写给那个人，我通常会及时采取行动。

college-writing-007482.en: For example, the head of AMF arranged to replace my son’s ten-speed “lemon” when it fell apart piece by piece in less than a year.
college-writing-007482.zh: 例如，AMF 的负责人安排在不到一年的时间里一块一块地分开我儿子的十速“柠檬”。

college-writing-007483.en: Another time, the president of a Philadelphia department store finally had a twenty-dollar overcharge on my bill corrected after I had spent three months arguing uselessly with a computer program.
college-writing-007483.zh: 还有一次，在我花了三个月的时间与计算机程序无用地争论后，费城一家百货公司的总裁终于在我的账单上获得了 20 美元的多收费用。

college-writing-007484.en: If I get no response to a written complaint within ten days, I follow through with a personal telephone call.
college-writing-007484.zh: 如果我在十天内没有收到书面投诉的回复，我会通过个人电话进行跟进。

college-writing-007485.en: When I had a new bathtub installed a few years ago, the plumber left a gritty black substance on the bottom of the tub.
college-writing-007485.zh: 几年前我安装了一个新浴缸时，水管工在浴缸底部留下了一种坚硬的黑色物质。

college-writing-007486.en: No amount of scrubbing could remove it.
college-writing-007486.zh: 再多的擦洗也无法将其移除。

college-writing-007487.en: I tried every cleanser on the supermarket shelf, but I still had a dirty tub.
college-writing-007487.zh: 我尝试了超市货架上的所有清洁剂，但我仍然有一个脏浴缸。

college-writing-007488.en: The plumber shrugged off my complaints and said to try Comet.
college-writing-007488.zh: 水管工对我的抱怨不以为然，说要试试彗星。

college-writing-007489.en: The manufacturer never answered my letter or e-mail.
college-writing-007489.zh: 制造商从未回复我的信或电子邮件。

college-writing-007490.en: Finally, I made a personal phone call to the president of the firm.
college-writing-007490.zh: 最后，我给公司总裁打了一个私人电话。

college-writing-007491.en: Within days a well-dressed executive showed up at my door.
college-writing-007491.zh: 几天之内，一位穿着考究的高管出现在我家门口。

college-writing-007492.en: In a business suit, white shirt, striped tie, and rubber gloves, he cleaned the tub.
college-writing-007492.zh: 他穿着西装、白衬衫、条纹领带和橡胶手套，清洗了浴缸。

college-writing-007493.en: Before he left, he scolded me in an angry voice, “You didn’t have to call the president.”
college-writing-007493.zh: 在他离开之前，他用愤怒的声音责骂我：“你不必给总统打电话。”

college-writing-007494.en: The point is, I did have to call the president.
college-writing-007494.zh: 关键是，我确实必须打电话给总统。

college-writing-007495.en: No one else cared enough to solve the problem.
college-writing-007495.zh: 没有其他人足够关心解决问题。

college-writing-007496.en: Therefore, my advice to consumers is to keep accurate records, and if a complaint needs to be made, they should go right to the top.
college-writing-007496.zh: 因此，我对消费者的建议是保持准确的记录，如果需要提出投诉，他们应该直接登上顶峰。

college-writing-007497.en: It has always worked for me.

college-writing-007525.zh: 第274章 论文发展模式

college-writing-007526.en: Developing an Essay with Emphasis on Process Considering Purpose and Audience Glance at a newsstand and you’ll see magazine cover stories with titles such as “How to Impress Your Boss,” “How to Add Romance to Your Life,” or “How to Dress Like a Movie Star.”
college-writing-007526.zh: 写一篇文章，考虑目的和观众的目的，看看报摊，你会看到杂志的封面故事，比如“如何给你的老板留下深刻印象”、“如何为你的生活增添浪漫”或“如何穿得像电影明星”。

college-writing-007527.en: These articles promise to give readers directions or information they can follow; they are popular versions of essays that emphasize process.
college-writing-007527.zh: 这些文章承诺为读者提供他们可以遵循的方向或信息； 它们是强调过程的散文的流行版本。

college-writing-007528.en: In general, essays that emphasize process explain the steps involved in a particular action, process, or event.
college-writing-007528.zh: 一般来说，强调过程的论文解释了特定行动、过程或事件所涉及的步骤。

college-writing-007529.en: Some of these essays focus on giving readers actual instructions, others provide information, and still others focus on persuading readers.
college-writing-007529.zh: 其中一些文章侧重于为读者提供实际说明，另一些则提供信息，而另一些则侧重于说服读者。

college-writing-007530.en: The type of essay you write depends on the specific topic and purpose you choose.
college-writing-007530.zh: 您撰写的论文类型取决于您选择的特定主题和目的。

college-writing-007531.en: Begin by asking yourself what you want your readers to know.
college-writing-007531.zh: 首先问自己你希望读者知道什么。

college-writing-007532.en: If, for example, you want your audience to know how to make the ultimate chocolate chip cookie, your essay would include directions telling them what to do and how to do it.
college-writing-007532.zh: 例如，如果您希望您的观众知道如何制作终极巧克力曲奇，您的文章将包括告诉他们该做什么以及如何做的方向。

college-writing-007533.en: On the other hand, if you want your readers to know how a cookie is digested, you would detail the events in the body as it turns food into energy.
college-writing-007533.zh: 另一方面，如果你想让你的读者知道饼干是如何消化的，你会详细说明身体中的事件，因为它将食物转化为能量。

college-writing-007534.en: No matter what your main purpose, keep your audience in mind as you work.
college-writing-007534.zh: 无论您的主要目的是什么，在您工作时都要牢记您的受众。

college-writing-007535.en: As with any essay, select a topic that will interest readers.
college-writing-007535.zh: 与任何论文一样，选择一个让读者感兴趣的主题。

college-writing-007536.en: A group of college students, for example, might be interested in reading an essay that explains how and why to get financial aid but be bored by an essay on how and why to plan for retirement.
college-writing-007536.zh: 例如，一群大学生可能对阅读一篇文章感兴趣，该论文解释了如何以及为什么获得经济援助，但对一篇关于如何以及为什么计划退休的文章感到厌烦。

college-writing-007537.en: Finally, evaluate how much your readers already know about your topic.
college-writing-007537.zh: 最后，评估您的读者对您的主题的了解程度。

college-writing-007538.en: An audience unfamiliar with your topic might require you to explain technical terms.
college-writing-007538.zh: 不熟悉您的主题的受众可能需要您解释技术术语。

college-writing-007539.en: If you are explaining how to protect your computer from viruses, for example, you might have to define “firewall.”
college-writing-007539.zh: 例如，如果您正在解释如何保护您的计算机免受病毒侵害，您可能必须定义“防火墙”。

college-writing-007540.en: If you are explaining how to check a car’s tire pressure, you might have to describe a pressure gauge.
college-writing-007540.zh: 如果您正在解释如何检查汽车的轮胎压力，您可能需要描述一个压力表。

college-writing-007541.en: Deciding on Structure, Content, and Style

college-writing-007542.en: • As with other types of papers, include a thesis.
college-writing-007542.zh: • 与其他类型的论文一样，包括论文。

college-writing-007543.en: Your thesis might explain your purpose─why it is important to learn how to change the oil in your car or why learning to prepare a room for painting is worth knowing.
college-writing-007543.zh: 你的论文可能会解释你的目的——为什么学习如何更换汽车中的油很重要，或者为什么学习为绘画准备房间是值得了解的。

college-writing-007544.en: On the other hand, it might explain something definitive about the process.
college-writing-007544.zh: 另一方面，它可能解释了这个过程的确定性。

college-writing-007545.en: For example, you might begin a paper on the digestive process by stating that “the human body is a truly marvelous machine.”
college-writing-007545.zh: 例如，您可以通过说“人体是一台真正奇妙的机器”开始一篇关于消化过程的论文。

college-writing-007546.en: Then, of course, you would have to show just how marvelous it is as you explain how it digests food.
college-writing-007546.zh: 然后，当然，当你解释它如何消化食物时，你必须展示它是多么奇妙。

college-writing-007548.en: • Use language that is easy to follow and not unnecessarily complex.
college-writing-007548.zh: • 使用易于遵循且不会不必要的复杂语言。

college-writing-007549.en: If you are explaining how to do something, your readers may be executing your instructions as they read them for the first time.
college-writing-007549.zh: 如果您正在解释如何做某事，您的读者可能会在第一次阅读时执行您的说明。

college-writing-007550.en: So be as clear as you can to avoid unintentionally misleading the reader.
college-writing-007550.zh: 所以尽可能清楚地避免无意中误导读者。

college-writing-007551.en: • In most cases, list each step in chronological or time order.
college-writing-007551.zh: • 在大多数情况下，按时间顺序或时间顺序列出每个步骤。

college-writing-007552.en: (See the final section of Chapter 3 for words that signal time.)
college-writing-007552.zh: （有关指示时间的单词，请参阅第 3 章的最后一部分。）

college-writing-007553.en: • Explain each step in a separate paragraph.
college-writing-007553.zh: • 在单独的段落中解释每个步骤。

college-writing-007554.en: If two steps are done or occur simultaneously, connect separate paragraphs with phrases such as “At the same time.”
college-writing-007554.zh: 如果同时完成或同时进行两个步骤，请将单独的段落与“同时”等短语连接起来。

college-writing-007555.en: • When giving information about a process, use the right verb tense.
college-writing-007555.zh: • 在提供有关过程的信息时，使用正确的动词时态。

college-writing-007556.en: If you are explaining something that happened only once, use the past tense: “After Mount Vesuvius erupted, it covered the city of Pompeii with pumice and ash.”
college-writing-007556.zh: 如果你解释的事情只发生过一次，就用过去的时态：“维苏威火山爆发后，它用浮石和灰烬覆盖了庞贝城。”

college-writing-007557.en: However, if you are discussing something that recurs, use the present tense: “During the next phase of digestion, food passes down the esophagus to the stomach.”
college-writing-007557.zh: 但是，如果您正在讨论一些反复出现的事情，请使用现在时：“在下一阶段消化过程中，食物会从食道下传到胃中。”

college-writing-007558.en: • If you are presenting information, as in the examples about Pompeii and digestion above, you should always write in the formal third person.
college-writing-007558.zh: • 如果您提供的信息，如上述关于庞贝和消化的示例，您应该始终以正式的第三人称写作。

college-writing-007559.en: If you are writing directions (something this book does), you may write in the second person, directly addressing your audience as “you,” or in the third person.
college-writing-007559.zh: 如果您正在编写方向（本书的内容），您可以以第二人称写作，直接以“您”或第三人称称呼您的听众。

college-writing-007560.en: It’s important to remember that the second person should be used very sparingly.
college-writing-007560.zh: 重要的是要记住，第二人称应该非常谨慎地使用。

college-writing-007561.en: TIP For more information about third- and second-person points of view, see Chapter 7.
college-writing-007561.zh: 提示 有关第三人称和第二人称观点的更多信息，请参阅第 7 章。

college-writing-007562.en: Development through Prewriting An essay that emphasizes process requires the writer to think through the steps involved in an activity.
college-writing-007562.zh: 通过预写一篇强调过程的论文的发展需要作者思考活动中涉及的步骤。

college-writing-007563.en: As Meghan, the author of “How to Complain,” thought about possible topics for her essay, she asked herself, “What are some things I do methodically, step by step?”
college-writing-007563.zh: 当《如何抱怨》的作者梅根想到她的论文可能的话题时，她问自己：“我有条不紊地做些什么，一步一步？”

college-writing-007564.en: A number of possibilities occurred to her, including getting herself and her children ready for school in the morning and shopping for groceries (from preparing a shopping list to organizing her coupons), and the one she finally settled on: effective complaining.
college-writing-007564.zh: 她发生了许多可能性，包括让自己和她的孩子早上准备好上学和购买杂货（从准备清单到整理她的优惠券），以及她最终确定的方式：有效的抱怨。

college-writing-007565.en: “People tell me I’m ‘so organized’ when it comes to getting satisfaction on things I buy,” Meghan said.
college-writing-007565.zh: “人们告诉我，当我对我购买的东西感到满意时，我‘非常有条理’，”梅根说。

college-writing-007566.en: “I realized that I do usually get results when I complain because I go about complaining in an organized way. To write my essay, I just needed to put those steps into words.”
college-writing-007566.zh: “我意识到，当我抱怨时，我通常会得到结果，因为我会以有组织的方式抱怨。为了写我的论文，我只需要把这些步骤变成文字。”

college-writing-007567.zh: 第276章 论文发展模式

college-writing-007574.zh: 写信或电子邮件投诉信
